They were Army lieutenant general Wang Peng (王鹏), who headed the CMC training and administration department from 2021–2025; Army lieutenant general Liu Faqing (刘发庆), who led the CMC national defense mobilization department from 2021–2025; and Navy vice admiral Zhao Xiaozhe (赵晓哲), who previously oversaw the CMC science and technology department. Separately, Army lieutenant general Zhang Lin (张林), director of the CMC logistics support department from 2022–2025, was removed from the NPC last October and expelled at the Fifth Plenum ( Zaobao , October 16, 2025). Last but not least, Army lieutenant generals Zhong Shaojun (钟绍军) and Fang Yongxiang (方永祥) were both considered confidants of Xi. Zhong assisted Xi since the latter’s tenure in Zhejiang in the early 2000s ( VOA , August 29). After Xi came to power, he brought Zhong into the PLA as a senior colonel, despite having no military experience, to manage the crucial CMC chairman’s office that supported Xi’s daily work schedule ( China Brief , September 14). Zhong subsequently became director of the CMC general office that provided administrative and logistical support to all CMC members, before eventually serving as political commissar of the National Defense University. He vanished in October 2025 and was removed from the NPC in August 2026, prior to his expulsion from the Party in October ( Zaobao , October 29). Fang succeeded Zhong in leading both the CMC chairman’s office and CMC general office, indicating a high level of trust that Xi had in him ( SCMP , October 26, 2024). Like many previously mentioned officers, Fang failed to attend the Fourth Plenum, with no news regarding his whereabouts until his expulsion from the CCP at the recent Fifth Plenum. Defense Industry Expulsions Other than military officers, Sun Shaopin (孙绍骋), former minister of veterans affairs from 2018–2022, was also expelled from the Party ( Caixin , January 29). Moreover, one third of the 17 civilian cadres expelled at the Fifth Plenum were associated with state-owned defense enterprises. At the top of the expulsion list was Lei Fanpei (雷凡培). He had a long career in the country’s aerospace industry, rising from an ordinary designer to become chairman of the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC). From 2018–2022, Lei was the chairman of China State Shipbuilding Corporation (CSSC) ( World Ships , October 31). From 2022–2025, Lei served as the deputy director at the Office of Central Military-Civil Fusion Development Commission (中央军民融合发展委员会办公室) ( Zaobao , October 31, 2024). Despite being an experienced technocrat and crucial link between defense companies and policymakers, Lei was expelled from the Party at the Fifth Plenum. Several other senior leaders from the defense sector were expelled at the same time. They include former chairman of the China National Nuclear Corporation Yu Jianfeng (余剑锋); former chairman of CASC Yuan Jie (袁洁), who was removed in 2024 likely in connection with the Rocket Force investigations that year ( Radio Free Asia , April 15, 2024); Zhang Zhongyang (张忠阳), former chairman of CASC and head of the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology, the country’s largest research, development, and production institution for carrier rockets and missile systems ( Zaobao , January 30, 2024); Wen Gang (温刚), former chairman of Norinco and CSSC ( Caixin , October 30); and Jin Donghan (金东寒), an engine and marine propulsion research specialist and former president of Shanghai University and Tianjin University. Jin spent decades researching engines for the PRC’s defense industry and led the CSSC’s Shanghai Marine Diesel Engine Research Institute that specializes in marine diesel and gas engines, power systems, electrical and automation systems, and energy equipment ( 163 , January 15). Scope of Purge Shows Inter-Service Political Priorities As the largest PLA service, the Army predominated among those expelled, accounting for 11 of the 16 military officers. The Navy follows with three officers, Information Support Force and the People’s Armed Police each account for one. Neither the Air Force nor Rocket Force saw any expulsions this time. While the lack of Rocket Force expulsions may be linked to the broad purges that decimated its top leadership in 2023 and the subsequent years, the absence of Air Force expulsions again highlights this service as the least affected by the purges so far. This reinforces the author’s previous assessment that the Air Force is set to gain influence within the reconstructed PLA high command, as its senior leadership remains comparatively intact ( The Diplomat , August 11). The professional backgrounds of expelled officers also reveal important patterns in the direction of the purge. Military officers with extensive command experience constitute seven cases while political commissars account for six, followed by three defense technocrats. This shows that the commanders and commissars of major PLA organizations are most at risk. The authorities appear to make no distinction between commanders or commissars when conducting investigations. In comparison, defense technocrats, who tend to stay in the background, seem to be less affected by the current campaign. Interestingly, three expelled officers had close personal ties with Xi, with relations dating back years, if not decades. But this did not save them from being purged, indicating that Xi does not tolerate any malfeasance or signs of disloyalty among military officers, regardless of their personal relations with him. Fourth Plenum Absences as a Potential Purge Indicator Another recurring theme is the connection between the expelled and the Fourth Plenum. Out of 16 officers expelled at the Fifth Plenum, 11 were absent from the Fourth Plenum in October 2025, with two more—Wang Renhua and Zhong Shaojun—disappearing from public view immediately after the gathering. This suggests that these 13 officers had likely been detained and placed under investigation around the time of the Fourth Plenum. This sequence teaches us that absence from key Party meetings is an early warning sign of political trouble and missing individuals are likely to end up as purge victims. It is worth noting that several other officers absent from the Fourth Plenum have not yet been expelled. They include Commander of the Southern Theater Command Wu Ya’nan (吴亚男); Political Commissar of the Central Theater Command Xu Deqing (徐德清); Commander of the PLA Navy Hu Zhongming (胡中明), and Political Commissar of the PLA Rocket Force Xu Xisheng (徐西盛) ( Sing Tao Daily , October 27, 2025; BBC , November 7, 2025). Despite having no news and public appearance since the Fourth Plenum, events at the Fifth Plenum suggest that they have met their downfall. Turning to the defense industry, the affiliations of the expelled executives reveal a clear concentration of those associated with CASC and CSSC. Others were linked to the China National Nuclear Corporation, Norinco, and key research institutions developing missiles and marine engines. There may be parallels between the depth of corruption within these corporations and the quality of their equipment, echoing concerns previously raised about Rocket Force vulnerabilities ( CNA , January 11, 2024). As investigations are likely to expand in these sectors, the disruptions could have negative consequences for the PRC’s defense industrial base and military modernization. Conclusion The armed forces and defense industry cadres constitute a two-third majority of Fifth Plenum expulsions, an extraordinary development when personnel involved in national defense only account for a minority within the entire Party-state elite. While the rise of CMC Vice Chairman Zhang Shengmin reestablished formal communications between the Politburo and the PLA, the Fifth Plenum’s expulsions offer broader insights into the state of the PLA. As Xi reconstructs the high command, the Fifth Plenum reminds us that trust between the commander-in-chief and his generals remains low ( The Diplomat , July 6). While it is not difficult to appoint new people to top posts, building confidence and rapport is a long-term project that might be undermined by frequent leadership instability. zh_title: 美日海底矿产资源开发联合声明
summary: 发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对于繁荣至关重要
content:
发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对两国的繁荣和国家安全至关重要。两国政府认识到负责任的海底矿产资源开发的潜力，可以使关键矿产供应多样化、创造新的商业机会并支持两国的工业基础。这项合作建立在特朗普总统和高市首相于 2025 年 10 月签署的《美日通过采矿和加工确保关键矿产和稀土供应的框架》中规定的共同目标的基础上，并通过美日双边举措得到推进，其中包括美国商务部与日本经济产业省于 2026 年 3 月签署的合作备忘录 (MoC)。
两国政府对谅解备忘录所取得的进展表示欢迎，包括 11 月 11 日至 12 日在日本富山举行的美日工作组第二次会议，会议讨论了日本南鸟岛附近的稀土泥浆项目及其多金属结核项目，以及扩大了政府官员、行业利益相关者、研究人员和技术专家之间的接触。展望未来，美国和日本政府计划推进以下优先事项： 深化与美国和日本的接触行业利益相关者并在整个海底矿物供应链中建立值得信赖的商业伙伴关系；确保值得信赖的合作伙伴之间的处理能力，以减少供应链漏洞；保护敏感技术和专有信息；交流与深海勘探、海底测绘和资源表征、环境评估、缓解和监测、技术创新和资源开发相关的先进技术和方法的信息和最佳实践；探索促进科学理解的机会，例如协调船只、自主水下航行器和其他相关资产的访问和使用，以支持联合研究、技术演示和各自的美国项目。
和日本海底勘探活动；根据国家法律和政策，促进与最佳实践相关的监管交流，包括缓解和监测、技术进步、环境评估、数据管理和适应性管理；促进明确、精简和可预测的监管方法，促进海底矿物部门的私人投资；促进国内和国际监管制度之间的互补性，以支持商业可行性和行业的长期确定性；寻求更多伙伴关系，推进负责任的海底矿产资源开发。两国政府重申致力于政府整体协调和务实合作，调动两国互补的科学、技术、产业力量

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman Joint Statement on U.S.-Japan Seabed Mineral Resource Development Media Note November 12, 2026 The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America and Japan on the occasion of a visit to Japan by a U.S. interagency delegation focused on seabed minerals development. Begin Text. The Governments of the United States and Japan reaffirm that economic security cooperation is an indispensable part of the U.S.-Japan Alliance and that secure, resilient, and diversified critical mineral supply chains are essential to the prosperity and national security of both countries. The two governments recognize the potential for responsible seabed mineral resource development to diversify critical mineral supplies, create new commercial opportunities, and support the two countries’ industrial bases. This cooperation builds on the shared objectives set out in the United States-Japan Framework for Securing the Supply of Critical Minerals and Rare Earths through Mining and Processing, signed by President Trump and Prime Minister Takaichi in October 2025, and is being advanced through U.S.-Japan bilateral initiatives, including the Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) between the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry signed in March 2026. The two governments welcomed progress under the MoC, including the second meeting of the U.S.-Japan Working Group on November 11 and 12 in Toyama, Japan, which included discussions on Japan’s rare-earth mud project near Minamitorishima Island and its polymetallic nodules project, as well as expanded engagement among government officials, industry stakeholders, researchers, and technical experts. Looking ahead, the Governments of the United States and Japan plan to advance the following priorities: Deepen engagement with U.S. and Japanese industry stakeholders and foster trusted commercial partnerships across the full seabed mineral supply chain; Secure processing capacity among trusted partners to reduce supply chain vulnerabilities; Safeguard sensitive technologies and proprietary information; Exchange information and best practices on advanced technologies and methodologies related to deep-sea exploration, seabed mapping and resource characterization, environmental assessment, mitigation and monitoring, technological innovation, and resource development; Explore opportunities to advance scientific understanding such as coordinating access to, and use of, vessels, autonomous underwater vehicles, and other relevant assets in support of joint research, technology demonstrations, and respective U.S. and Japanese seabed exploration campaigns; Facilitate regulatory exchanges related to best practices, including for mitigation and monitoring, technological advancements, environmental assessments, data management, and adaptive management, consistent with national laws and policies; Promote clear, streamlined, and predictable regulatory approaches that facilitate private investment in the seabed minerals sector; Promote complementarity between domestic and international regulatory regimes to support commercial viability and long-term certainty for industry; and Seek additional partnerships to advance responsible seabed mineral resource development. The two governments reaffirm their commitment to whole-of-government coordination and practical cooperation that mobilizes their complementary scientific, technological, industrial, diplomatic, and financial strengths. They intend to support commercial opportunities, encourage private-sector investment, and foster trusted partnerships across mineral supply chains to accelerate responsible seabed mineral resource development, strengthen critical mineral security, and advance the shared economic security of the United States and Japan. End Text.

title: Nemaska pause clouds Rio Tinto’s Quebec lithium plans
zh_title: 内马斯卡暂停令力拓魁北克锂计划蒙上阴影
source: MINING.COM 全球矿业（稀土/关键矿产）
summary: 据《蒙特利尔日报》报道，力拓（LSE、ASX、NYSE：RIO）位于魁北克的 Nemaska 锂工厂的建设计划将在 2027 年之前暂停，这使其计划于 2028 年开工受到质疑。该报援引公司信函报道称，员工周三被告知，工作可能会在 2028 年恢复，尽管这一消息尚未得到证实。魁北克省经济发展部长办公室在早些时候的报告中确认，截至 12 月的裁员人数为 68 人。 “这一决定并不反映力拓或内马斯卡锂业董事会承诺的任何减少，”力拓在放慢速度时表示。
content:
据《蒙特利尔日报》报道，力拓（LSE、ASX、NYSE：RIO）位于魁北克的 Nemaska 锂工厂的建设计划将在 2027 年之前暂停，这使其计划于 2028 年开工受到质疑。该报援引公司信函报道称，员工周三被告知，工作可能会在 2028 年恢复，尽管这一消息尚未得到证实。魁北克省经济发展部长办公室在早些时候的报告中确认，截至 12 月的裁员人数为 68 人。 “这一决定并不反映力拓或 Nemaska Lithium 董事会承诺的任何减少，”力拓在 3 月份放慢建设速度时表示。据该报报道，较长的停顿引发了人们对魁北克省投入该项目的 12 亿加元（合 8.46 亿美元）公共资金回报率的质疑。 3月份该工厂已完成70%以上，当时力拓表示预计总体时间表不会发生重大变化。资金压力贝坎库尔项目是魁北克尝试建立电池供应链的一部分，该供应链将当地开采的矿物转化为更高价值的材料。贝坎库尔位于蒙特利尔东北约 150 公里处，与三河市隔圣劳伦斯河相望。力拓在 2 月份将其持股比例增至 54% 后取得了直接管理控制权。魁北克省通过魁北克投资局持有剩余 46% 的股份。当时，魁北克承诺追加高达2亿美元的股权，力拓承诺在2026年为其魁北克锂业务提供超过3亿美元的资金。
该省将其贡献描述为最终投资，并表示力拓已承诺在 2028 年将该工厂投入使用。最新报道的暂停将使之前预定的首次生产年份的建设重启变得不确定。锂暴跌 BMO 周四援引 Fastmarkets 的消息称，亚洲碳酸锂现货价格已从 5 月份的每公斤 25 美元以上跌至每公斤 12.90 美元。 BMO表示，需求增长疲软以及非洲和中国供应不断扩大给市场带来压力。力拓还在审查该工厂锂辉石的长期供应，锂辉石是一种用于制造氢氧化锂的含锂矿物。该公司一直在评估 Nemaska 的 Whabouchi 项目及其全资拥有的 Galaxy 项目，以确定最佳来源。 2月份，力拓预计供应审查将在今年上半年完成。 BMO周四表示，这两个项目之间的选择仍未解决。周四上午，力拓股价在纽约证券交易所交易中下跌 1.51%，至 83.72 美元，该公司估值约为 1,360 亿美元。去年该股的价格区间为 68.70 美元至 112.58 美元。

【原文 English Original】
Construction of Rio Tinto ’s (LSE, ASX, NYSE: RIO) Nemaska lithium plant in Quebec is set to remain on hold through 2027, putting its planned 2028 start in doubt, according to Le Journal de Montréal. Employees were told Wednesday that work could resume in 2028, although that was unconfirmed, the newspaper reported , citing a company letter. Quebec’s economic development minister’s office had confirmed 68 layoffs extending through December in earlier reporting. “This decision does not reflect any reduction in commitment from Rio Tinto or from the Board of Nemaska Lithium,” Rio said when it slowed construction in March. The longer pause raises questions about the return on C$1.2 billion ($846 million) of public funding that Quebec has put into the venture, according to the newspaper. The plant was more than 70% complete in March, when Rio said it did not foresee major changes to the overall timetable. Funding pressure The Bécancour project forms part of Quebec’s attempt to build a battery supply chain that converts locally mined minerals into higher-value materials. Bécancour lies about 150 km northeast of Montreal, across the St. Lawrence River from Trois-Rivières. Rio took direct management control in February after increasing its interest to 54%. Quebec holds the remaining 46% through Investissement Québec. At the time, Quebec committed up to $200 million in additional equity and Rio pledged more than $300 million for its Quebec lithium business during 2026. The province described its contribution as its final investment and said Rio had committed to bringing the plant into service in 2028. The latest reported pause would leave the construction restart uncertain in the very year previously targeted for first production. Lithium slump Lithium carbonate spot prices in Asia have fallen to $12.90 per kilogram from more than $25 in May, BMO said Thursday, citing Fastmarkets. Weak demand growth and expanding supply from Africa and China have weighed on the market, BMO said. Rio is also reviewing the plant’s long-term supply of spodumene, the lithium-bearing mineral used to make lithium hydroxide. The company has been assessing Nemaska’s Whabouchi project and its wholly owned Galaxy project to determine the best source. In February, Rio expected that supply review to be finished in the first half of the year. BMO said Thursday that the choice between the two projects remained unresolved. Rio shares dropped 1.51% Thursday morning to $83.72 in NYSE trading, valuing the company at about $136 billion. The stock has ranged between $68.70 and $112.58 in the past year.

title: Titan, US military team up on graphite

source: MINING.COM 全球矿业（稀土/关键矿产）

content:
Titan Mining（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TII；多伦多证券交易所股票代码：TI）正致力于成为 70 年来美国第一家商业石墨生产商，同时寻求与陆军达成历史性协议，在阿拉巴马州基地建立石墨加工厂。根据拟议的交易，泰坦将把石墨精矿从其主要的基尔伯恩矿场和纽约州北部的示范工厂运送到安尼斯顿陆军仓库，泰坦的帝国矿业子公司将在那里利用一些现有的基础设施进一步加工石墨。该仓库位于阿拉巴马州首府蒙哥马利东北约145公里处。 Titan 首席执行官丽塔·阿迪亚尼 (Rita Adiani) 在 10 月份接受《北方矿工》采访时表示：“能够生产精矿真是太好了，但除非你能进一步精炼，否则你最终会面临同样的情况，即基本上将中游出口回中国或其他地方。” “这使我们能够有效地在国内生产端到端产品，从供应链安全的角度来看，这非常重要。”  政府与行业动力 6 月份，根据美国陆军战略资本计划 (SCI) 计划，该基地合作伙伴关系标志着政府、军方和工业界之间的重大合作，因为美国越来越多地寻求将关键矿产供应链置于国内控制之下并摆脱中国的影响。
在正在考虑的三个陆军基地中，包括纽约的德拉姆堡和阿肯色州的派恩布拉夫兵工厂，泰坦的安尼斯顿基地交易已进展为商业条款清单，尽管最终的租约尚未完成。安尼斯顿的租约涵盖最初的 50 年，以及两个额外的 25 年续约选项。根据 SCI 计划入选的其他公司包括 REalloys (纳斯达克股票代码：ALOY) 和 Ioneer (ASX: INR)，它们获得了有条件租赁合同，分别在犹他州 Tooele Army Depot 开发单独的重稀土和硼加工设施；私人公司 EnergyX 拥有德克萨斯州红河基地一座锂工厂的有条件租赁权。 13 年使用寿命 根据 2025 年起的初步经济评估 (PEA)，Kilbourne 在 13 年使用寿命内每年可按铭牌产能生产约 40,000 吨石墨精矿。Titan 于 1 月份开始在 Kilbourne 生产，并已向客户运送了至少 1,600 公斤石墨精矿。按 7% 折现，其税后净现值为 5.13 亿美元，税后内部收益率为 37%，初始成本为 1.56 亿美元。根据 2024 年的初步估计，PEA 基于 2240 万吨品位为 2.91% 的石墨碳 (Cg) 推断，其中露天有限资源中含有 653,000 短吨石墨。综合采矿和加工业务的可行性研究正在进行中，预计将于 2027 年上半年发布。
泰坦还通过位于纽约市西北约 480 公里处的基尔本的帝国州矿山生产锌。阿迪亚尼表示，虽然基尔本周边地区有一些工业基地可以与泰坦的下游加工愿景兼容，但纽约的许可时间相对较长。此外，获得下游设施的许可需要靠近安尼斯顿基地拥有的废水处理厂。 “[其]废水处理设施有效地用于弹药清洗，”阿迪亚尼说。 “这从允许的角度推动事情向前发展，并且让你更容易

【原文 English Original】
Titan Mining (NYSE-A: TII; TSX: TI) is working to become the first commercial graphite producer in the United States in 70 years while pursuing an historic agreement with the Army to set up a graphite processing plant on a base in Alabama.   The proposed deal would see Titan ship graphite concentrate from its main Kilbourne mine and demonstration plant in upstate New York to the Anniston Army Depot, where Titan’s Empire Mines subsidiary would further process the graphite using some existing infrastructure. The depot is about 145 km northeast of Alabama state capital Montgomery.   “It’s great to be able to produce a concentrate, but unless you can refine it down further, you end up facing that same situation where you’re basically exporting the midstream back to China or somewhere else,” Titan CEO Rita Adiani told The Northern Miner in an October interview.   “This allows us to effectively get to an end-to-end product domestically, which is pretty significant from a supply chain security standpoint.”  Government-industry momentum   Selected under the U.S. Army’s Strategic Capital Initiatives (SCI) program in June, the base partnership marks significant cooperation between the government, military and industry as the U.S. increasingly seeks to bring critical mineral supply chains under domestic control and outside the influence of China.   Of the three Army bases under consideration, including Fort Drum in New York and Pine Bluff Arsenal in Arkansas, Titan’s Anniston base deal has progressed to a commercial term sheet, although a definitive lease remains outstanding. The Anniston lease covers an initial 50 years with two additional 25-year renewal options.  The other companies selected under the SCI program include REalloys (Nasdaq: ALOY) and Ioneer (ASX: INR), which received conditional lease awards to develop separate heavy rare earth and boron processing facilities, respectively, at Tooele Army Depot in Utah; and private firm EnergyX, which has a conditional lease for a lithium plant at the Red River base in Texas.   13-year life   Kilbourne could produce about 40,000 tonnes of graphite concentrate annually at nameplate capacity over a 13-year life, according to a preliminary economic assessment (PEA) from 2025. Titan began production at Kilbourne in January and has shipped at least 1,600 kg of graphite concentrate to customers.   Discounted at 7%, it has a post-tax net present value of $513 million, a post-tax internal rate of return of 37% and initial costs of $156 million.  The PEA is based on 22.4 million inferred tons grading 2.91% graphitic carbon (Cg), containing 653,000 short tons of graphite in open-pit constrained resources, according to a 2024 initial estimate. A feasibility study is under way for the integrated mining and processing operation, expected to be released in the first half of 2027.  Titan also produces zinc through Empire State Mines at Kilbourne, about 480 km northwest of New York City.  Army base advantages   While there are some industrial sites in the region around Kilbourne that could be compatible with Titan’s downstream processing vision, New York’s permitting timelines are relatively long, Adiani said. As well, permitting a downstream facility requires close access to a wastewater treatment plant, which the Anniston base has.   “[Its] wastewater treatment facility is effectively used for ammunition cleaning,” Adiani said. “That moves things forward from a permitting standpoint, and it makes it easy for us to plug and play into that infrastructure. It ends up saving us a lot of capex and operating costs.”  The timeline to production for the Kilbourne-Anniston supply chain starts with the feasibility study, followed by an investment decision and permits before the end of 2027, Adiani said. Construction would take about 15 months, with production starting in 2028 or 2029.   Fine processing at Anniston   Kilbourne’s graphite concentrate and micronized graphite concentrate would be shipped to Anniston for producing purified micronized graphite (PMG) and then coated spherical purified graphite (CSPG), highly purified graphite that is shaped into tiny particles and used in anodes for lithium batteries.   Initial production of PMG is pegged at 10,000 tons and could start around 2029, Adiani said. Titan is still determining if it would come from Kilbourne or Anniston. A few years later, CSPG output would start from Anniston, ramping up to 20,000 tons.   Kilbourne is also covered by the U.S. government’s FAST-41 permitting program, intended to improve coordination and transparency for major infrastructure projects.  Army’s 10% share   Under Titan’s agreement, the Army has a right of first offer to buy up to 10% of annual PMG and CSPG output. Other potential graphite customers include refractory supplier RHI Magnesita and an unnamed U.S. aerospace and defence manufacturer.   Titan could invest between $30 million and $70 million in the Anniston plant, Adiani said. The U.S. Export-Import Bank has separately proposed up to $120 million in construction financing for Kilbourne and agreed to provide $5.5 million for feasibility work.  Market catch-up   Despite the recent positive developments, Titan’s share price is about 30% over the past year. The stock traded at C$2.74 apiece in Toronto on Thursday, giving the company a market capitalization of C$271.3 million ($190 million). The stock has traded in a 12-month range of C$2.55 to C$7.75.  “The key thing people should remember is that until two years ago Titan traded at 30 cents,” Adiani said. “That 654% increase in two years is not going to be sustained.”  Investors want to see how Titan is de-risking its operations by completing the Kilbourne feasibility study, organizing offtake deals and completing the financing with U.S. EXIM, Adiani suggests.  “There are some key catalysts due for later this year and early next year, which will provide that momentum and sustaining back to those levels.”

title: President Trump says Apple’s Tim Cook is the only man to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示，苹果公司的蒂姆·库克是唯一接替黄仁勋出任英伟达首席执行官的人
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，因婚外情被曝光，黄仁勋已辞职
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，黄仁勋因与一名涉嫌中国情报人员的 Megaspeed 高管发生婚外情以及与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生婚外情而辞职。执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将在公司寻找替代者期间担任临时首席执行官。当然，潜在的继任者候选人的名字已经浮出水面，其中包括苹果首席硬件官约翰尼·斯鲁吉(Johny Srouji)。由于英伟达处于全球人工智能爆发的中心，黄仁勋和特朗普的关系密切，经常成为新闻头条。特朗普此前曾形容黄仁勋对于关税和废除拜登总统的人工智能扩散规则的看法“非常有远见”。正在发生的黄事件丑闻中提到了特朗普总统的名字。值得注意的是，据称，虽然美国
情报认为黄仁勋是中国蜜罐行动的目标，有报道称特朗普总统已听取了此事的简报，但选择不对这些信息采取任何行动，以免影响英伟达的销售或与中国对抗。国会已传唤黄仁勋出席中共特别委员会，议员们威胁如果黄仁勋不同意自愿参加闭门会议，将向他发出传票。蒂姆·库克目前担任苹果公司董事会执行主席，曾于 2011 年至 2026 年担任该公司首席执行官。在他任职期间，他负责监督 Apple Music 和 Apple TV 等众多 Apple 服务的推出，同时扩展到 Apple Watch 和 AirPods 等新产品类别。周三开盘时，英伟达股价暴跌超过 10 个百分点，但由于交易员希望利用英伟达股价下跌的机会，该公司股价收复了大部分失地。该公司将于下周（即 11 月 17 日星期二）公布 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩。

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump has said that retired Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, just hours after it was announced that the latter had resigned in the wake of a series of scandals. Taking to his Truth Social platform, the President said , "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP." Nvidia's board of directors announced on Wednesday that Huang had resigned following the revelation that he conducted an extramarital affair with a Megaspeed executive suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset , and a further affair with Nvidia Vice President of Health Care, Kimberly Powell. Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will serve as Interim CEO while the company looks for a replacement. Naturally, names have been floated as potential successor candidates, including Apple's Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji. With Nvidia at the center of the global explosion in AI, Huang and Trump have enjoyed a close relationship that routinely makes news headlines. Trump previously described Huang as 'utterly visionary' in regard to his views on tariffs and rescinding President Biden's AI Diffusion Rule . President Trump's name has been mentioned in the ongoing Huang affair scandal. Notably, it is alleged that while U.S. intelligence believed that Huang had been the target of a Chinese honeypot operation , reports claim that President Trump was briefed on the matter but chose not to do anything with the information, so as not to affect Nvidia's sales or antagonize China. Congress has summoned Jensen Huang to appear before the Select Committee on the CCP , with lawmakers threatening to issue Huang with a subpoena if he doesn't agree to attend a closed-door meeting voluntarily. Tim Cook is currently the Executive Chair of Apple's board, having served as the company's CEO from 2011 to 2026. During his tenure, he oversaw the launch of a plethora of Apple services, including Apple Music and Apple TV, while expanding into new product categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods. Nvidia's share price plunged more than 10 percentage points at the open on Wednesday, but recovered much of that ground as traders looked to take advantage of the dip in Nvidia's share price. The company will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results next week, on Tuesday, November 17.

title: Elon Musk says it ‘would be an honor’ to hire ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
zh_title: 埃隆·马斯克表示，能够聘请被罢免的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋“将是一种荣幸”
summary: 黄仁勋在情报来源披露他与一名疑似中国间谍的关系两周后，以及他与英伟达副总裁的恋情曝光一天后，辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。但在此举之前几个小时，当有传言称 Nvidia 董事会计划将他驱逐时，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 就已经表示愿意聘用这位 Nvidia 前首席执行官。一位随机的 X 用户发帖称，“埃隆请雇用詹森”，这位亿万富翁回答道：“那将是一种荣幸。” @zerohedge 这将是一种荣幸 2026 年 11 月 12 日，尽管詹森有丑闻
content:
黄仁勋在情报来源披露他与一名疑似中国间谍的关系两周后，以及他与英伟达副总裁的恋情曝光一天后，辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。但在此举之前几个小时，当有传言称 Nvidia 董事会计划将他驱逐时，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 就已经表示愿意聘用这位 Nvidia 前首席执行官。一位随机的 X 用户发帖称，“埃隆请雇用詹森”，这位亿万富翁回答道：“那将是一种荣幸。” @zerohedge 这将是一种荣誉，2026 年 11 月 12 日 尽管 Jensen 目前面临丑闻，但他仍然拥有工程专业知识、对行业及其内部运作的深入了解，再加上在世界各地的多重联系，这对于任何想要进入半导体行业的公司来说都是极其有价值的。这正是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在他的 Terafab 项目中所做的事情，他于 2025 年 11 月首次提到该项目。黄仁勋甚至警告说，这将是一个挑战，并指出“台积电谋生的工程、科学和艺术是极其困难的。”尽管如此，马斯克仍将资源投入到该项目中，Terafab 工厂的建设正如火如荼地进行，并计划在 2028 年下半年实现芯片量产。马斯克本人表示，该工厂的目标是到 2032 年实现每月 100 万片晶圆的产能。
特斯拉有着雄心勃勃的人工智能加速器路线图，SpaceX 甚至宣称在未来制造自己的 GPU。我们仍然不知道黄仁勋的计划是什么，但尽管他不再是 Nvidia 董事会及其领导层的成员，Jensen 和他的妻子 Lori 仍然通过各种信托和有限责任公司共同持有约 8 亿股 Nvidia 股票，而黄仁勋本人则拥有约 7000 万股 Nvidia 股票。除此之外，他仍然收到国会发出的讨论英伟达安全协议的邀请，如果他拒绝的话，这可能会变成传票，尽管我们不知道他的辞职会对闭门会议产生什么影响。据报道，FBI 正在调查他与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系，后者据称在向中国进口价值 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 过程中发挥了重要作用，并涉嫌与中国国家安全部合作。黄仁勋只是因与下属发生关系或外遇而辞职或被免职的高管名单中最新的一个。其中包括2005年的波音前首席执行官哈里·斯通西弗(Harry Stonecipher)、2010年的惠普首席执行官马克·赫德(Mark Hurd)、2018年的英特尔首席执行官布莱恩·科兹安尼克(Brian Krzanich)和2019年的前麦当劳首席执行官史蒂夫·伊斯特布鲁克(Steve Easterbrook)。
据了解，马斯克本人与多家公司的下属有过关系，他甚至通过试管受精与 2017 年开始在特斯拉工作的 Neuralink 高管 Shivon Zilis 生了四个孩子。目前尚不清楚马斯克的回复是否是对黄仁勋的认真报价。但如果这位前 Nvidia 首席执行官决定为 Musk 的 Terafab 项目工作，那么 Jensen 可以利用他的努力和专业知识，将其变成 Nvidia 的强大竞争对手。

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO two weeks after his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy was revealed by intelligence sources and a day after his affair with an Nvidia vice president became publicly known. But hours before this move, when it was just rumored that the Nvidia board was planning to oust him , Elon Musk had already stated his willingness to hire the former Nvidia chief on X . A random X user posted, “Elon please hire Jensen,” to which the billionaire replied, “That would be an honor.” @zerohedge That would be an honor November 12, 2026 Despite the scandals that Jensen is currently facing, he still has the engineering know-how, deep knowledge of the industry and its inner workings, plus multiple connections across the world, which would be extremely valuable for any company looking to break into the semiconductor industry. This is exactly what Elon Musk is doing with his Terafab project, which he first mentioned in November 2025 . Jensen Huang even warned that this was going to be a challenge, pointing out that “the engineering, the science, and the artistry of doing what TSMC does for a living is extremely hard.” Nevertheless, Musk poured his resources into the project, with construction on the Terafab facility in full swing and with plans to hit volume chip production by the second half of 2028 . Musk himself said that the site targets a production capacity of a million wafers a month by 2032. Tesla has an ambitious AI accelerator roadmap , and SpaceX has even touted making its own GPUs in the future . We still don’t know what Jensen Huang’s plans are, but even though he’s no longer a part of the Nvidia board and its leadership, Jensen and his wife, Lori, still jointly own approximately 800 million Nvidia shares through various trusts and LLCs, while Huang himself personally owns around 70 million Nvidia shares. Aside from that, he still has an outstanding invitation from Congress to discuss Nvidia’s security protocols, which could turn into a subpoena if he snubs them, although we don’t know how his resignation would affect the closed-door meeting. There’s also a reported FBI investigation into his relationship with Alice Huang , the Megaspeed executive who was allegedly instrumental in the import of $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI GPUs into China and is suspected of working with China’s Ministry of State Security . Jensen Huang is just the latest in the long list of executives who resigned or were ousted from their leadership position because of a relationship or an affair with a subordinate. This includes former Boeing CEO Harry Stonecipher in 2005, HP CEO Mark Hurd in 2010, Intel CEO Brian Krzanich in 2018, and former McDonald’s CEO Steve Easterbrook in 2019. Musk himself is known to have had relationships with subordinates from his various companies, and that he has even fathered four children with Shivon Zilis, a top executive at Neuralink who started working at Tesla in 2017, through IVF. It’s still not confirmed if Musk’s reply is a serious offer for Jensen Huang. But if the former Nvidia chief ever decides to work for Musk on his Terafab project, then Jensen could put his effort and expertise into turning it into a formidable competitor to Nvidia.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因多项事务和中国间谍指控而辞职
summary: 英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “Colette Kress，现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官
content:
英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意担任临时首席执行官。Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时担任临时首席执行官，直至任命永久继任者。董事会正在开始寻找永久首席执行官，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。”最近几周，有报道称黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系过于熟悉，美国情报机构怀疑黄可能是中国情报人员。据报道，这家 AI GPU 巨头的首席执行官可能成为间谍阴谋的目标——Megaspeed 因参与向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的出口管制 AI GPU 而受到调查。
消息传出后，英伟达股价在早盘交易中暴跌逾 10%，目前上个月跌幅超过 23%。 周末，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子不忠，并在全公司范围内道歉。另外，鉴于黄仁勋在全球人工智能革命中的作用，英伟达董事会对有关黄仁勋的卷入可能涉及国家安全问题的报道发起了独立调查。 Colette Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起担任 Nvidia 执行副总裁兼首席财务官；在此之前，她在思科和微软等公司工作了 25 年。几天后，第二个爆炸性报道出现，声称黄仁勋还与他在公司的直接下属之一鲍威尔有恋情。有报道称，这件事在公司内部是众所周知的，两人甚至被拍到在 Nvidia GTC 的圣何塞酒店里亲热。据称，安全人员隔离了一名旁观者，该旁观者用摄像机拍摄了整个互动过程，并要求该人签署一份保密协议。 Nvidia 还宣布 Harvey C. Jones 将担任公司首任董事会主席；他此前曾担任新思科技 (Synopsys) 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board of directors has confirmed today that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO. The news follows revelations that Huang had been involved in not one but two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another with his direct report, Nvidia’s VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. "NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," the board stated. "Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates." In recent weeks, stories have come to light alleging that Huang was involved in an overly familiar relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect may be a Chinese intelligence asset. It was reported that the AI GPU giant’s CEO may have been the target of a spy plot — Megaspeed is under investigatio n for its involvement in the smuggling of $2 billion worth of export-controlled AI GPUs into China. Nvidia shares plunged more than 10 percent in early market trading following the news, and are now down more than 23% in the last month. Over the weekend, Jensen Huang admitted that he had been unfaithful to his wife and issued a company-wide apology. Separately, Nvidia’s Board of Directors launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang’s entanglement may be a matter of national security, given his role in the global AI revolution. Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and CFO since September 2013; prior to that, she spent 25 years at Cisco and Microsoft, among others. Just a couple of days later, a second bombshell report emerged claiming that Jensen Huang was also romantically involved with Powell , one of his direct reports at the company. Reports indicate the affair was known within the company, and that the two were even filmed being affectionate in a San Jose hotel at Nvidia GTC. Security allegedly sequestered a bystander who filmed the interaction on camera and made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. Nvidia also announced that Harvey C. Jones will serve as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board; he has previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

title: Migrant worker activists push back against Hong Kong visa rejections over ‘job-hopping’
zh_title: 农民工活动人士反对香港因“跳槽”而拒绝签证
summary: 移民工人活动人士反对政府拒绝家庭佣工签证，担心他们有“跳槽”的历史，称工人有权寻求更好的工作条件。 2023 年 11 月 11 日，香港的外籍家庭佣工正在休息。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。亚洲移民协调机构（AMCB）周五在一份声明中表示，“谴责”移民局歧视工人并“恶意指责他们跳槽”。该组织是在劳工及福利局局长 C
content:
移民工人活动人士反对政府拒绝家庭佣工签证，担心他们有“跳槽”的历史，称工人有权寻求更好的工作条件。 2023 年 11 月 11 日，香港的外籍家庭佣工正在休息。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。亚洲移民协调机构（AMCB）周五在一份声明中表示，“谴责”移民局歧视工人并“恶意指责他们跳槽”。该组织做出回应之前，劳工及福利局局长孙宇晨周​​三表示，自 2024 年 1 月以来，政府已拒绝了 455 份家庭佣工的就业签证申请。2024 年和 2025 年，分别有 266 份和 93 份申请被拒绝。截至2026年10月，政府今年已拒绝了96份申请。孙在立法会会议上表示，移民局因怀疑工人“跳槽”而调查了 3,300 多份申请，其中包括这些申请。香港劳工及福利局局长孙宇晨于 2026 年 1 月 14 日出席第八届立法会第一次会议。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局将家政工跳槽定义为提前终止合同（法律规定期限为两年）以更换雇主。
“不人道的工作条件” 政府长期以来一直指责家政工跳槽，称他们被职业介绍所引诱，以现金奖励的承诺缩短合同并跳槽到新雇主。然而，农民工活动人士表示，这是不真实的，工人离开雇主有真正的理由。他们还表示，工人不会轻易做出换雇主的决定，因为他们需要飞回自己的祖国等待新签证。 AMCB 的声明中写道：“提前终止合同的大部分原因是不人道的工作条件、缺乏体面的住宿、没有定期休息日以及身体和精神虐待。” 2023 年 3 月 20 日，家政工人在劳工部外举行抗议。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 AMCB 发言人多洛雷斯·巴拉达雷斯 (Dolores Balladares) 表示：“寻求更好的工作条件并没有什么错。”孙周三表示，移民局于2013年成立了一个“特别职责小组”，以“加强对频繁更换雇主的[家政工人]的工作签证申请的评估。”近年来，被拒绝的签证申请数量持续下降。 2021 年，这一数字为 2,833 件，是去年拒绝数量的 30 多倍。
政府于 2024 年修订了就业机构的“业务守则”，要求各机构向那些寻找外籍家庭佣工工作的人介绍移民法规，并禁止他们“采取商业行为，例如向在职的[家庭佣工]提供金钱激励，以促使其提前终止雇佣合同。”孙在2024年底表示，“跳槽”情况“在政策干预下已明显改善”。

【原文 English Original】
Migrant worker activists have pushed back against the government’s rejection of domestic workers’ visas over concerns that they had a history of “job-hopping,” saying that workers have the right to seek better working conditions. Migrant domestic workers on their day off in Hong Kong, on November 11, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Asian Migrants Coordinating Body (AMCB) said in a statement on Friday that it “condemned” the Immigration Department for discriminating against workers and “maliciously accusing them of job-hopping.” The group’s response came after Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Wednesday that the government had rejected 455 employment visa applications from domestic workers since January 2024. In 2024 and 2025, 266 and 93 applications were rejected , respectively. As of October 2026, the government had rejected 96 applications this year. They were among more than 3,300 applications that the Immigration Department investigated due to suspicions that the workers had “job-hopped,” Sun said during the Legislative Council meeting. Hong Kong Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun attends the first meeting of the eighth Legislative Council (LegCo) on January 14, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities define domestic workers’ job-hopping as prematurely terminating their contracts – fixed under the law at two years – to change employers. ‘Inhumane working conditions’ The government has long accused domestic workers of job-hopping, saying that they are lured by employment agencies to cut short their contracts and switch to a new employer with the promise of cash incentives. Migrant worker activists, however, have said this is untrue, and that workers have genuine reasons when leaving their employers. They have also said that workers would not make the decision to change employers lightly, as they would need to fly back to their home country to await their new visa. “Most of the reasons for early termination of their contract are due to inhumane working conditions, lack of decent accommodation, no regular rest day, and physical and mental abuse,” the AMCB’s statement read. Domestic workers staging a protest outside the Labour Department on March 20, 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “There is nothing wrong with seeking better working conditions,” Dolores Balladares, an AMCB spokesperson, said. Sun said on Wednesday that the Immigration Department set up a “special duties team” in 2013 to “strengthen the assessment of employment visa applications from [domestic workers] who change employers frequently.” The number of rejected visa applications has fallen consistently in recent years. In 2021, the figure was 2,833 – more than 30 times the number of rejections last year. The government revised the “code of practice” for employment agencies in 2024, requiring agencies to brief those looking for foreign domestic worker jobs on immigration regulations, as well as barring them from “adopting business practices such as providing monetary incentives to [domestic workers] in employ to induce premature termination of employment contracts.” Sun said in late 2024 that the “job-hopping” situation had “significantly improved following policy interventions.”

title: All five defendants in San Po Kong subversion case intend to plead guilty, court hears
zh_title: 新蒲岗颠覆案五名被告均拟认罪
summary: 两名男子因涉嫌在新蒲岗一栋工业大楼进行非法武器训练而被捕，他们向香港法院表示，他们打算承认共谋颠覆罪。湾仔区域法院。资料图片：HKFP。据当地媒体报道，学生邓毅博和服务员陈晓俊周四在区域法院出庭。辩方告诉陈士丹法官，两人计划认罪。两人是去年 12 月被指控串谋颠覆罪的五名被告之一。所有五人现已在法庭上表示
content:
两名男子因涉嫌在新蒲岗一栋工业大楼进行非法武器训练而被捕，他们向香港法院表示，他们打算承认共谋颠覆罪。湾仔区域法院。资料图片：HKFP。据当地媒体报道，学生邓毅博和服务员陈晓俊周四在区域法院出庭。辩方告诉陈士丹法官，两人计划认罪。两人是去年 12 月被指控串谋颠覆罪的五名被告之一。五人现已在法庭上表示他们打算认罪。法官表示，五人定于明年 3 月 15 日一起提出抗辩。在此之前，他们将继续被还押。据当地媒体报道，十月份，另外三名被告——学生黄杰伦、保安彭嘉良和保安李俊森——告诉法庭，他们将承认颠覆罪指控。黄还被指控持有儿童色情制品。检方10月在法庭上表示，已与辩方达成认罪协议：在黄承认颠覆罪后，持有儿童色情制品的指控将被存档。去年 12 月，唐和陈被指控时均为 23 岁。李当时26岁，彭24岁，黄21岁。2024年10月1日，人们在香港历史博物馆观看有关国家安全的视频装置。
图片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。检方指称，2024年11月1日至2025年12月11日期间，五名被告伙同及伙同其他不明人士，组织、策划、实施或参与以武力或以武力相威胁的行为，以颠覆国家政权、推翻香港特别行政区权力机构。根据第二十三条逮捕 这五人是去年12月11日和12月12日被捕的10人之一。警司周学贤表示，警方于 12 月 11 日持法院搜查令突击搜查新蒲岗工业大厦的一个单位，发现里面有 6 名男子，其中一名正在为其他人进行战斗训练。周说，警方缴获了五支气步枪、两支气手枪、五把军刀和一把长剑的仿制品，以及带有反政府标语的物品。他用粤语说：“此外，我们还发现了疑似爆炸物。”他补充说，警方爆炸品处理科正在检查这些物品。警方其后在大埔及油麻地拘捕另外三名男子。 12月12日，他们逮捕了一名妇女。所有这些人都是根据《维护国家安全条例》中的“非法钻探”条款被捕的，该条例是该市当地制定的安全立法，称为第 23 条。其中五人后来被指控串谋颠覆国家政权。

【原文 English Original】
Two men have told a Hong Kong court that they intend to plead guilty to conspiracy to commit subversion after they were arrested on suspicion of illegal weapons training in an industrial building in San Po Kong. District Court in Wan Chai. File photo: HKFP. Student Tang Ngai-pok and waiter Chan Hiu-chun appeared at the District Court on Thursday, local media reported . The defence told Judge Stanley Chan that the duo planned to plead guilty to the charges. The two are among five defendants who were charged with conspiracy to commit subversion last December. All five have now stated in court that they intend to plead guilty. The judge said the five were set to enter their pleas together on March 15 next year. They will remain remanded in custody until then. In October, the other three defendants – student Wong Kit-lun, security guard Gallian Pang and security guard Lee Chun-sum – told the court that they would plead guilty to the subversion charges, local media reported . Wong was also charged with possession of child pornography. The prosecution said in court in October that a plea bargain had been reached with the defence: after Wong pleaded guilty to subversion, the charge of possession of child pornography would be left on file. Tang and Chan were both 23 years old when they were charged last December. Lee was 26 at the time, while Pang was 24 and Wong was 21. People watch a video installation on national security in the Hong Kong Museum of History, on October 1, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The prosecution alleged that between November 1, 2024 and December 11, 2025, the five defendants conspired together and with other persons unknown to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by force or threat of force with a view to subverting state power and overthrowing the body of power of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Arrests under Article 23 The five were among a group of 10 people who were arrested on December 11 and December 12 last year. Superintendent Chow Hok-yin said that officers raided a unit at the San Po Kong industrial building on December 11 with a court warrant and found six men inside, one providing combat training to the others. Officers seized five air rifles, two air pistols, replicas of five military knives and a long sword, as well as items bearing anti-government slogans, Chow said. “Additionally, we found objects suspected to be explosives,” he said in Cantonese, adding that the objects were being examined by the force’s Explosive Ordnance Disposal Bureau. Police later arrested another three men in Tai Po and Yau Ma Tei. On December 12, they arrested a woman. All of them were arrested under the “unlawful drilling” provision of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, the city’s locally enacted security legislation known as Article 23. Five were later charged with conspiracy to commit subversion.

title: Hong Kong Judiciary issues binding rules making litigation ‘last resort’ for Wang Fuk Court fire claims
zh_title: 香港司法机构发布具有约束力的规则，使诉讼成为宏福法院火灾索赔的“最后手段”
summary: 香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到时间、成本和不确定性
content:
香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到诉讼所涉及的时间、成本和不确定性，”它表示，首先通过和解或调解解决索赔将符合当事人和公众的利益，而诉讼是最后的手段。声明称，新规则以两套“特别实践说明”的形式立即生效。 “最后手段” 据司法机构称，实践指引旨在“确保司法资源的公平和按比例分配，同时不损害当事人诉诸法庭和公平审判的权利”。宏福苑火灾引起的索赔应首先通过和解方式解决，否则各方应采取调解等其他争议解决方式。它说，诉讼只能是“最后的手段”。
在谈判和争议解决过程中，“当事人应尽最大努力，做出真诚和善意的努力”，而“当且仅当”这些努力未能解决争议时，才应提起诉讼。司法机构。照片：何凯莉/HKFP。当事人还必须向法院解释调解失败的原因以及仍然存在的争议点。如果一方绕过调解而直接向区域法院或高等法院原讼法庭提出申索，法院可将诉讼程序搁置最多六个月，以便双方尝试调解。至于雇员补偿索偿及小额钱债审裁处的案件，诉讼程序也可能会押后约四个月，以方便和解或调解。如果这些解决方案尝试不成功，则将在未来六到九个月内安排针对员工赔偿的听证会，并在四个月内针对小额索赔法庭安排听证会。香港大律师公会调解委员会主席凌俊伟向《明报》表示，虽然操作指引提出了新要求，但“不会阻止你提起诉讼”。他还表示，值得考虑诉讼权利是否受到影响，同时指出新要求并没有过度限制，并指出根据标准民事审判程序至少需要等待六个月才能安排听证会日期。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s Judiciary has issued a set of binding procedural rules requiring former residents of the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court to exhaust other options for compensation before formally filing civil claims at the city’s courts as a “last resort.” Wang Fuk Court on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam. The Judiciary said in a Thursday statement that “a large number of claims involving complex issues and substantial sums may soon be brought before the courts” owing to the “extensive casualties and severe damage” caused by the deadly blaze last November. “Bearing in mind the time, costs and uncertainties involved in litigation,” it said that resolving claims initially through settlement or mediation would serve the interests of the parties and the public, with litigation as a last resort. The new rules, taking the form of two sets of “Special Practice Notes,” have taken immediate effect, according to the statement. ‘Last resort’ According to the Judiciary, the practice notes intend “to ensure a fair and proportionate distribution of judicial resources without impairing the parties’ right to access to court and a fair trial.” It said that claims arising from the Wang Fuk Court fire should be resolved first by settlement, failing which parties should proceed with alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation. Litigation should only be a “last resort,” it said. “The parties shall use their best endeavours and make genuine and bona fide efforts” in the negotiation and dispute resolution processes, while litigation should be commenced “if and only if” those efforts failed to resolve the dispute. The Judiciary. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Parties must also explain to the court their reasons for failed mediation and the points of dispute that remain. If a party bypasses mediation and files a claim directly with the District Court or the Court of First Instance of the High Court, the court may put proceedings on hold for up to six months to allow the parties to attempt mediation. For Employees’ Compensation claims and cases in the Small Claims Tribunal, proceedings may also be adjourned for about four months to facilitate settlement or mediation. If those resolution attempts are unsuccessful, hearings will be scheduled within the next six to nine months for Employees’ Compensation and within four months for the Small Claims Tribunal. Chairman of the Hong Kong Bar Association’s Committee on Mediation Ling Chun-wai told Ming Pao that while the practice notes impose new requirements, they “will not stop you from litigating.” He was also quoted as saying that it was worth considering whether the right to litigate had been affected, while noting that the new requirements were not overly restrictive, pointing to the wait of at least six months to have a hearing date scheduled under standard civil trial procedures.

title: Hong Kong probe uncovers ‘deficiencies,’ possible illegal acts in Queen Mary Hospital lift scandal
zh_title: 香港调查发现玛丽医院升降机丑闻中的“缺陷”和可能存在的非法行为
summary: 一项调查发现，参与玛丽医院新临床大楼电梯丑闻的承包商、分包商、顾问和专业人士都存在“缺陷”，可能存在违法行为，而两个政府部门也存在监督失误。玛丽皇后医院。照片：香港政府一站通。发展局周四晚间向立法会提交了一份长达116页的报告，内容涉及因建筑工程失误导致玛丽医院新大楼电梯井倾斜。该问题已导致 230 多起电梯故障报告
content:
一项调查发现，参与玛丽医院新临床大楼电梯丑闻的承包商、分包商、顾问和专业人士都存在“缺陷”，可能存在违法行为，而两个政府部门也存在监督失误。玛丽皇后医院。照片：香港政府一站通。发展局周四晚间向立法会提交了一份长达116页的报告，内容涉及因建筑工程失误导致玛丽医院新大楼电梯井倾斜。 2025 年 9 月至 2026 年 1 月期间，该问题已导致 230 多起电梯故障报告，直到 8 月媒体报道后才被曝光。报告指出，电梯故障频发的四大主要原因，包括电梯井道尺寸、垂直度、导轨“不符”、轿厢不平衡以及安装工艺“不理想”等。调查发现，这栋32层建筑中，4个电梯井道的差异“比较严重”，差异范围在62至82毫米之间。发展局在向立法会提交的文件中表示：“综上所述，28部升降机均出现不同程度的问题，导致升降机轿厢运作不顺畅，需要暂停服务以跟进问题。”
可能存在的违法行为 报告指出，该项目涉及的各方均应对这些故障负责，其中主承包商安博工程公司“对电梯井道施工的不准确负有全部责任”。分包商安力电梯未能按照法律要求正确安装导轨和轿厢，其工程师在颁发安全证书之前也没有对电梯工程进行“彻底检查”。报告称，被任命监督和签署该项目各个部分的多名专业人员也未能正确履行职责。香港发展局局长林贝尔纳黛特于 2026 年 1 月 14 日在立法会发表讲话。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。发展局表示，有关部门将对有过错的当事人进行处罚。该局表示：“根据缺陷的严重程度，惩罚措施可能包括暂停投标资格、降级或取消资格。”该局还表示，调查显示该丑闻可能涉及违法行为，但没有详细说明。该局补充说，执法部门将进一步调查这一事件。政府缺陷 报告还点名建筑署和机电工程署在监督工程项目和发放升降机使用许可证方面存在缺陷。
报告称，ASD 没有严格遵循内部准则，在 2025 年 1 月为新临床区颁发了竣工证书，当时电梯尚未获得使用许可证。 至少 10 名 ASD 工作人员在丑闻中存在“不同程度的缺陷”，目前正在根据《公务员条例》接受纪律处分。报告称，与此同时，机电署依赖注册电梯承包商，在现场检查期间仅检查了有限的稳定性和操作问题。该部门将就此事向相关人员发出咨询信。多位议员对当局的 SC 提出批评

【原文 English Original】
The contractor, subcontractor, consultants and professionals involved in the lift scandal at Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical block displayed “deficiencies” and may have committed illegal acts, while two government departments also exhibited oversight lapses, an investigation has found. Queen Mary Hospital. Photo: GovHK. The Development Bureau submitted a 116-page report to the Legislative Council on Thursday night regarding the faulty construction work that resulted in tilted lift shafts at Queen Mary Hospital’s new building. The problem had led to over 230 reports of elevator failures between September 2025 and January 2026 and only came to light in August following media reports. The report identified four main causes of the frequent lift malfunctions, including “discrepancies” in lift shaft dimensions and verticality as well as in the lifts’ guide rails, imbalanced lift cars, and “unsatisfactory” installation workmanship. Discrepancies in four lift shafts were “comparatively serious” and in the range of 62 to 82 millimetres in the 32-storey building, the investigation found. “In summary, all the 28 lifts have problems of varying severity which have led to the lift cars not operating smoothly, thus requiring temporary suspension of service for following up the problems,” the Development Bureau said in a paper submitted to LegCo. Possible illegal acts The report identified various parties involved in the project as responsible for the faults, with Able Engineering, the main contractor, bearing the “sole responsibility for the inaccuracy in the lift shaft construction.” Subcontractor Anlev Elex Elevator failed to properly install the guide rails and lift cars as required by law, and its engineers did not conduct “thorough examination” of the lift works before issuing safety certificates. A number of professionals appointed to oversee and sign off various parts of the project also failed to properly conduct their duties, the report said. Hong Kong Development Secretary Bernadette Linn addresses the Legislative Council on January 14, 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities will impose penalties against the parties at fault, the Development Bureau said. “Depending on the severity of the deficiencies, the punitive actions may include suspension of eligibility to tender, downgrading, or removal,” the bureau said. The bureau also said that the investigation revealed that the scandal may involve illegal acts, without elaborating. Law enforcement agencies will further investigate the incident, the bureau added. Government deficiencies The report also named the Architectural Services Department (ASD) and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) as having deficiencies in their oversight of the project and the issuing of lift use permits. The ASD had not strictly followed internal guidelines and issued the Certificate of Completion for the new clinical block in January 2025, when the lifts had yet to be granted use permits, the report said. At least 10 ASD staff members had “deficiencies of varying degrees” in the scandal and are now subject to disciplinary proceedings under the Civil Service Regulations. Meanwhile, the EMSD had relied on registered lift contractors and only examined a limited set of stability and operational issues during on-site inspections, the report said. The department will issue advisory letters to relevant personnel over the matter. Multiple lawmakers levelled criticism at the authorities for the scandal during a LegCo panel meeting on Friday. Jody Kwok of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong called the incident “unbelievable,” while Mark Chong of Roundtable said it was serious that the current oversight mechanism failed to spot the issue early on. But Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn defended the system, saying that the incident only involved “executional shortcomings” by individual government employees. Lawmaker Rebecca Chan also criticised the government’s late disclosure of the incident, noting that the ASD was aware of various degrees of concrete scabbling work inside the lift shafts as early as February 2025. Linn said in response that the Development Bureau had not been aware of the exact causes of the frequent lift malfunctions when the media began reporting on the issue in August, and that it would have been “irresponsible” to disclose the matter at that stage and dampen public confidence in the new clinical block.

title: Trump says China bears ‘hatred’ for Hong Kong’s Jimmy Lai, casting doubt on his release
zh_title: 特朗普称中国对香港黎智英怀有“仇恨”，并对他的释放表示怀疑
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四表示，中国对香港民主派媒体大亨黎智英怀有“极大的仇恨”，不太可能释放他出狱。 2025 年 5 月 8 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在椭圆形办公室。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 78 岁的黎智英是现已不复存在的《苹果日报》创始人，2 月份在香港发生广泛的民主抗议活动后，因与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪被判处 20 年监禁。人权组织和外国政府呼吁释放黎智英，特朗普在 5 月表示
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四表示，中国对香港民主派媒体大亨黎智英怀有“极大的仇恨”，不太可能释放他出狱。 2025 年 5 月 8 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在椭圆形办公室。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 78 岁的黎智英是现已不复存在的《苹果日报》创始人，2 月份在香港发生广泛的民主抗议活动后，因与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪被判处 20 年监禁。人权组织和外国政府呼吁释放黎智英，特朗普五月表示，他此前曾与习近平主席讨论过此案。 “那里存在很大程度的仇恨，”特朗普在接受塞勒姆新闻频道采访时表示。 “习主席解释了香港发生的事情……黎智英是（民主运动）的领导人，这给他们带来了巨大的痛苦，”这位美国总统说。黎智英，2020 年。照片：HKFP。特朗普将于下周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织会议上与习近平会面。但美国总统对黎智英的释放前景并不乐观。 “我已经让其他人离开了。黎智英的情况有点不同，”特朗普说。在特朗普五月向习近平提出此事后，北京释放了地下教会创始人金以斯拉 (Ezra Jin)。然而，特朗普五月表示，黎智英对习近平来说是“一个难缠的人”。

【原文 English Original】
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that China harbours a “great level of hatred” towards Hong Kong’s pro-democracy media mogul Jimmy Lai and is unlikely to release him from jail. US President Donald Trump in the Oval Office on May 8, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Lai, the 78-year-old founder of the now-defunct Apple Daily newspaper, was sentenced in February to 20 years in prison on charges of foreign collusion and sedition following widespread pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong. Rights groups and foreign governments have called for Lai’s release, and Trump said in May that he had previously discussed the case with President Xi Jinping. “There’s a great level of hatred there,” Trump told Salem News Channel in an interview. “President Xi explained what happened with Hong Kong and… that Jimmy Lai was the leader (of the pro-democracy movement), and it caused them tremendous distress,” the US president said. Jimmy Lai in 2020. Photo: HKFP. Trump is due to meet Xi next week at the APEC gathering in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. But the US president was not optimistic about the prospect of Lai’s release. “I’ve gotten others out. Jimmy Lai’s a little bit of a different story,” Trump said. Beijing freed the founder of an underground church, Ezra Jin, after Trump raised his case with Xi in May. However, Trump said in May that Jimmy Lai is “a tough one” for Xi.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected China spy
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因涉嫌与中国间谍有染而辞职
summary: 人工智能热潮的皮夹克设计师黄仁勋周四辞去英伟达首席执行官一职，此前他的两起婚外情被曝光，其中包括一名被指控为中国从事间谍活动的女性。美国科技公司 Nvidia 联合创始人、总裁兼首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日在巴黎出席新闻发布会。照片：Joel Saget/法新社。该丑闻已经使英伟达的市值蒸发了近 5000 亿美元，因为它引发了国家安全担忧，并使人工智能行业陷入未知领域。首席财务官科尔
content:
人工智能热潮的皮夹克设计师黄仁勋周四辞去英伟达首席执行官一职，此前他的两起婚外情被曝光，其中包括一名被指控为中国从事间谍活动的女性。美国科技公司 Nvidia 联合创始人、总裁兼首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日在巴黎出席新闻发布会。照片：Joel Saget/法新社。该丑闻已经使英伟达的市值蒸发了近 5000 亿美元，因为它引发了国家安全担忧，并使人工智能行业陷入未知领域。首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将担任临时首席执行官，而英伟达董事会正在寻找继任者，从而结束黄仁勋执掌该公司 33 年的任期。 63 岁的黄也放弃了董事会席位。英伟达没有给出他离职的原因。黄仁勋是 2022 年 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 推出引发的热潮中的核心人物，Nvidia 的处理器曾经为视频游戏图形设计，现在成为构建 AI 模型的关键要素。他还是唐纳德·特朗普总统在人工智能方面的亲密非正式顾问，并花了数年时间游说反对限制向中国销售先进人工智能芯片。消息公布后，Nvidia 股价一度下跌 13%，随后将跌幅削减至 4% 左右，自周末以来该公司市值蒸发约 4500 亿美元。
投资银行约克维尔·艾夫斯 (Yorkville Ives) 的丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 称这是“英伟达和美国科技行业黑暗的一天”，但表示董事会已经做了需要做的事情：“撕掉创可贴，让英伟达在没有他的情况下进入下一个篇章。”董事会任命芯片设计软件公司新思科技(Synopsys)前首席执行官哈维·琼斯(Harvey Jones)为主席，并表示预计公司的运营和产品路线图“将不间断地继续下去”。临时首席执行官克雷斯 (Kress) 在思科和微软等公司工作了近 25 年，于 2013 年加入英伟达。在整个丑闻期间一直支持黄的特朗普表示，前苹果老板蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 应该接任。 2025 年 4 月 30 日星期三，在白宫十字厅举行的“投资美国”活动中，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统的注视下发表讲话。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 “传奇取代传奇！”特朗普在他的真相社交网络上说道。 “蒂姆·库克从乔布斯和其他人那里汲取了很多出色的想法和设计以及其他一切，他在相当短的时间内将其发展成为世界上最伟大的公司之一。我认为蒂姆·库克将是管理英伟达的绝佳候选人，”总统写道。根据该公司最新提交的文件，黄仁勋仍然是 Nvidia 最大的个人股东，持有约 3.6% 的股份。
对于硅谷的许多人来说，这次离职让人回想起史蒂夫·乔布斯 (Steve Jobs)，他于 1985 年被董事会赶出苹果公司，12 年后重返苹果，将公司带到了新的高度。 两起婚外情 与妻子 Lori 结婚 40 多年的黄在周日承认了与新加坡数据中心公司 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 的婚外情。两者没有关系。据报道，美国情报部门今年春天散发了一份备忘录，声称她是中国国家安全部的资产。北京否认了这些指控。新加坡周四表示，已禁止中国公民黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 在 2 月份再次入境新加坡，因为她向调查人员提供了有关她在 Megaspeed 职位的不准确信息。

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang, the leather-jacketed architect of the artificial intelligence boom, resigned as chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. Co-founder, President and CEO of US technology company Nvidia, Jensen Huang, looks on during a press briefing in Paris on October 13, 2026. Photo: Joel Saget/AFP. The scandal has wiped almost half a trillion dollars off Nvidia’s market capitalisation, as it  raises national security fears and leaves the AI industry in uncharted waters. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, will serve as interim CEO while Nvidia’s board searches for a successor, ending Huang’s 33 years at the helm of the company he co-founded. Huang, 63, also gave up his board seat. Nvidia did not give a reason for his departure. Huang was a central figure in the boom set off by the launch of OpenAI’s ChatGPT in 2022, with Nvidia’s processors, once designed for video game graphics, becoming the crucial ingredient for building AI models. He was also a close informal adviser to President Donald Trump on AI, and had spent years lobbying against curbs on sales of advanced AI chips to China. Nvidia shares fell as much as 13 percent following the announcement before paring losses to about four percent, wiping roughly $450 billion off the company’s value since the weekend. Dan Ives of investment bank Yorkville Ives called it “a dark day for Nvidia and the US tech industry,” but said the board had done what it needed to: “rip off the band-aid and take Nvidia into its next chapter without him.” The board named Harvey Jones, a former chief executive of chip design software firm Synopsys, as chair, and said it expected the company’s operations and product roadmap “to continue without interruption.” Interim CEO Kress joined Nvidia in 2013 after nearly 25 years at companies including Cisco and Microsoft. Trump, who had stood by Huang throughout the scandal, said former Apple boss Tim Cook should take over. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang delivers remarks as President Donald Trump looks on during an “Investing in America” event, Wednesday, April 30, 2025, in the Cross Hall of the White House. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. “A Legend replaces a Legend!” Trump said on his Truth Social network. “Tim Cook took a lot of these brilliant ideas and designs and everything else from Jobs and others, and he made it into one of the great companies of the world at a fairly short range. I think Tim Cook would be a great candidate to run Nvidia,” wrote the president. Huang remains Nvidia’s largest individual shareholder, with a stake of about 3.6 percent, according to the company’s most recent filing. For many in Silicon Valley, the departure recalls that of Steve Jobs, who was pushed out of Apple by its board in 1985 and returned 12 years later to take the company to new heights. Two alleged affairs Huang, who has been married to his wife Lori for more than 40 years, admitted on Sunday to an affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former senior executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. The two are not related. US intelligence reportedly circulated a memo this spring alleging she was an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. Beijing has rejected the allegations. Singapore said Thursday it had barred Alice Huang, a Chinese national, from re-entering the country in February for giving investigators inaccurate information about her role at Megaspeed, though she was not investigated for espionage. Nvidia’s board opened a probe on Sunday into reporting that Huang had been the target of a “foreign intelligence effort,” while saying it retained confidence in him. Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. Photo: Nvidia. When asked Thursday if Jensen should have stepped down, Trump said it depended on whether the woman was indeed a Chinese spy. “If the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different,” Trump said in an interview with sports commentator Stephen A. Smith. But Trump said he was confident that Huang will “end up on his feet.” “I spoke to him yesterday. He’s going through hell. What he feels most badly about is his wife and family,” the president said. On Wednesday, The New York Times reported a second affair, citing video of Huang being affectionate with Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell. US-China tech race At the heart of the spy allegations is the race between the United States and China for supremacy in an industry widely seen as the next industrial revolution. Key US lawmakers, including Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer, called Thursday for answers on what the Trump administration knew about Huang’s ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, days before Trump travels to China for a summit. See also: Nvidia CEO affair revives push for tougher US line on China Reports allege the Commerce Department under Secretary Howard Lutnick may have failed to act on suspicions that Megaspeed was helping reroute restricted Nvidia technology to China. Singapore’s home ministry said it had repeatedly sought information from the US Justice Department and FBI on a US server supplier during its Megaspeed probe, but “received limited information or assistance.”

title: The New Six Frigates

content:
巴黎——一家英国公司藏在法国郊区会议中心的一个黑暗角落里，掌握着美国最新战舰的下一个设计方案。上周，在 2026 年欧洲海军大会上，巴布科克国际展台上的展示台上展示了​​ 31 型“箭头”号的模型。这是白宫设计的美国海军外国护卫舰竞赛的六个竞争者之一，目的是在美国掀起新一轮造船和投资浪潮。随着特朗普政府不断追求外国军舰设计和造船，在两年一度的会议上，几家欧洲防务公司急于讨论如果美国来敲门，他们可以在潜在的国际竞争中提出的选择。美国海军目前正在建造两艘护卫舰设计。一年前前海军部长约翰·费兰取消了该计划后，芬坎蒂尼马里内特海军陆战队仍在威斯康星州造船厂建造前两艘星座级护卫舰。与此同时，HII 的英格尔斯造船公司签订了一份长期合同，用于启动基于美国海岸警卫队国家安全巡逻舰的 FF(X) 护卫舰。据美国海军学院新闻了解，虽然美国海军几十年来一直未能成功推出护卫舰项目，但美国海军正在努力在未来几年内将外国设计用于新型舰艇。哈德逊研究所海军分析师布莱恩·克拉克表示，新护卫舰的工作要求已基本完成。
现在，海军优先考虑的是能够护航其他船只的护卫舰，而不是执行反潜战，这是现已取消的星座级计划的主要任务。克拉克表示，海军需要一个能够实施封锁并防御中层威胁的平台，就像美国中央司令部目前面临的中等威胁。 “一艘护卫舰可以防御我们所看到的来自伊朗的那种规模的威胁，”克拉克在欧洲海军之前告诉美国海军学院新闻。 “并不是真正的[反潜战]——更多的是执行这种海上控制、海上安全类型的任务。”为此，来自全球各地的六种设计已成为国际竞赛的潜在候选者，该竞赛将遵循唐纳德·特朗普总统在八月份的造船备忘录中所呼吁的设计。白宫文件呼吁海军推行所谓的“芬兰模式”，即在外国投资美国造船基础设施之前，可以在外国造船厂开始建造最多前两艘船体。白宫正在利用芬兰模式，在芬兰、德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州的造船厂建造两个独立的设计，以启动北极安全巡逻艇计划。白宫管理和预算办公室主任拉斯·沃特一直直言不讳地主张对小型水面作战舰艇和辅助舰艇使用相同的模型。
但国会抵制了这一努力，在众议院和参议院版本的《2027 财年国防授权法案》中都加入了草案，该法案将阻止海军购买外国建造的军舰。国会对购买海外辅助舰艇持更开放的态度。尽管遭到国会的抵制，八月的一份备忘录还是勾勒出了这场竞赛的蓝图——由国防部长皮特·赫格斯和代理海军部长曹洪制定。该计划将于周四向白宫提交。竞争者 Type 31 Babcock 图片 自 2023 年以来，Babcock 一直与美国领先者保持合作关系

【原文 English Original】
PARIS — Tucked in a dark corner of a convention center in the French suburbs, a British company could hold the next design for America’s newest warship. A model of the Type-31 Arrowhead sailed on a display table at the Babcock International booth at Euronaval 2026 last week. It was one of a half a dozen contenders for the U.S. Navy’s foreign frigate competition designed by the White House to jumpstart a new wave of shipbuilding and investment in the U.S. With the Trump administration’s ongoing pursuit of foreign warship design and shipbuilding, several European defense companies at the biennial conference were eager to discuss the options they could propose in a potential international competition should the U.S. come knocking at their doors. The U.S. Navy currently has two frigate designs under construction in the U.S. Fincantieri Marinette Marine is still building the first two Constellation-class frigates at its Wisconsin yard after former Navy Secretary John Phelan canceled the program one year ago . Meanwhile, HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding has a long lead-time contract to start the FF(X) frigate that is based on the U.S. Coast Guard’s National Security Cutter. While a successful frigate program has eluded the U.S. Navy for decades, the service is working toward using a foreign design for a new class of ships in the next few years, USNI News understands. The working requirements for a new frigate are mostly done, according to Hudson Institute naval analyst Bryan Clark. Now the Navy is prioritizing frigates that can escort other ships instead of performing anti-submarine warfare, which was the main mission of the now-cancelled Constellation-class program. The service wants a platform that can enforce a blockade and protect against medium tiered threats like what the military is currently facing in U.S. Central Command, according to Clark. “A frigate could defend against the kind of scale of threat that we’re seeing from the Iranians,” Clark told USNI News ahead of Euronaval. “Not really [anti-submarine warfare] – more about doing this kind of sea control, maritime security type mission.” To that end, six designs from around the globe have emerged as potential candidates in an international competition that would adhere to the one President Donald Trump called for in an August shipbuilding memo. The White House document called on the Navy to pursue the so-called “Finland model,” in which construction could begin in a foreign shipyard for up to the first two hulls before a foreign investment in U.S. shipbuilding infrastructure. The White House is using the Finland model to jumpstart the Arctic Security Cutter program by building two separate designs in shipyards in Finland, Texas and Louisiana. White House Office of Management and Budget Director Russ Vought has been vocal about using the same model for small surface combatants and auxiliaries. But Congress has resisted the effort by including draft language in both the House and Senate versions of the Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act that would prevent the Navy from buying foreign-built warships. Congress is more open to buying auxiliaries overseas. Despite congressional resistance, an August memo outlined a blueprint for that competition – crafted by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao. The plan was due to the White House on Thursday. The Contenders Type 31 Babcock image Since 2023, Babcock has maintained a partnership with lead American shipbuilder HII as part of the AUKUS security pact. The British company also works with HII on the unmanned surface vessel Romulus, which the U.K.’s Royal Navy is purchasing. Sir Nick Hine, the chief executive of Babcock’s marine division, said he thinks the Type 31 frigate could fill the U.S. Navy’s need for a small surface combatant. That platform should be able to “perform anti‑submarine warfare, surface warfare and convoy escort duties,” according to the White House memo. The Type 31 frigate could function as a command vessel in a fleet that includes a mix of manned and unmanned ships, according to Hine. Babcock has already worked with Lockheed Martin, meaning the platform could integrate the AEGIS Combat System and the AN/SPY-7 radar. The design also features a Mark 41 launcher with 32 Vertical Launching System cells, but Hine says it could potentially take additional cells. “Navies are short of two things always, even yours, short of money and people,” Hine, making the case for the Type 31, told USNI News on the sidelines of Euronaval last week. “You need a cheaper frigate because the cost of some of these platforms is insane, and you need a platform that’s got less people in it because you don’t have enough people. The Type 31 was designed to be more adaptable, more affordable, more available, and it was designed to have less people in it,” he added. “It was designed for a crew of a complement of 100, not to exceed 100. It’s 6,000 tons, 140 meters in length, and therefore it was designed for North Atlantic operations, so it’s designed to operate in high sea states for long periods of time.” To field the platform in the U.S. fleet faster, the hull could be built abroad to the point where it’s ready to sail away while the combat system is integrated back in the U.S., Hine said. Another option is out of Spain’s Navantia, which is working on an export version of its Bonifaz-class F-110 anti-submarine warfare frigate. Navantia, which is partnered with Lockheed Martin for the F-110, plans to submit a bid should the U.S. Navy issue a request for proposals, Navantia commercial director Juan de la Cueva told USNI News during a wine and tapas-fueled reception on the convention center floor. F-110 frigate. Navantia image “All Navantia ships have a U.S. legacy because we came from a very long-standing relationship with the United States,” de la Cueva said. “We learned from Bath Iron Works, Gibbs & Cox how to build ships. So these ships pass … [Naval Sea Systems Command]” standards. De la Cueva noted the long relationship Navantia has maintained with major U.S. yards like General Dynamics Bath Iron Works and HII. The company has already provided the U.S. Navy with some information and is waiting to hear about the next steps in the competition. A U.S. variant could feature Lockheed Martin’s Aegis Combat System and the SPY-7 air and defense radar, de la Cueva said. In addition to the Brits and the Spanish, the Italians also have an option for the U.S. should it kick off an international competition. Italy’s Fincantieri, which has its own American subsidiary at Marinette Marine in Wisconsin, could propose the FREMM EVO. That platform is an updated version of the FREMM multi-mission frigate that the U.S. used as the parent design for the Constellation class. “I would call us untapped potential,” Fincantieri Marinette Marine chief executive officer George Moutafis told USNI News in September. The yard is still finishing the Royal Saudi Navy’s multi-mission surface combatant while building the first two Constellation-class frigates and preparing to build the Marine Corps’ Landing Ship Medium. “It’s an evolution of the original version, which is meant to say all the benefits are still there,” Moutafis said of the FREMM EVO. “The hard lines that work well for an [anti-submarine warfare] mission all is there, and they’ve been working on the areas that you would think would be the attractive ones – you know making it more lethal, making it ready to host energy-wise future growth for future missions, bringing in capabilities that have to do again with the ASW mission – and at the same time identifying the ways that it can integrate well with deploying, recovering and managing unmanned elements of across all domains.” The Wisconsin yard currently has about 2,200 employees and would need to hire about 500 over time should it receive a contract to build more frigates. Other possible designs could come out of Japan, South Korea and Turkey, USNI News previously reported . Following a discussion between Trump and Turkish leadership on the sidelines of July’s NATO summit, the Istanbul-class guided-missile frigate built by several Turkish shipyards entered the mix, two sources previously told USNI News. Fincantieri image Perhaps the nation most closely associated with the ongoing conversation about foreign shipbuilding is South Korea, which has pledged to invest $150 billion in the U.S. shipbuilding industry as part of a trade deal in the works with the Trump administration. The Chungnam-class guided-missile frigate, which several South Korean companies build, is one option under consideration, USNI News has learned. Meanwhile, the export version of Japan’s Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ FFM Mogami-class guided-missile frigate is also on the table. While the Trump administration has repeatedly made its preference for an international competition known, the Navy has experienced setbacks when pursuing foreign designs. When altering the FREMM parent design for the Constellation-class program, Gibbs & Cox made so many changes to meet NAVSEA’s requirements that the commonality between the FREMM and the FFG(X) went from 85 percent to under 15 percent, USNI News reported in 2024 . “The thing that will prevent Constellation 2.0 is stop changing the requirement. If you set the requirement and leave it alone, and just let industry build it, whoever that is, that will stop Constellation 2.0,” Babcock’s Hine told USNI News. “Don’t even change the color of the curtains. Just build it,” he added. “It’s this sort of constant fiddling, and I know from being in the [U.K. Royal] Navy for most of my life, that we can’t help ourselves.”

source: 美国海军学院工作人员（大量国会报告每周2-3次）
summary: 以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）和保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-6）
content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福、长津和迪凯特向西航行进入马六甲海峡，而保罗·汉密尔顿则向东航行进入南中国海。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和迪凯特号目前正在印度洋前往美国中央司令部。日本横须贺附近 印度海军 Shivalik 级隐形多用途护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) 和美国海军 San 2026 年 11 月 7 日，安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞运输舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 在 2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间在西太平洋编队航行。美国海军照片 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习于周四在日本横须贺附近海域结束。
参与的资产包括日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM-1)、日本海上自卫队潜艇和 P-1 海上巡逻机 (MPA)、印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F49)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH153) 和澳大利亚皇家空军 P-8A Poseidon MPA、美国海军 P-8A 海神 MPA 和两栖运输船坞 USS Anchorage (LPD-23) 和 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26)。安克雷奇号和约翰·P·穆萨号与两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 以及已登船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队组成了马金岛两栖待命大队。据当地船舶观察员称，这三艘船均于周六从横须贺舰队活动司令部（CFAY）出发。 2026 年 11 月 8 日，在日本横须贺，美国海军陆战队海军陆战队海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（加强型）的飞行员从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇 (LPD-23) 的飞行甲板上驾驶一架 MV-22B 鱼鹰。美国海军照片安克雷奇于周五返回横须贺，目前停泊据当地船舶观察员称，那里近海。据当地船舶观察员称，澳大利亚皇家海军斯图尔特号护卫舰在参加 2026 年马拉巴尔演习后于周四返回横须贺。据当地船舶观察员称，印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri 于周四返回横须贺，并于周五离开。
据当地船舶观测员称，潜艇补给船弗兰克·凯布尔号 (AS-40) 于周三驶入横须贺指挥官舰队活动基地。在西太平洋，隶属于海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364 的美国海军陆战队 CH-53 种马准备从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰约翰·P·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 的飞行甲板起飞， 2026 年 11 月 9 日。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号和两栖运输船坞约翰·P·穆萨号正在美国第七舰队作战区域航行。在菲律宾海 台湾民族党秘书长吴钊燮于 2026 年 11 月 12 日发布的图片
