content:
黄仁勋经历了令人震惊的失宠——从地球上最富有的人之一、人工智能繁荣的主要推动者之一，到卷入两起婚外情丑闻，并在不到两周的时间里从英伟达辞职。虽然许多人都关注这位英伟达前首席执行官与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的关系，后者据称向中国情报部门传递信息，但《华尔街日报》深入挖掘了将她介绍给詹森的人——上海的明星基金经理康伟，他恰好也是黄女士的丈夫。有报道称，康伟在2010年代认识了黄仁勋，当时他的投资公司大量涉足中国游戏公司。目前尚不清楚这段介绍是否早于康与爱丽丝的关系和婚姻，但与黄女士关系密切的消息人士表示，她在 2020 年代就能够与詹森走近。据《华尔街日报》报道，尽管是情侣，但康似乎接受了爱丽丝与詹森的关系，与这对夫妇关系密切的人表示，康经常开玩笑说她是亿万富翁的私人助理。不过，康伟不仅仅是一名普通的企业高管。在2007年接手中海基金之前，他曾作为申银万国的策略师在金融界名声大噪。这使他成为当时中国最年轻的共同基金总裁之一，最终于2010年独自创业并创立了上海河西。
也正是在这个时候，黄乐（黄乐）进入金融行业，先是在香港汇丰银行的私人银行部门工作，后来转到中信证券，并担任副总裁职务。正是在中信工作期间，黄乐与康有交集。上海河西于2014年和2015年与该证券公司签署了协议，到2016年，公司登记记录显示黄女士已加入该投资公司。据《经济时报》报道，黄爱丽入驻上海河西后，她获得了该公司25%的股份，而这些股份全部来自于康。剩余股份由康伟（48.75%）和他的商业伙伴朱晓明（26.25%）共同持有，黄丽娟（Alice Huang）通过上海玉玺投资管理咨询有限公司持有25%的股权。与此同时，康伟也开始向他的商业伙伴和投资者介绍黄丽娟（Alice Huang）作为他的妻子。一年后，朱和康在河西基金的一项投资获得了一笔巨额意外之财，两人在如何分配利润的问题上发生了争执。尽管如此，该交易产生的巨额利润使上海河西以约5亿元人民币从中国企业集团世纪华通手中收购了视频游戏公司杭州盛丰。
交易两年后，即2019年，杭州盛丰的所有权转移给一家境外实体，该实体最终并入Osmanthus Vale Holdings——一家在英属维尔京群岛注册成立的控股公司，并将黄乐（Alice Huang的中文名字）列为其唯一所有者。随后，该公司成立不到两个月就被第七大道控股收购。虽然黄女士是这笔交易的签署人，但据信她充当了“白手套”的角色，即代表他人行事以隐瞒身份的人，但目前尚不清楚这是针对上海河西和康维还是其他第三方。关于Alice H的信息并不多

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang had a stunning fall from grace — from being one of the richest people on Earth and one of the primary drivers of the AI boom to being implicated in two extramarital affair scandals and resigning from Nvidia in under two weeks. While many are focused on the former Nvidia chief’s relationship with Alice Huang, who was allegedly passing on information to Chinese intelligence , the Wall Street Journal dug deeper into the person who introduced her to Jensen — Kang Wei, a star fund manager in Shanghai who also happened to be Ms. Huang’s husband. There have been reports that Kang Wei met Jensen Huang in the 2010s, when his investment firm was heavily involved in Chinese gaming companies. It’s not clear if this introduction predated Kang’s relationship and marriage to Alice, but sources close to Ms. Huang said that she was able to get close to Jensen by the 2020s. Despite being a couple, the WSJ reported that Kang seemingly accepted Alice’s relationship with Jensen, with people close to the couple saying that he would often joke that she was a personal assistant to the billionaire. Kang Wei is not just an average business executive, though. He made a name for himself in the finance world as a strategist for Shenyin Wanguo before taking over the Zhonghai Fund in 2007. This made him one of the youngest mutual fund chiefs in China at that time, before finally setting out on his own and founding Shanghai Hexi in 2010. It was also around this time that Alice Huang, whose Chinese name is Huang Le, entered the financial industry, first working at HSBC’s private banking arm in Hong Kong, before moving to CITIC Securities, where she attained a vice president position. It was during her time at CITIC that Alice crossed paths with Kang. Shanghai Hexi signed a deal with the securities firm in 2014 and 2015, and by 2016, corporate registry records show that Ms. Huang had joined the investment firm. The Economic Times reports Alice Huang’s move into Shanghai Hexi resulted in her getting a 25% stake in the company, all of which came from Kang. The remaining shares were shared between Kang Wei, with 48.75%, and his business partner, Zhu Xiaoming, with 26.25%, with Alice Huang’s 25% ownership stake being held through Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management Consulting Co., Ltd. Meanwhile, Kang also started introducing Alice Huang as his wife to his business associates and investors. One year later, Zhu and Kang had a falling out when one of their investments under a Hexi fund resulted in a major windfall, with the two partners disagreeing on how the profits were to be shared. Nevertheless, the massive profit generated by the deal allowed Shanghai Hexi to purchase Hangzhou Shengfeng, a video game company, for around 500 million yuan from Chinese conglomerate Century Huatong. Two years after the transaction, in 2019, Hangzhou Shengfeng’s ownership was transferred to an offshore entity, which was eventually consolidated under Osmanthus Vale Holdings — a holding company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands and listed Huang Le, Alice Huang’s Chinese name, as its sole owner. It was then purchased by 7Road Holdings less than two months after it was founded. While Ms. Huang was the signatory in this deal, it’s believed that she served as a “white glove,” a person who operates on behalf of another to conceal their identity — but it remains unclear if this was for Shanghai Hexi and Kang Wei or some other third party. There is not much information on Alice Huang’s activities between 2019 and 2021. However, Shanghai Hexi invested in Shanghai Longjing Information Technology, a data center-focused subsidiary of Century Huatong in 2020, where Ms. Huang served as a director between 2021 and 2022, according to a report by The Wire China . At about the same time, 7Road Holdings expanded into cloud computing, just before ChatGPT brought AI LLMs to the forefront. The U.S. government’s ban on the export of Nvidia chips to China put this investment in jeopardy, though, forcing it to spin off the business as 7Road International in Singapore. We don’t know when 7Road Holdings sold its Singapore subsidiary, but corporate records show that by the time the company was renamed Megaspeed in March 2023, it was already under the ownership of Huang Le Limited and led by Ms. Huang. It was sold again in November 2023 to Swiftdata, a company owned by Singaporean Tan Yong Pong. Axios said that she left the firm as a managing director soon after this acquisition, but sources said that she kept working with the company afterward, with Kang Wei helping her get it off the ground. In the same year, Shanghai Century Litong was founded to build AI data centers in Shanghai and Shenzhen, with Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co., an electronic components manufacturer, holding a 90% stake, while the remaining 10% is owned by Century Longteng, as reported by BigGo Finance . It should be noted that Century Longteng was renamed from Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management, with the firm pivoting its business from finance to cloud computing, and that even though Alice Huang has already exited the company by this time, it’s under the control of Huang Yu, who some sources say is Ms. Huang’s sister. A year after these data center acquisitions, Alice Huang began to be spotted in public with the former Nvidia CEO. A LinkedIn post showed her having drinks with a leather-clad Jensen Huang alongside other tech executives from NetThunder and Gigabyte at a post-Computex 2024 event. She was once again seen having dinner with him in a Taipei restaurant as reporters tried to interview him while one kid demanded his attention off camera. But more than these public sightings, Alice herself boasted about her “closeness” to the then CEO. People close to her said that she regularly posted photos with Jensen on her WeChat account, and even shared others with potential customers to help establish her credibility. She even reportedly claimed that Mr. Huang would celebrate her birthdays with restaurant dinners and gifts, with one Nvidia China sales employee also saying that she was a familiar face at the company’s annual event for China partners. An investigation revealed that from 2023 to 2025, Megaspeed imported $4.6 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips, while another $2 billion was routed through Speedmatrix , Megaspeed’s subsidiary with offices in Johor, Malaysia. Shanghai Century Litong also reportedly bought AI GPUs from other sources, with estimates putting the total number of banned chips moved through Alice Huang’s assistance at around 240,000, putting the shipments’ worth at around $7.5 billion. But even as Ms. Huang was making her international moves, Kang Wei was facing trouble at home. Chinese regulators fined him 2.5 million yuan, or approximately $380,000, in 2025, for violating sections of China’s Securities Law. This also led to a warning letter against him, issued in August 2026 by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Despite running into trouble with the authorities, this massive paper trail showed how Kang Wei actively made moves that put Alice Huang close to Jensen Huang. Some questions remain, though, about the U.S. intelligence community’s claims that she worked with the Ministry of State Security (MSS), China’s primary intelligence and counterintelligence agency. If it’s true that Alice Huang worked with the MSS and passed on information to the agency, did she specifically target Jensen Huang, or did the spy agency simply discover their indiscretion and use that to force her to cooperate? Was all this planned by the MSS, or were they just shrewd business moves that allowed Kang to make more money while going under the radar of regulators? These are questions that only Kang Wei and Alice Huang (or the Chinese spy agency) can answer. But no matter the case, the fact remains that China acquired advanced AI chips that were supposed to be out of its reach because of this couple’s connections.

title: 深陷醜聞的黃仁勳辭職，AI芯片巨頭Nvidia陷入動盪
summary: Play video, "How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security?", 節目全長 0,59 Author, 莉莉·賈馬利(Lily Jamali) 黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）在被曝涉嫌婚外情後，突然辭去AI芯片製造巨頭英偉達（Nvidia，輝達）的首席執行官一職。這一驚人的隕落在從硅谷到國會山（Capitol Hill）的各界引發震動。 美國華盛頓特區的國會議員正在對英偉達展開審查
content:
Play video, "How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security?", 節目全長 0,59
Author, 莉莉·賈馬利(Lily Jamali)
黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）在被曝涉嫌婚外情後，突然辭去AI芯片製造巨頭英偉達（Nvidia，輝達）的首席執行官一職。這一驚人的隕落在從硅谷到國會山（Capitol Hill）的各界引發震動。
美國華盛頓特區的國會議員正在對英偉達展開審查，要求黃仁勳說明，其涉嫌婚外情的其中一名對象是否為中國間諜。
英偉達因AI熱潮而成為全球市值最高的公司之一，但在醜聞佔據各大新聞頭條的短短五天內，其股票市值蒸發了5500億美元（約合4150億英鎊）。
英偉達臨時首席執行官科萊特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）召集管理團隊召開緊急會議，討論公司未來。
黃仁勳涉嫌的行為不僅可能逾越了職業界限，也使英偉達受到美國政界人士的質疑，他們對國家安全風險表示擔憂。
自1993年以來一直是英偉達公眾形象代表的黃仁勳，在被報道與涉嫌為中國從事間諜活動的艾麗斯·黃（Alice Huang）有婚外情後，於週日承認對妻子「不忠」。
週三，又有報道稱他有第二段婚外情，這次的對象是一名英偉達高管。
艾麗斯·黃曾在新加坡企業Megaspeed擔任高管，與黃仁勳並無親屬關係。據《紐約時報》（The New York Times）報道，她被懷疑為中國情報機構提供協助。中國否認這項指控，稱其為抹黑。
Play video, "Watch: What we know so far about Nvidia CEO resignation", 節目全長 0,50
美國司法部長托德·布蘭奇（Todd Blanche）週四表示，司法部尚未就艾麗斯·黃是否為北京（Beijing）從事間諜活動得出任何結論。
參議員伊麗莎白·沃倫（Elizabeth Warren）和克里斯·庫恩斯（Chris Coons），以及眾議院外交事務委員會（House Foreign Affairs Committee）的其他民主黨（Democratic Party）議員，公開要求黃仁勳向國會說明此事。
一名參議院工作人員告訴英國廣播公司（BBC），如果黃仁勳拒絕自願出席任何要求他到場的委員會聽證，他可能會收到傳票。
自週三以來，英偉達方面已多次拒絕置評。黃仁勳的一名私人代表週四也拒絕置評。
據美國媒體報道，黃仁勳涉嫌的第二段婚外情，對象是長期在英偉達擔任高管的金伯莉·鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell），她在公司內直接向黃仁勳匯報。
消息人士告訴BBC，英偉達員工曾注意到兩人的關係異常親密。
第一段婚外情曝光後，外界原本普遍預期黃仁勳能夠渡過風波，儘管英偉達當時已宣佈展開調查，以確定其首席執行官是否「成為外國情報活動的目標」。
一名現任英偉達員工告訴BBC，公司普通員工對最初有關他不忠的報道，大多沒有太當回事。
這名員工說，直到黃仁勳涉嫌與英偉達高管有婚外情的消息曝光，員工才開始覺得「這太瘋狂了」。
另一名英偉達員工表示，他們已被告知不得與媒體交談，也不得以其他方式公開評論此事。
隨着英偉達股價飆升，許多員工得以出售所持公司股票套現，獲得數百萬美元的報酬。
英偉達表示，「沒有理由相信國家安全受到損害，或英偉達的機密遭到洩露」，但承諾其獨立調查將審視所有可獲取的資料。
黃仁勳帶領英偉達迅速崛起，並成為人工智能行業的重要推動者。這個行業依賴英偉達製造的高性能計算機芯片。
但在過去四年，隨着人工智能技術發展出聊天機械人和大語言模型，開發人工智能工具的公司突然需要大量能夠處理海量數據的英偉達計算機芯片。
英偉達目前正在尋找正式接替黃仁勳的人選。首席財務官科萊特·克雷斯於週四獲任命為臨時首席執行官。
BBC本週採訪的幾名科技業內人士指出，黃仁勳的失勢已成為舊金山灣區（San Francisco Bay Area）圈子裏的熱門話題。該地區聚集了大量科技從業者、行業高管和億萬富翁。
微軟（Microsoft）的比爾·蓋茨（Bill Gates）和亞馬遜（Amazon）的傑夫·貝索斯（Jeff Bezos），都曾在過去十年間被揭露有婚外情。兩人如今都已與妻子離婚。
黃仁勳與妻子洛麗·黃（Lori Huang）已結婚40年。他們的兩個孩子也都在英偉達擔任高管。
英偉達本週的股價跌幅，是該公司27年前上市以來最大的五日跌幅。
其市值在過去五年上漲超過470%，並在僅僅幾週前觸及峰值。在科技行業普遍面臨不確定性的背景下，其市值如今已下跌31%。
由於英偉達近年來的規模和業績表現，這樣的跌幅可能直接影響普通美國人的儲蓄賬戶。
英偉達的市值在標準普爾500指數（S&P 500）中所佔權重約為7%。追蹤該指數的指數基金，是美國退休儲蓄賬戶中一種熱門的投資選擇。
黃仁勳辭職：暫時接掌Nvidia的克雷斯是誰？還有哪些正式接班人選？2026年11月12日

content:
2026 年 11 月 13 日

日本横须贺——

由军事海运司令部运营的远征快速运输舰俾斯麦市号（EPF 9）迎来了新任指挥官，中校。蒂亚·迈尔斯在横须贺舰队活动船上举行的仪式上。迈尔斯从中校手中接过指挥权。 VanAnh McCormick，在将该船移交给 MILCREW II 之前担任军事船员 I 的指挥官。

“从我们的人员流动开始，我们不再是 MILCREW II 和 CIVMAR；我们都是俾斯麦市号航空母舰，”迈尔斯在向由水手和公务员组成的混合船员发表的讲话中说道。 “‘保持媒体报道’是我们的全部工作！我们必须在场并准备好参与，同时互相支持，以确保我们的成功。Crew I 奠定了基础，我们的工作就是在此基础上继续发展。Possumus Efficiemus：我们可以而且我们将会实现。”

迈尔斯是南卡罗来纳州哥伦比亚人，2014 年从弗朗西斯马里恩大学毕业并获得数学学士学位后，被任命为海军军官。她还拥有海军研究生院的高级工商管理硕士学位。

在海上，迈尔斯曾在阿利伯克号航空母舰 (DDG 51)、珍珠港号航空母舰 (LSD 52) 和哈珀斯渡口号航空母舰 (LSD 49) 上服役。
在岸上，她在圣地亚哥海军水面和水雷作战发展中心和水面高级作战学校担任两栖作战战术教官。迈尔斯接替了麦考密克，麦考密克于 2026 年 7 月接管了 MILCREW I 的指挥权，并带领船员完成了有史以来的首次 EPF 部署。部署期间，船员航行超过4000海里，访问了4个海外港口。机组人员为“锐剑”演习提供了后勤保障，并完成了任务要求的所有准备工作。此外，供应部门还入围了 David M. Cook 食品服务卓越奖的决赛。

俾斯麦号是EPF级第九艘舰艇。这些浅吃水、全铝制商用双体船旨在以 35 节的平均速度将 600 短吨军用货物运输 1,200 海里。该船设有用于直升机操作的飞行甲板、车辆卸载坡道部署以及增强沿海操作和港口通道的浅吃水。这些能力使 EPF 能够在严峻或受损的港口提供灵活的物流支持、快速运输和救灾。

该船的船员由军事人员和文职海员组成。 MILCREW 轮流部署，基地设在圣地亚哥，而该舰的母港是横须贺，由美国第七舰队负责作战控制。
军事海运司令部负责指挥和支持大约 140 艘民用船只的行动，这些船只为美国海军舰船补充海上补给、执行专门任务、在全球范围内预置战斗货物、提供支持服务以及向部署的美国部队运输军事装备和补给品。

【原文 English Original】
13 November 2026

YOKOSUKA, Japan --

The expeditionary fast transport USS City of Bismarck (EPF 9), operated by Military Sealift Command, welcomed its new commanding officer, Lt. Cmdr. Tia Myers, during a ceremony aboard the ship at Fleet Activities Yokosuka. Myers assumed command from Lt. Cmdr. VanAnh McCormick, who served as the Military Crew I commander before turning the ship over to MILCREW II.

“Starting with our turnover, we are no longer MILCREW II and CIVMARs; we are all USS City of Bismarck,” Myers said in her address to the hybrid crew of sailors and civil service mariners. “It is all of our job to ‘keep the press!’ We have to be present and ready to engage while supporting each other to ensure our success. Crew I laid the foundation, and it is our job to build upon it. Possumus Efficiemus: We can and we will accomplish.”

A native of Columbia, South Carolina, Myers commissioned as a naval officer in 2014 after graduating from Francis Marion University with a bachelor’s degree in mathematics. She also holds an executive master’s degree in business administration from the Naval Postgraduate School.

At sea, Myers served aboard USS Arleigh Burke (DDG 51), USS Pearl Harbor (LSD 52) and USS Harpers Ferry (LSD 49).

Ashore, she served as an amphibious warfare tactics instructor at the Naval Surface and Mine Warfighting Development Center and Surface Advanced Warfighting School in San Diego. Myers relieved McCormick, who took command of MILCREW I in July 2026 and led the crew through its first ever EPF deployment. During the deployment, the crew sailed more than 4,000 nautical miles and visited four overseas ports. The crew provided logistics support for Exercise Keen Sword and completed all ready for tasking requirements. In addition, the supply department became a finalist for the David M. Cook Food Service Excellence Award.

Bismarck is the ninth ship in the EPF class. These shallow-draft, all-aluminum, commercial-based catamarans are designed to transport 600 short tons of military cargo 1,200 nautical miles at an average speed of 35 knots. The ship features a flight deck for helicopter operations, a vehicle offload ramp deployment, and a shallow draft that enhances littoral operations and port access. These capabilities allow the EPF to deliver flexible logistics support, rapid transport and disaster relief in austere or damaged ports.

The ship operates with a hybrid crew of military personnel and civil service mariners. The MILCREWs rotate for deployments and are based in San Diego, while the ship is homeported in Yokosuka under the operational control of U.S. 7th Fleet.

Military Sealift Command directs and supports operations for approximately 140 civilian-crewed ships that replenish U.S. Navy ships at sea, conduct specialized missions, preposition combat cargo worldwide, provide support services, and transport military equipment and supplies to deployed U.S. forces.

SilentAir 劫持亚洲电信网络拦截 SMS 2FA 代码并监视台湾用户
SilentAir 劫持亚洲电信网络拦截 SMS 2FA 代码并监视台湾用户
Swati Khandelwal报告2026年11月13日网络间谍/威胁情报
一个新发现的间谍组织利用亚洲移动运营商内部的黑客设备拦截特定人员的电话和短信，这些人员大多来自台湾。
总部位于斯德哥尔摩的电信和网络安全软件公司 Enea 本周在至少六个亚洲国家发现了该组织的攻击源，并将其命名为 SilentAir。它高度确信 SilentAir 是一个国家级行为者，但仅将其活动与中国联系起来，信心度较低。
该公司已告知运营商其在何处找到 SilentAir 源。据称，SilentAir 目前已中断，但可能会恢复。报告没有透露这些运营商是否已经清理了被黑的设备。
移动运营商使用 SS7 和 Diameter 协议来交换路由呼叫和文本并启用漫游的信令消息。此流量穿过称为 IPX 的共享网络，该网络在运营商之间的高度信任基础上运行。 SilentAir 从被黑设备向 IPX 发送攻击。
为了进行拦截，SilentAir 向目标的家庭网络发送了 UpdateLocation 消息或其等效的 Diameter 消息。该消息声称，被黑客入侵的设备现在正在为目标的手机提供服务。如果家庭网络接受它，该人的电话和短信将被转移给攻击者。
其中一些攻击有效。对于某些目标，该公司观察到两因素身份验证（2FA）代码在转移生效后立即被拦截。这表明有人试图闯入这些人注册的其他帐户。
该报告没有提供类似的语音通话证据，也没有说明是否有任何帐户被盗用。
该公司从 SilentAir 看到的攻击中，拦截占 18.3%。对于典型的监控公司（大多数信号攻击背后的公司）来说，该公司早期研究中的份额为 2.1%。
一些目标是本国的政治和政府要人。在极少数情况下，多个国家的 SilentAir 设备会协同对抗此类目标，该公司表示，这些目标指向单个控制器。
攻击呈爆发式发生，一个月内从一个或几个订户到数千个订户，两次爆发之间的间隔长达几个月或更长时间。
在台湾以外，目标主要位于其他东南亚和东亚网络，有时也位于东非、中亚、中东和欧洲。使用被黑客攻击的运营商自己的网络的人也可能成为目标，但该公司无法看到该流量。
该公司通过研究针对运营商之间链路的攻击发现了 SilentAir。自 2025 年初以来，它一直在追踪来自一些通常不会发送攻击的亚洲运营商的异常攻击，其中大部分是通过 SS7，有时是通过 Diameter。后来的分析甚至更早地发现了可疑活动。
根据该公司的技术报告，托管 SilentAir 的网络以奇怪且不一致的方式处理转移目标的后续消息。这就留下了两种解释：外部有人伪造了这些网络的信令地址，或者每个网络内部的设备已被接管。
该公司随后看到一名操作员内部的设备既发送又接收攻击命令，这证实了第二种解释。该设备的表现是

【原文 English Original】
SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
Swati KhandelwalNov 13, 2026Cyber Espionage / Threat Intelligence
A newly identified spying group used hacked equipment inside Asian mobile operators to intercept the calls and texts of selected people, mostly in Taiwan.
Enea, a telecom and cybersecurity software company based in Stockholm, found the group's attack sources in at least six Asian countries and named it SilentAir this week. It assessed with high confidence that SilentAir is a state-level actor, but linked its activity to China only with low confidence.
The company has told the operators where it found SilentAir sources. It said SilentAir has been disrupted for now but could return. The report does not say whether those operators have cleaned up the hacked equipment.
Mobile operators use the SS7 and Diameter protocols to exchange signaling messages that route calls and texts and enable roaming. This traffic crosses a shared network called the IPX, which runs on a high level of trust between operators. SilentAir sent its attacks into the IPX from the hacked equipment.
For interception, SilentAir sent the target's home network an UpdateLocation message, or its Diameter equivalent. The message claimed that the hacked equipment was now serving the target's phone. If the home network accepted it, calls and texts for that person would be diverted to the attackers.
Some of these attacks worked. For some targets, the company observed two-factor authentication (2FA) codes being intercepted immediately after the diversion took effect. That points to an attempt to break into other accounts registered to those people.
The report gives no similar evidence for voice calls, and it does not say whether any account was taken over.
Interception made up 18.3% of the attacks the company saw from SilentAir. For a typical surveillance company, the kind of firm behind most signaling attacks, the share was 2.1% in the company's earlier research.
Some targets were political and government VIPs in their own countries. In rare cases, SilentAir equipment in several countries worked together against such targets, which the company said points to a single controller.
The attacks came in bursts, from one or a few subscribers to several thousand over a month, with gaps of up to several months or longer between bursts.
Outside Taiwan, targets were mostly in other Southeast and East Asian networks, and at times in East Africa, Central Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. People using the hacked operators' own networks may also have been targeted, but the company could not see that traffic.
The company spotted SilentAir by studying attacks on the links between operators. Since early 2025, it has tracked unusual attacks, mostly over SS7 and sometimes Diameter, from some Asian operators that would not normally send attacks. Later analysis found suspicious activity even earlier.
The networks hosting SilentAir handled follow-up messages for diverted targets in odd and inconsistent ways, according to the company's technical report. That left two explanations: someone outside was faking those networks' signaling addresses, or equipment inside each network had been taken over.
The company then saw equipment inside one operator both send and receive attack commands, which confirmed the second explanation. That equipment behaved exactly like SilentAir sources in other networks.
Detecting and blocking the attacks was hard at first because the attackers understood mobile networks and signaling defenses well. After the attacks were contained, the company recovered traces of unauthorized access. It could not analyze the malware it believes SilentAir used.
The report does not name the countries, the operators, or any of the targets. In some countries, SilentAir attacks came from more than one operator.
SilentAir also sent silent SMS on a very large scale, mainly to subscribers in Taiwan. These are texts that the phone does not display or alert on.
During the day, most silent SMS went to subscribers on other networks, such as Southeast Asian networks. One of their main uses appears to have been checking whether a diversion had worked, the company said.
If the test text reached the hacked equipment instead of the phone, the attackers knew they were getting that person's texts.
Most silent SMS went out at night, and most of those went to people in Taiwan. The company said the purpose of those messages is not confirmed. They may be a bulk check that earlier diversions were still in place, since phones are least likely to re-register to their real location at night.
The silent texts carried spam-like motivational or promotional lines, often in English. The company believes the text was a disguise. If an operator along the way stripped a message's silent setting, the recipient would see it as spam and ignore it.
The company's low-confidence link to China rests on several signs. SilentAir focused on Taiwan and did not target Chinese networks or subscribers.
Its tracking and interception attacks also followed a working day in UTC+8, which is China Standard Time. They started at 9 a.m., almost stopped on weekends, and paused or slowed around Chinese holidays.
The company also considered a link to Liminal Panda, a group behind earlier telecom intrusions. It called the link possible but unconfirmed and does not tie the two groups together for now.
In several hacked operators, SilentAir attacks happened during a known Liminal Panda infection. At other times, the two showed no sign of working together. They also went after operators in the same part of Asia, though Liminal Panda has no known focus on Taiwan.
SilentAir's behavior also partly matches that of SCTPE, a little-known Linux trojan that runs in the kernel and is designed to send and receive SS7 and Diameter traffic.
Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) has described the same tool in a government advisory. There, the tool is called SIGweaver. The agency said CrowdStrike identified it on January 21 and links it to Liminal Panda with moderate confidence.
But Enea said SilentAir answered messages it had not sent itself, which the known SCTPE program cannot do. SilentAir's operational security also seemed far better than Liminal Panda's.
Separately, the company's GTP firewall has detected Liminal Panda activity at several customer operators since the first quarter of this year. The company blocked the group's GTPDoor traffic there and saw Liminal Panda infections, or strong signs of them, in at least 5 to 10 operators.
The GTPDoor backdoor, first documented on February 27, 2024, hides commands within GTP-C, the protocol that establishes mobile data connections between networks. The company also found evidence of a new version that hides commands in GTP-U, the part of GTP that carries users' data. GTP-U traffic is harder to inspect, though the company believes the new version serves mainly as a backup.
The company said any attacker could reuse these techniques, and it told operators to:
Deploy GTP-C and GTP-U firewalls and configure them to share information with their SS7 and Diameter firewalls.
Go beyond the industry's basic recommendations for signaling security.
Treat the whole IPX as untrusted.
Add detection for signaling protocols inside their own networks.
Connect signaling security with the rest of their IT security.
The report does not advise people whose calls and texts may be targeted.

中共百艘军舰无声演习 国安揭对台操作“兵凶战危”(图) 台灣 | 認知戰 | 亞太經濟合作會議 | APEC | 台海风云 || 看中国网
中共近期在西太平洋及台湾周边集结大批海军与海警船舰，疑似进行一场未公开宣布、没有演训代号的大规模“无声演习”，台湾国安示警:对台操作认知战，营造“兵凶战危”氛围。（示意图/图片来源：ADEK BERRY/AFP via Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者立明综合报导）中共近期在西太平洋及台湾周边集结大批海军与海警船舰，疑似进行一场未公开宣布、没有演训代号的大规模“无声演习”，引发美国智库及台湾国安单位关注。美国战争研究所（ISW）与美国企业研究所（AEI）最新报告指出，截至11月初，已有超过100艘解放军海军及中国海警船舰在西太平洋活动，演练内容可能包括模拟包围、孤立台湾及反介入／区域拒止（A2/AD）作战。国安人士分析，北京选在亚太经济合作会议（APEC）及台湾九合一选举前夕采取低调军事施压，除了避免引发国际外交反弹，也可能借此营造“兵凶战危”氛围，对台湾进行认知作战。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
ISW与AEI日前共同发布“中国与台湾情势更新”（The China & Taiwan Update）报告，指出中国可能正在进行一场大型、未预告的军事演习，透过海军及海警船舰在西太平洋部署，模拟包围并孤立台湾。
报告指出，截至11月初，超过100艘解放军海军及中国海警船舰在西太平洋集结活动，相关行动涉及反介入／区域拒止（A2/AD）演练，显示中国可能正测试远海兵力整合及封锁台湾周边海域的作战能力。
国安人士指出，这次行动没有正式宣布军演名称，也未透过高调宣传对外释放讯息，与过去公开宣布对台军演的模式有所不同，但不代表军事威慑程度降低，反而可能具有更复杂的政治与战略盘算。
国安人士分析，中国此次采取“无声演习”，首先与APEC及台湾九合一选举的时间点有关。
在APEC举办前夕，如果北京高调宣布对台军演，势必引发国际社会关切，甚至冲击峰会的外交氛围。因此，中国选择不公开宣布演习，仍能维持军事威慑，同时避免立即承受外交压力，保留对外关系的回旋空间。
另一方面，随着台湾九合一选举接近，北京也可能利用周边军事活动营造战争威胁，操作“兵凶战危”的政治氛围。国安人士认为，中国一方面透过军事部署制造压力，另一方面避免高调军演引起台湾民众反感，借由不宣布军演的方式降低警觉，再配合台湾内部对战争风险的讨论，削弱民众自我防卫的信心。
国安人士进一步指出，这次部署不应只被视为单纯的围台演练，而是中国对第一岛链进行系统性军事压制的展现。
从部署规模及演练科目来看，中国此次动员已超过去年底对台军演的规模，并协调北部、东部及南部战区海军兵力参与。如此大规模的跨战区动员，已超出一般国土防卫需求，显示北京正尝试将不同区域舰队整合为单一远海作战力量，并在西太平洋联合作战环境中进行实战化验证。
换言之，中国透过围台作战情境，测试的不只是对台封锁能力，也包括对第一岛链周边军事力量的投射、协同及压制能力。
此外，国安人士也注意到中俄近期的军事动态。俄罗斯太平洋舰队10月28日从鄂霍次克海试射“布拉瓦”（Bulava）潜射洲际弹道飞弹，飞弹横跨欧亚大陆后命中俄国西北部靶场；中国则在数天后试射潜射洲际弹道飞弹。
国安人士认为，中俄接连进行远距离飞弹试射，可能具有相互呼应的战略意涵，透过跨战区兵力部署及远程火力投射，向美国与其盟友展示突破地理限制、在广大印太区域进行战略反制的能力。
国安人士分析的第三个重点，则是这次演习与中共军方高层人事整肃的关联。
随着中国国家主席习近平持续清洗解放军高层，军委会层级的全军战略演习去年一度停摆。此次行动被视为军方高层整肃后，首次重新启动的军委会层级全军战略演习，具有检验军队指挥体系及跨战区协同能力的意义。
国安人士认为，从百艘以上船舰集结、跨战区兵力整合，到中俄远程飞弹试射及中国军方重新启动全军战略演习等迹象来看，北京近期军事活动已不只是针对台湾的单一威慑，而是涉及第一岛链、西太平洋及区域战略布局。尤其在APEC及台湾选举前夕，如何辨识中国军事行动与认知作战的相互配合，将是台湾国安单位持续关注的重点。

胡春华出席纪念孙中山大会 广东旧部刘吉被免职(图) 余金富 | 馬興瑞 | 習近平 | 惠州市委書記 | 李希 | 官吏 || 看中国网
2023年3月11日，在北京举行的中共全国人大第四次全体会议开幕。时任中共全国政协副主席胡春华（左）和上海市委书记陈吉宁（右）出席开幕式并做交谈。（图片来源：Lintao Zhang/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者李德言综合报导）日前，中共举行纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会，胡春华有出席，但显得表情拘谨。而他在主政广东时的旧部、大秘刘吉也在不久前被免职。刘吉也给马兴瑞担任八年的下属。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据中共党媒新华社报导称，2026年11月12日，中共在北京举行纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会，中共党魁习近平与政治局常委李强、赵乐际等人出席，中共政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁主持大会。据悉有大约3000人参会。中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，包括胡春华在内的全国政协副主席等人都有出席大会。
2026年10月31日，据广东省官方通报称，广东省委决定惠州市长陈宇航出任惠州市委书记；刘吉不再担任惠州市委书记、常委、委员职务，并称对其“另有任用”。
据中共官媒《惠州日报》报导称，2026年11月4日，广东省惠州市人大常委会举行会议，接受刘吉辞去惠州市人大常委会主任职务的请求，接受陈宇航辞去惠州市长职务的请求；11月6日，惠州市常务副市长王滨升任为惠州市长。
据公开资料显示，刘吉今年57岁，是湖北麻城人。他曾先后担任广东省发改委稽察办主任、投资处处长、总经济师，广东省发改委副主任，广东省委办公厅副主任，广东省委副秘书长、省委改革办主任，广东省委政研室主任，惠州市委书记，惠州市人大常委会主任，直到此番被免职。
从刘吉的简历中可以看出，他进入仕途以来，多年来始终在广东省任职，也与胡春华有过交集。胡春华是湖北宜昌市五峰县人，与刘吉是湖北老乡。
2012年12月18日--2017年10月，胡春华担任广东省委书记。这期间，刘吉在2013年9月出任广东省发改委副主任，后来相继担任广东省委办公厅副主任，广东省委副秘书长、省委改革办主任，广东省委政研室主任。这表明刘吉给胡春华担任四年多的下属、大秘等。
胡春华离开广东后，李希从2017年10月--2022年10月接任广东省委书记职务。而马兴瑞从2013年11月开始出任广东省委副书记兼政法委书记，成为时任省委书记胡春华副手。2015年3月，马兴瑞中共广东省委副书记、深圳市委书记，2017年1月23日--2021年12月，马兴瑞担任广东省省长。
这期间，刘吉从2018年5月被调任为惠州市委副书记，惠州市市长。2021年10月，任惠州市委书，次月担任惠州市人大常委会主任。
由此可见，刘吉给李希担任五年的属下，给马兴瑞担任8年的属下。而刘吉接下来的仕途走向如何，以及他是否会受到马兴瑞案的牵连，还需要进一步观察。
刘吉被免职才不长时间，2026年11月10日，广东阳江市长余金富也被官宣落马，而他也是刘吉的旧部。
2018年4月至2021年10月，刘吉出任惠州市委副书记、市长。曾担任商务厅投资促进与对外经济合作处处长、公平贸易局局长的余金富，在2016年10月担任惠州市副市长；2020年5月升任为惠州市委常委、市委秘书长，2021年8月升任为惠州市委副书记；两个月后调任阳江市委副书记、市长。从中可以看出，余金富给刘吉担任两年半的下属。
而在刘吉被免职前，他曾任职8年多的惠州官场出现“大地震”，出现官员落马潮，包括：2026年9月15日，惠州市住房和城乡建设局党组成员、副局长商红新落马；2026年9月4日，惠州仲恺高新区党工委委员、管委会副主任庄煜平落马；2026年7月29日，惠州城市职业学院党委书记钟文宇落马；2026年4月3日，惠州市卫生健康局党组书记、局长徐蓉落马；2026年1月6日，惠州市人大常委会党组成员、副主任，原教育局党组书记、局长袁清山落马；他们也几乎都是刘吉在惠州任职时被提拔和重用。
五中全会后，中共政局越发诡异。习近平的重要亲信马兴瑞落马，五中全会会议公报显示，他被确认开除中共党籍。对于马兴瑞落马的原因众说纷纭，但不可否认的是，他是习近平与彭丽媛夫妇共同的心腹。而胡春华的动态也引发海外关注。2026年10月22日，胡春华缺席中共所谓长征“胜利”纪念大会，引发诸多猜测，有爆料说他和家人失联，也有说法称他当时生病。后来胡春华出席五中全会，但在10月29日会议闭幕后流出的现场画面中，他的面前摆放一本红色记事本，又被指是中共党章，一时间传闻再起，有媒体人随后发现新疆党委书记陈小江、中共中央社会工作部部长吴汉圣等人的桌面上也出现类似的红色封皮笔记本。
这次胡春华出席纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会，据流到网上的现场画面来看，他头发花白，表情拘谨而略显沉重。而他的广东旧部刘吉的被免职，未知是否会“平安着陆”。
2026年11月12日，旅美独立时评人蔡慎坤在X平台发帖表示，“近期关于胡春华的消息多如牛毛，我认为胡春华再被习近平清洗整肃的可能性微乎其微。胡春华在担任广东省委书记的第三年，也就是2015年就向习近平‘俯首称臣’，明确表示没有‘接班’的想法，并且把自己的秘书支走。经济上胡春华是标准的‘不粘锅’，石泰峰在内蒙倒查二十年就是冲他而去，结果发现掘地三丈也查不到胡春华藏匿的半个铜板，再说身为二十大‘接班人’，59岁就被打发到政协老人院，二十一大胡春华更不可能对习近平连任构成任何威胁。”
胡春华出席纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会，这场纪念大会规模比照江泽民百年纪念大会，11月12日上午在北京人民大会堂举行。习近平出席大会并发表讲话。

title: 黄乐丈夫牵线“亲密关系” 传黄仁勋出轨不止一人(图)
summary: 黄乐丈夫牵线“亲密关系” 传黄仁勋出轨不止一人(图) 婚外情 | 英伟达 | 时事 || 看中国网 2026年9月2日，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）在美国北卡罗来纳州教堂山举行的二十国集团（G20）创新部长会议上发表讲话。（图片来源：Sean Rayford/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。 【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者金言综合报道）英伟达（又名辉达）创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋11月12日宣布
content:
黄乐丈夫牵线“亲密关系” 传黄仁勋出轨不止一人(图) 婚外情 | 英伟达 | 时事 || 看中国网
2026年9月2日，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）在美国北卡罗来纳州教堂山举行的二十国集团（G20）创新部长会议上发表讲话。（图片来源：Sean Rayford/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者金言综合报道）英伟达（又名辉达）创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋11月12日宣布辞职。综合多家美国主流媒体报道，此前，他与华裔商人黄乐的婚外情已持续发酵数日，美国官员更担心黄乐是被中国情报机构招募的线人。与此同时，美国媒体11月11日披露他与公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利・鲍威尔的另一段婚外情。更令人关注的是，正是黄乐的丈夫最初牵线两人认识的。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据《华尔街日报》报道，认识这对夫妇的人士透露，黄仁勋是经相识十年的中国商人康伟介绍，认识了后来与他发展出恋情的黄乐，而康伟正是黄乐的丈夫。这些人士说，在约两年时间里，康伟似乎接受了妻子与黄仁勋的恋情，并公开谈论两人的亲密关系，有时还半开玩笑地称黄乐是黄仁勋的“私人助理”。
黄仁勋周日在致员工的信中承认对妻子不忠，并为辜负家人和员工的信任道歉。据照片及曾与两人会面的人士说，黄乐在2024年和2025年多次与黄仁勋会面。台湾媒体曾拍到，2025年5月在台北的一场晚宴上，黄仁勋的女儿笑着为两人拍照。
报道称，据了解这对夫妇商业往来的人士说，现年50岁出头的康伟曾是中国的明星基金经理，2010年创办上海和熙。黄乐则于2000年代末在香港浸会大学攻读传媒管理硕士。工商登记记录显示，两人于2016年开始共同经营这家公司。
过去十年间，夫妇二人不断从一个商机转向另一个，涉足游戏、制药企业收购和云计算等领域，每次都搭建关联实体网络、相互转让股权，并动用一切可用人脉。据一名曾在康伟所投资公司工作的人士说，英伟达当时专注于游戏芯片，黄仁勋与康伟是在亚洲见面的，这名人士还称自己曾帮助两人建立联系。
2018年，中国证券监管机构对康伟及其公司处以罚款，原因是在一场收购争夺战中未披露其在一家中国制药公司的持股，并存在其他违规行为。康伟和上海和熙当时提出异议，被监管机构驳回。
2023年，夫妇二人盯上了AI数据中心。据工商登记记录和知情人士透露，他们收购了此前所投游戏公司旗下的新加坡子公司，并于当年3月更名为Megaspeed International，黄乐登记为董事，康伟与她共同开拓业务。
据了解谈判的人士说，中国电商龙头阿里巴巴是帮助Megaspeed起步的关键参与方。美国自2022年末起实施出口管制，禁止英伟达向中国直接销售高性能芯片，理由是担心其增强中国的军事和监控能力。阿里巴巴当时正寻找合作伙伴，以获取中国境外配备大量英伟达芯片的数据中心算力。
这些人士说，Megaspeed告诉英伟达，阿里巴巴将成为其核心客户。凭借这一大客户，该公司在2023年11月被列为“英伟达云合作伙伴”，可优先获得芯片。此后不久，黄乐告诉一名熟人，她已与黄仁勋取得联系，公司业务很快就能顺利开展。
据知情人士说，Megaspeed将购得的大量英伟达服务器运往马来西亚的数据中心，向阿里巴巴提供算力，但部分服务器还被运往中国，收货方包括上海云计算服务商世纪利通。该服务商隶属于一家上海上市公司，康伟曾与这家上市公司有业务往来。The Information此前报道过两家公司的关联。Megaspeed表示，其运营“完全符合所有适用的出口管制规定”，世纪利通未回应置评请求。
2024年末至2025年6月间，夫妇二人还向上海和新加坡的投资者推介多个数据中心项目，其中两个位于东南亚，一个位于上海。潜在投资者称，两人承诺资金三年内可增长两倍，并自信地表示有办法把英伟达芯片运入中国。
如今，这对夫妇正受到一系列调查。美国和新加坡正在审查Megaspeed，该公司被指可能向中国转运了价值数十亿美元的受管制英伟达AI芯片。新加坡政府表示仍在调查Megaspeed，但未调查黄乐与中国的关系，也未回应有关拘留的提问。
台湾有关部门表示，已撤销黄乐的入境许可并禁止其再次入境。她曾在台湾多次与英伟达负责人会面，台湾官员正调查她访台期间是否涉及情报搜集，或违反《反渗透法》。据了解情况的人士说，黄乐2025年夏天曾被新加坡有关部门拘留并被禁止离境，禁令后来解除，她今年早些时候身在中国。
据认识这对夫妇的人士说，康伟今年早些时候因一项涉及上市公司的股市操纵调查在上海被拘留，最近已获释，并向朋友分享了一张自己在斯坦福大学的照片。
美国官员认为，中国情报机构因黄乐能接触这家芯片设计公司的负责人，而将她招募为线人。中国政府否认有关黄仁勋是间谍行动目标的报道，外交部发言人郭嘉昆称“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑”。记者未能联系到康伟和黄乐，英伟达未予置评。
就在黄乐事件之外，《纽约时报》周三披露，黄仁勋与在英伟达工作逾18年的医疗保健副总裁鲍威尔也有婚外情。据报道，两人关系违反了公司行为准则，今年3月还曾在圣何塞一家酒店被拍到举止亲密，黄仁勋的安保人员随后要求拍摄者签署保密协议。路透社周四另援引匿名消息人士称，黄仁勋与另一名员工存在“亲密关系”。
另据报道，英伟达董事会在另一桩婚外情曝光后，已准备解除其CEO职务，黄仁勋随即辞职。首席财务官兼执行副总裁科莱特・克雷斯出任临时CEO，她在公司工作13年，将继续履行原有职责，公司将同时考虑内部和外部人选担任正式继任者。
《纽约邮报》专栏作家查理・加斯帕里诺批评董事会反应迟缓，缺乏基本的继任计划，并指黄仁勋采用直接下属多达60人的“扁平化”管理，削弱了监督。有报道还质疑英伟达向投资者披露东南亚业务的方式，市场担忧问题不止于此，英伟达股价因此下挫。黄仁勋同时担任特朗普政府的高级AI顾问，使事件的政治敏感度进一步上升，有评论预计两党议员、监管机构和集体诉讼律师均可能介入。

【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者尹华综合报道）美国海军研究生院能源学术组成员布伦达·沙弗（Brenda Shaffer）近日表示，加拿大拥有加强西方能源安全、创造巨额财富的资源条件，却在限制自身产能的同时，加深了对中国的依赖。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
沙弗近日在《The Bureau》播客中表达了自己的核心观点，即西方国家过于倾向把能源当作“气候美德”的表态，忽视了谁来生产能源、谁掌控输送设备、谁能切断供应这些战略后果。“加拿大不仅可以通过提高产量、建设基础设施为全球安全作出重大贡献，还能赚大钱。”她说。
在她看来，加拿大尤其容易受到中国影响、国际气候政治与国内能源开发阻力三重因素的叠加冲击。她认为，中国对加拿大的渗透“可能比大多数西方国家更深”。
节目中，沙弗从瑞典气候活动人士格蕾塔·通贝里转向亲巴勒斯坦的活动谈起，提出所谓“红绿绿联盟”概念：第一个“红”指激进左翼与中国，后两个“绿”分别指伊斯兰主义运动和气候组织。她主张，这些群体即便动机不同，也可能在削弱西方机构与战略利益的行动上形成合流。她同时明确表示，并不认为这些网络事先知晓2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击。
总理马克·卡尼是她批评的焦点之一。卡尼在出任总理前，曾于2021年发起“格拉斯哥净零金融联盟”，后来迈克尔·布隆伯格加入担任联席主席。沙弗认为，引导资金远离化石燃料的做法抑制了对世界仍然需要的能源供应的投资，一旦战争或其他冲击发生，各国将更易遭遇短缺和价格飙升。
不过她强调，保障能源安全并不意味着反对可再生能源。“我认为自己是‘燃料中立’的。”她说。她主张从一国的资源、气候、人口、经济和战略需求出发，选择最合适的能源组合；她反对的是在替代方案尚未就绪时，就以金融和监管手段让现有能源变得稀缺或昂贵。
她指出，中国可以利用以煤为主的电力系统制造可再生能源设备并出口，在西方供应链依赖加深的同时获取收入和影响力。针对谷歌前首席执行官埃里克·施密特关于中国可再生能源充沛的说法，她提醒应区分电力与一次能源总供应。据能源研究所2026年报告，2025年化石燃料约占全球一次能源供应的86%。
沙弗还点名电力逆变器等联网设备可能成为安全隐患，称受损的能源基础设施或能在敌方动用军舰战机之前就扰乱军事行动。“你不必在台湾附近击落飞机。”她说。她同样关注联网汽车和港口设备可能带来的监控、数据窃取与干扰风险。西方安全机构此前已指出，“伏特台风”旨在将黑客潜伏于美国关键基础设施，“盐台风”则渗透包括加拿大在内的全球电信网络。基于这些担忧，她反对加拿大向中国电动车开放市场。
她还认为，对数据中心等人工智能基础设施的抵制，可能成为西方又一项自我设限。
沙弗的药方只有一个字：建。扩大产量，完善输送基础设施，推动全球供应多元化，让更少国家依赖脆弱的海上咽喉要道。
她最后说，加拿大风景优美、民众教育程度高、资源禀赋出众。“你得非常努力，”她说，“才能让繁荣和安全不发生。”

在华人圈甚至部分港人中，流传着一种极其荒谬且本末倒置的论调：将香港今日的彻底沦陷全盘栽赃给川普(特朗普)总统，甚至借由黄之锋等年轻抗争者被暴政重判的残酷现实，曲解外交法律规范，以此攻击川普“出卖香港”。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
历史的真相是，长达四十年西方世界特别是美国对中共的纵容，任其坐大，成为第二大经济体，已经香港被送进中共手中的溃败，以及中共对香港的全面控制和镇压——，责任从来不在川普。
自1983年中英谈判引发信心危机、香港开启联系汇率挂钩美元起，前宗主国英国便一路畏首畏尾、推诿责任。
最讽刺的是，1989年天安门大屠杀的血迹未干，仅仅三年后的1992年，老布什领导下的美国建制派政府便急不可耐地通过《美国香港政策法》，亲手为中共送上了香港这个“独立关税区”的特权默认，将其打造成滋养中共权贵外汇与走私西方高科技的温床。
随后，从克林顿、小布什到奥巴马，历届建制派放任中共对香港长达三十年的蚕食侵吞，喂大了这只专制巨兽。这套虚伪的绥靖利益链，直到川普总统上任后，才被他用法律、制度、雷霆行动彻底砸碎。
国际政治不是好莱坞电影。在面对中共全面同化香港的残暴现实时，任何主权国家领事馆的外交规范与国际法框架都有其现实边界，无法单凭一己之力阻挡暴政的司法迫害。川普政府没有选择给廉价的口头声援和作秀式的“强烈谴责”，而是直接以法律与制度性铁腕，将中共占领下的香港打回原形！他通过四部核心法案、三项重磅行政命令、多轮高官金融绝杀，以及全盘围剿离岸黑产网络，彻底剥夺了中共继续拿香港作为“自由港”的免死金牌。
本系列将以事实、证据、法案、行动与数据，刺破谣言与栽赃，让历史真相大白于天下！👇
．是什么：在川普总统执政前，华盛顿长期墨守1992年《美国—香港政策法》，克林顿、小布什、奥巴马政府面对中共对港自治的蚕食均仅止于口头抗议。川普总统彻底终结了这套绥靖模式，两任任期内密集打出“4部核心涉港法案、3项重磅行政命令、多轮高官金融绝杀、以及全盘围剿离岸黑产网络”等一系列雷霆实体行动。
．目的是什么：打破中共“既要全面剥夺香港自由，又要继续占用香港国际经济红利”的如意算盘。美方不再充当中共破坏法治的被动旁观者，而是在法律、经贸、金融和情报防务层面，彻底清算中共利用香港制度漏洞进行的战略套利，强行剥离其经济与外交特权。
．核心意义：宣告西方对中共“以经促变”幻想的彻底破产。确立了“法案制度化、行政工具化、金融手段化”反制专制扩张的新基准。
．对中共的致命打击：通过这些真刀真枪的立法与行动，彻底剥离中共套在香港头上的“自由港免死金牌”，让中共无法再把香港当成安然无恙、套取西方外汇与高科技的“离岸缓冲区”。去特权化、去套利化、剥离中共的白手套——这是彻底切断中共对香港的制度套利，长远来看，恰是对香港人民根本利益最大的保护和救赎。
．是什么：2019年11月27日，川普总统顶住美中第一阶段贸易谈判的巨大压力，签署《香港人权与民主法案》。法案规定国务院必须每年评估香港自治状况，作为是否延续其特殊待遇的前置条件；授权强制制裁人权迫害官僚（冻结资产、撤销签证）；并明确规定不得以“政治捕控记录”为由拒发香港抗争者的赴美签证。同步签署《保护香港法案》，直接切断催泪弹、橡胶子弹等美制警用装备供应链。
．目的是什么：以美国国内法强制绑架香港的商业特权与人权法治，击碎中共企图用数千亿贸易订单胁迫华盛顿的算盘，拉高中共暴力镇压抗争的政治、金融与执法成本。
．核心意义：数十年来首次以法律形式建立可量化的国际审查与惩罚机制，为香港抗争者建立外交庇护屏障，奠定了后续所有对港反制与金融制裁的法律基石。
．对中共的致命打击：击穿中共“香港事务纯属内政”的防火墙；将暴政官员直接置于美国司法与资产冻结雷达之下；同时斩断了中共借西方执法装备武装港警的物理供应链。
．是什么：2020年7月14日中共强推《港区国安法》后，川普总统签署《香港自治法》（HKAA）。法案不仅授权冻结破坏香港自治官僚的海外资产，更首创针对金融机构的“二级制裁”（Secondary Sanctions）机制——规定任何外国银行若与受制裁官员发生重大交易，美方将实施包含切断美元清算、取消代理账户在内的10项绝杀级惩罚。
．目的是什么：建立极其严密的金融封锁网。不仅制裁作恶官僚个人，更逼迫包括中资四大行在内的全球金融体系，必须在“全球美元SWIFT清算网络”与“中共专制官僚”之间做出二选一的抉择。
．核心事实与效果：受制裁的高官（如林郑月娥）被迫公开承认无银行敢为其开户、只能领取并在家存放大量现金；汇丰、渣打及中资银行全面遵从美方命令拒绝服务受制裁官员。这证明了二级制裁在国际金融体系中的统治级威慑力。
．对中共的致命打击：彻底击穿了中共高官利用香港离岸金融体系隐匿、转移资产的暗道。不仅断了官员个人的金融活路，更拉高了整个中国金融系统因为专制背书而随时可能遭遇“美元切断”的系统性崩溃风险。
．是什么：2020年7月14日，川普总统依据《美国—香港政策法》第202条签署EO 13936，正式宣布香港不再享有高度自治，全面取消对港优惠待遇：
1.经贸防务：关税与中国内地对齐，全面取消敏感双用技术的出口许可豁免；
2.司法切断：正式终止《美港引渡条约》及移交被判刑人协定；
3.税务与人文：取消航运双重税收豁免，彻底叫停富布赖特（Fulbright）学术交流与警队合作项目；
4.移民签证：启动取消香港护照在签证配额上的特殊独立待遇。
．目的是什么：在行政与监管法规层面将香港直接视同中国内地普通城市，彻底封杀中共利用“两套制度差价”进行政治套利与经济吸血的游隙。
．核心意义：从根本上重构美港行政法律关系。美方不再承认“一国两制”的法律区隔，用最高级别的总统行政命令正式宣告了香港“独立经贸地位”的历史终结。
．对中共的致命打击：摧毁了中共将香港作为“司法引渡工具”、“外汇免税桥头堡”和“敏感技术转运站”的功能，迫使中共及其官僚直接承担全面扼杀香港自治所带来的高昂经济、外交与行政代价。
1.剥离独立标签：海关（CBP）依据第13936号令公告，强制要求所有香港出口美国商品的产地标签，必须由“Made in Hong Kong”彻底修改为“Made in China”；
2.封杀技术通道：商务部（BIS）正式暂停对香港的所有出口许可豁免（License Exceptions），将敏感军民两用技术与高科技管制的标准与中国内地全面拉平。
．目的是什么：从经贸和技术双重维度，堵死中共利用香港模糊地位规避高额关税、走私西方尖端技术并输送至其军工产业的“走私后门”。
．核心事实与法理硬核：在国际法理上彻底剥夺香港的独立经贸身份。面对港府向WTO申诉并获胜的裁决（DS597），美方坚决拒绝妥协撤回，捍卫基于国家安全的管制决定，彻底击碎了中共“既要控制香港，又要骗取西方贸易红利”的妄想。
．对中共的致命打击：毁灭了中共将香港作为“高科技走私中转站”和“规避高关税转口港”的遮羞布功能，从根源上切断了中共借道香港窃取关键战略技术的管道。
．是什么：2020年8月7日，川普政府依据第13936号行政命令及《香港自治法》，由财政部（OFAC）正式将11名中港核心高官列入最高级别的“特别指定国民清单”（SDN List），冻结其在美资产并切断美元结算服务：
o中共驻港与港澳办核心：夏宝龙（港澳办主任）、张晓明（港澳办副主任）、骆惠宁（中联办主任）、郑雁雄（驻港国安公署署长）。
o港府核心高官：林郑月娥（行政长官）、郑若骅（律政司司长）、李家超（保安局局长）、邓炳强（警务处处长）、曾国卫（政制及内地事务局局长）、陈国基（国安委秘书长）、卢伟聪（前警务处处长）。
．目的是什么：直接打击暴政的决策与执行个人，打破“官员作恶、无须承担个人后果”的体制庇护，强迫全球金融系统在中港官僚个人与美元体系之间切断关联。
．核心事实与效果：开创了西方强国直接对特区首长及中共驻港主官实施个人金融封锁的历史先例。林郑月娥等高官被迫公开承认无银行敢为其提供服务、只能领取并在家存放大批现金薪资，彻底刺破了官僚集团在西方金融体系前的强硬伪装。
．对中共的致命打击：直接击中中共官僚利益集团的死穴。它向整个专制体制证明，一旦充当镇压打手，其海外资产配置、子女海外通道及个人金融活路将被彻底截断，极具体制内心理威慑力。

title: China, Thailand pledge closer trade, security ties as Li meets Paetongtarn
zh_title: 李克强会见白东丹时，中国和泰国承诺加强贸易和安全关系

李克强会见白东丹时，中国和泰国承诺加强贸易和安全关系
中国国务院总理李强和泰国总理白东赞同意加快新五年经济规划谈判，加强新能源、半导体等领域合作，加强打击跨境犯罪执法。
2026 年 11 月 13 日 22:57 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 14 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
中国国务院总理李强周五在曼谷会见泰国总理白东丹，这是他对泰国进行正式访问的一部分，双方承诺深化贸易、投资和安全领域的双边关系。
李克强表示，中方愿同泰方高质量推进“一带一路”合作，实施中泰铁路等重大项目，加紧磋商新的五年经贸合作规划。据中国官方媒体报道，他强调了新能源、半导体和人工智能等潜在合作领域的互利共赢。
李克强还表示，中方愿进口更多泰国优质产品，鼓励中国企业赴泰投资。他呼吁泰国为中国企业提供公平、稳定、可预期的营商环境。在安全方面，李克强表示，双方要加强交流，加大打击非法活动的力度。当前国际形势不稳定不确定因素较多，中方愿同泰方密切配合，为世界和平与发展作出贡献。
培东赞表示，泰方愿同中方加强高层交往，扩大双边贸易，深化互利合作。她重申泰国致力于为中国投资者维持良好的营商环境，加强执法和安全合作，包括打击网络赌博和电信诈骗。她还承诺确保中国游客的安全。
会谈后，两国领导人共同见证了多项合作文件的签署。

Saturday, 14 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China, Thailand pledge closer trade, security ties as Li meets Paetongtarn
Chinese Premier Li Qiang and Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra agreed to accelerate talks on a new five-year economic plan, boost cooperation in sectors such as new energy and semiconductors, and strengthen law enforcement against cross-border crimes.
13 Nov 2026 at 22:57 HKT · updated 14 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Chinese Premier Li Qiang met Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra in Bangkok on Friday as part of his official visit to Thailand, where both sides pledged to deepen bilateral ties across trade, investment and security.
Li said China is willing to work with Thailand to advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, implement major projects such as the China-Thailand railway, and step up consultations on a new five-year economic and trade cooperation plan. He highlighted potential collaboration in new energy, semiconductors and artificial intelligence as areas for mutual benefit, according to Chinese state media.
Li also expressed China's readiness to import more high-quality products from Thailand and encouraged Chinese companies to invest in the country. He called on Thailand to provide a fair, stable and predictable business environment for Chinese firms. On security, Li said both sides should strengthen exchanges and intensify efforts to combat illegal activities. Noting ongoing instability and uncertainty in the global situation, he said China is willing to closely coordinate with Thailand to contribute to global peace and development.
Paetongtarn said Thailand is willing to strengthen high-level exchanges with China, expand bilateral trade and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation. She affirmed Thailand's commitment to maintaining a good business environment for Chinese investors and enhancing law enforcement and security cooperation, including cracking down on online gambling and telecom fraud. She also pledged to ensure the safety of Chinese tourists.
Following the talks, the two leaders witnessed the signing of several cooperation documents.

content:
全球 Microsoft 365 中断导致 74 个国家/地区的服务中断 |中国劳工公告栏
星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
全球 Microsoft 365 中断导致 74 个国家/地区的服务中断
11 月 13 日，微软的云生产力套件遭遇大规模全球系统中断，导致至少 74 个国家和地区的电子邮件、消息传递和人工智能服务瘫痪。香港航空公司表示，航班时刻表保持正常，但警告可能出现通讯延误。
据 The Standard 报道，11 月 13 日上午，微软的云生产力套件发生了大规模的全球系统中断，导致至少 74 个国家和地区的电子邮件、消息传递和人工智能服务瘫痪。
尽管 Microsoft 365 云服务在全球范围内出现广泛中断，香港主要客运航空公司确认其航班时刻表于 11 月 13 日保持正常，但航空公司警告旅客可能出现通信延误和后台中断。
这次中断影响了全球用户，电子邮件、消息平台和人工智能工具等服务都无法访问。此次中断的规模至少覆盖 74 个国家，凸显了全球企业和政府运营对微软云基础设施的依赖。
在另一项进展中，英伟达表示，美国的出口管制实际上将其排除在中国人工智能数据中心市场之外，但路透社的一份评论发现，围绕这家美国芯片制造商的受限处理器构建的中国计算项目价值超过 30 亿美元。
特朗普政府发言人表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的人工智能特别工作组成员于周四举行会议，讨论了鼓励美国关键部门报告人工智能网络攻击的方法。
在周五举行的2026星岛全球经济峰会上，香港科技大学计算机科学与工程系讲座教授贾家亚认为，人工智能的发展虽然深刻改变了工作模式，但不会造成大规模失业，而是会创造大量新的就业机会。

Global Microsoft 365 outage disrupts services across 74 countries
A massive global system outage struck Microsoft's cloud productivity suite on 13 November, crippling email, messaging and AI services across at least 74 countries and territories. Hong Kong airlines said flight schedules remained normal but warned of possible communication delays.
A massive global system outage struck Microsoft's cloud productivity suite on the morning of 13 November, crippling email, messaging, and artificial intelligence services across at least 74 countries and territories, according to The Standard.
Hong Kong's major passenger airlines confirmed that their flight schedules remained normal on 13 November following the widespread global disruption across Microsoft 365 cloud services, though carriers warned travellers of possible communication delays and back-office disruptions.
The outage affected users worldwide, with services including email, messaging platforms and AI tools rendered inaccessible. The scale of the disruption, covering at least 74 nations, highlighted the reliance on Microsoft's cloud infrastructure for business and government operations globally.
In a separate development, Nvidia has said US export controls have effectively shut it out of China's AI data-centre market, but a Reuters review has identified more than US$3 billion in Chinese computing projects built around the American chipmaker's restricted processors.
Members of US President Donald Trump's AI task force met on Thursday and discussed ways to encourage critical US sectors to report AI-powered cyberattacks, according to a Trump administration spokesperson.
At the Sing Tao Global Economic Summit 2026 on Friday, Jia Jiaya, Chair Professor of Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, maintained that the development of artificial intelligence will not cause large-scale unemployment despite profoundly shifting work patterns, but rather create numerous new jobs.

禽流感爆发后香港暂停京都家禽进口中国劳工公告栏
星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
禽流感爆发后香港暂停京都家禽进口
H5禽流感爆发后，香港于11月13日暂停从日本京都府进口家禽和鸡蛋。该禁令在日本当局发出通知后立即生效。贸易数据显示，香港进口了约1,030吨冷冻家禽和近250家加工厂
香港食品安全当局已指示本地业界，自 11 月 13 日星期五起立即暂停从日本京都府进口禽肉及相关产品，包括禽蛋。预防性进口禁令是由日本农业当局发出正式通知，报告该县爆发高致病性H5禽流感而触发的，旨在保障全境公共卫生。
食物环境卫生署食物安全中心证实，该措施适用于所有源自京都府的禽肉及禽蛋货物。食品安全监管机构发言人解释说，在日本农林水产省就该地区发生的疾病发出警报后，立即实施了进口管制。
该发言人补充说，该中心已就疫情与日本当局建立了直接沟通，并将在兽医遏制措施的实施过程中保持密切联系。此外，当地官员将密切关注世界动物卫生组织与日本兽医机构发布的最新疫情动态和监测数据，并指出，如果流行病学情况需要，政府将采取进一步的监管应对措施。
政府统计处编制的贸易数据反映，本地对日本家禽供应的需求稳定，今年首九个月，香港从日本进口约1,030吨冷冻家禽肉和约2.4994亿个家禽蛋。
食品安全当局强调，边境管制站仍严格执行标准进口检验协议，以确保只有合规且无病的货物才能到达当地消费者，并建议家禽进口商和餐饮经营者在暂停期间密切监控采购来源。

Hong Kong halts Kyoto poultry imports after avian flu outbreak | China Labour Bulletin Board
Saturday, 14 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong halts Kyoto poultry imports after avian flu outbreak
Hong Kong suspended poultry and egg imports from Japan's Kyoto Prefecture on 13 November after an H5 avian influenza outbreak. The ban, effective immediately, follows a notification from Japanese authorities. Trade data show Hong Kong imported about 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry and nearly 250 mill
Hong Kong food safety authorities have instructed the local trade to suspend the import of poultry meat and related products, including poultry eggs, from Kyoto Prefecture in Japan with immediate effect on Friday 13 November. The precautionary import ban was triggered by an official notification from Japanese agricultural authorities reporting an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza in the prefecture, aimed at safeguarding public health across the territory.
The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department confirmed that the measure applies to all poultry meat and poultry egg consignments originating from Kyoto Prefecture. A spokesman for the food safety watchdog explained that import controls were enacted swiftly following an alert from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Japan regarding the disease occurrence in the region.
The spokesman added that the centre had already established direct communication with Japanese authorities regarding the outbreak and would maintain close contact as veterinary containment measures proceed. In addition, local officials will monitor ongoing epidemic updates and surveillance data published by the World Organisation for Animal Health alongside Japanese veterinary agencies, noting that the government will implement further regulatory responses should the epidemiological situation warrant.
Trade figures compiled by the Census and Statistics Department reflect steady local demand for Japanese poultry supplies, with Hong Kong importing approximately 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry meat and roughly 249.94 million poultry eggs from Japan during the first nine months of this year.
Food safety authorities stressed that standard import inspection protocols remain strictly enforced at border control points to ensure that only compliant and disease-free consignments reach local consumers, advising poultry importers and catering operators to monitor sourcing origins closely during the suspension.

香港金融管理局 (HKMA) 于 11 月 13 日表示，其意识到全球服务中断影响了部分微软服务，并正在密切关注事态及其对银行服务的潜在影响。管理局发言人表示，香港零售银行的所有关键系统，包括存款和转账功能均维持正常运作。金管局表示将继续与银行保持密切沟通并监察事态发展。
金管局提醒市民提高警惕，谨防骗徒利用事件冒充提供技术支持，以获取账户登入资料。它还警告人们不要点击可疑的超链接或向任何人透露支付卡数据、登录密码或一次性密码等敏感信息。
香港银行公会还呼吁公众提高警惕，警惕不法分子利用该事件发送欺诈信息的可能性。该协会表示，诈骗者可能冒充微软、银行或相关机构，利用系统故障或更新作为借口，发送要求立即采取行动的网络钓鱼消息，试图获取个人或财务信息。
该协会呼吁公众在收到据称来自银行的信息时仔细核实发件人的身份，不要点击可疑链接或打开可疑附件。它还建议不要通过未经验证的渠道登录帐户或提供个人信息。任何收到自称来自银行的可疑消息的人应直接联系相关银行以确认其真实性。

Hong Kong banks maintain normal operations amid Microsoft outage, HKMA says
Hong Kong's banking regulator says all retail banks' critical systems are functioning normally after a global Microsoft services outage. The authority warns the public to watch for scammers exploiting the incident, and the Banking Association advises against clicking suspicious links or sharing pers
13 Nov 2026 at 19:52 HKT · updated 14 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on 13 November that it is aware of a global disruption affecting some Microsoft services and is closely monitoring the situation and its potential impact on banking services. A spokesperson for the authority stated that all critical systems of retail banks in Hong Kong, including deposit and transfer functions, are maintaining normal operations. The HKMA said it will continue to maintain close communication with banks and monitor developments.
The HKMA reminded the public to stay vigilant against scammers who may use the incident to pretend to offer technical support in an attempt to obtain account login details. It also warned people not to click on suspicious hyperlinks or disclose sensitive information such as payment card data, login passwords or one-time passwords to anyone.
The Hong Kong Banking Association also urged the public to be alert to the possibility of criminals sending fraudulent messages exploiting the incident. The association said scammers may impersonate Microsoft, banks or related institutions, using system faults or updates as a pretext to send phishing messages that demand immediate action, in an attempt to obtain personal or financial information.
The association called on the public to carefully verify the identity of senders when receiving messages purportedly from banks, and not to click on suspicious links or open questionable attachments. It also advised against logging into accounts or providing personal information through unverified channels. Anyone receiving a suspicious message claiming to be from a bank should contact the relevant bank directly to confirm its authenticity.

星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港报告输入性猴痘病例 男子在海外有高风险接触
香港卫生防护中心正在调查一宗输入性猴痘病例，涉及一名34岁男子，他上周出现症状，目前在医院情况稳定。患者自称在潜伏期内在香港以外地区与其他男性发生高风险性接触
2026 年 11 月 13 日 19:30 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 14 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港卫生防护中心（CHP）11月13日表示，正在调查一起涉及一名34岁男子的输入性猴痘病例。患者上周出现发烧、疲劳和手臂皮疹，随后皮疹扩散到身体的其他部位。周三，他到伊丽莎白女王医院急症室寻求治疗，并入院接受隔离治疗。目前他的病情稳定。
卫生防护中心表示，经其公共卫生化验服务部门检测的临床样本证实，该患者的猴痘病毒呈阳性。根据病人提供的资料，他在潜伏期内在香港境外期间与其他男子发生高风险性接触。卫生防护中心正继续就个案进行流行病学调查，并会向世界卫生组织报告。
卫生防护中心建议高危目标人群接种猴痘疫苗。它还敦促公众保持警惕，避免与疑似感染猴痘的人进行密切身体接触。

Saturday, 14 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong reports imported monkeypox case, man had high-risk contact abroad
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection is investigating an imported monkeypox case involving a 34-year-old man who developed symptoms last week and is now in stable condition in hospital. The patient reported high-risk sexual contact with other men during the incubation period while outside Hong K
13 Nov 2026 at 19:30 HKT · updated 14 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP) said on 13 November it is investigating an imported case of monkeypox involving a 34-year-old man. The patient developed a fever, fatigue and a rash on his arm last week, with the rash later spreading to other parts of his body. He sought treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital's accident and emergency department on Wednesday and was admitted for isolation treatment. His condition is now stable.
The CHP said clinical samples tested by its Public Health Laboratory Services branch confirmed the patient was positive for the monkeypox virus. According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk sexual contact with other men during the incubation period while outside Hong Kong. The CHP is continuing its epidemiological investigation into the case and will report it to the World Health Organization.
The CHP advised members of high-risk target groups to receive the monkeypox vaccine. It also urged the public to remain vigilant and avoid close physical contact with people suspected of being infected with monkeypox.

中美战略稳定未到水深火热
习近平和特朗普在北京同意建立战略稳定的“建设性”关系（在新窗口中打开），并于 9 月在白宫重申了这一方案（在新窗口中打开），近六个月后，两国军队再次进行了对话。然而，在十月的最后一周，中国海军和海岸警卫队船只在日本南部海峡到棉兰老岛附近海域活跃。
这些事实并不矛盾。该框架从未承诺冻结军事竞争，并且根据其实际承诺来判断，它取得的进展不大。问题更窄也更严重：现有的渠道不匹配，可能会发生危险的遭遇。无论意图如何，其结果都是双边平静与地区压力并存。
从承诺的事情开始。根据北京峰会的消息，两军同意“尽快”缔结一份关于危机沟通和预防的备忘录（在新窗口中打开）。白宫情况说明书没有提及此事（在新窗口中打开），据报道，一位美国官员表示（在新窗口中打开）没有讨论该主题。尽管如此，指挥层的接触已经恢复：美国印太司令在加拿大会见了负责台湾海峡的中国同行（在新窗口中打开）。
9月份解放军在台湾周边的空中活动仍低于去年的水平。尽管活动较 8 月有所反弹，但据台湾安全监测机构统计， 9 月份的飞机出动次数为 255 架次，比 2025 年 9 月减少了 43%（在新窗口中打开）。海上压力呈现出不同的景象：10 月 31 日，北京宣布海岸警卫队在台湾东部巡逻（在新窗口中打开），台北对此提出质疑。因此，较少的出动次数提供了不完全的限制措施。
日历现在很重要。
该框架最有力的防御是危机管理使竞争对手能够保持威慑力，同时防止事故升级。美国太平洋陆军仍将 2027 年视为战备基准（在新窗口中打开），尽管路透社 10 月 1 日援引未具名消息人士的话说，美国官员认为 2028 年之前采取军事行动的可能性越来越小（在新窗口中打开）。然而，低于战争门槛的压力仍在继续。 10 月 23 日，台湾海岸警卫队警告说，中国民兵和海岸警卫队的协调行动（在新窗口中打开）正在加大对台湾、日本和菲律宾的压力。

US–China strategic stability doesn’t reach the water
Renewed military dialogue is a step forward, but the channels do not yet reach the coast guards and allies where maritime incidents are most likely.

|US–China strategic stability doesn’t reach the water
US–China strategic stability doesn’t reach the water
Nearly six months after Xi Jinping and Donald Trump agreed in Beijing to build a “constructive” relationship of strategic stability (Opens in new window), a formula they reaffirmed at the White House in September (Opens in new window), their militaries are talking again. Yet in the last week of October, Chinese navy and coast guard ships were active from Japan’s southern straits to the waters off Mindanao.
These facts are not a contradiction. The framework never promised to freeze military competition, and judged against its actual commitments it is making modest progress. The problem is narrower and more serious: the channels that exist do not fit together where dangerous encounters can occur. Whatever the intent, the effect is that bilateral calm and regional pressure coexist.
Start with what was promised. According to Beijing’s summit readout, the two militaries agreed to conclude a memorandum (Opens in new window) on crisis communication and prevention “as soon as possible”. The White House fact sheet did not mention it (Opens in new window), and a US official reportedly said (Opens in new window) the subject was not discussed. Command-level contact has nonetheless resumed: the US Indo-Pacific commander met his Chinese counterpart (Opens in new window) responsible for the Taiwan Strait in Canada.
PLA air activity around Taiwan was still below last year’s level in September. The Taiwan Security Monitor counted 255 sorties in September, 43% fewer than in September 2025 (Opens in new window), although activity rebounded from August. Maritime pressure presents a different picture: on 31 October, Beijing announced coast guard patrols east of Taiwan (Opens in new window), which Taipei challenged. The lower sortie count, therefore, offers an incomplete measure of restraint.
The calendar now matters.
The strongest defence of the framework is that crisis management allows rivals to maintain deterrence while preventing accidents from escalating. US Army Pacific still treats 2027 as a readiness benchmark (Opens in new window), although news agency Reuters reported on 1 October, citing unnamed sources, that US officials considered a military operation before 2028 increasingly unlikely (Opens in new window). Pressure below the threshold of war nevertheless continues. On 23 October, Taiwan’s coast guard warned that coordinated Chinese militia and coast guard operations (Opens in new window) were increasing pressure on Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines.
The harder problem is scope. On 27 October, three Chinese warships and a coast guard ship passed together through Japan’s Osumi Strait, the first time Japan’s defence ministry has disclosed (Opens in new window) the two services travelling together through Japanese waters. Further south, the Liaoning carrier group sailed around the Philippines and did not answer Philippine radio challenges (Opens in new window), although Manila said there was no cause for alarm (Opens in new window). By 28 October, Taipei counted 53 Chinese vessels, 34 of them warships (Opens in new window), between southern Japan and the Philippines.
The Liaoning ran a similar loop (Opens in new window) in October 2024. Ship movements alone do not prove coercion. But the US intelligence community did expect Chinese pressure on Japan to intensify (Opens in new window) through 2026, while US–China channels do not directly connect the vessels involved.
A 2024 exercise between the US Coast Guard and Philippine Coast Guard (Elijah Murphy/DVIDS)
Regional channels do exist. Japan and China opened a defence hotline in 2023 (Opens in new window), and Manila and Beijing agreed in 2024 (Opens in new window) to improve maritime communications, including a future coast guard link. In August, The Interpreter reported that the Japan–China hotline had barely been used (Opens in new window) since its first call in May 2023. Manila said in March that amendments to its coast guard agreement were under discussion (Opens in new window). The gap is not an absence of channels but their coverage, reliability and coordination. A US–China memorandum alone cannot establish procedures for Chinese coast guard captains and Philippine or Japanese commanders when their ships meet.
Two further gaps compound the problem. The first is meaning. Xi has defined stability as including competition within proper limits (Opens in new window), and within days of the summit Beijing’s foreign ministry invoked the leaders’ consensus on Taiwan (Opens in new window). A US military official described Washington’s aim as enabling “both strategic stability and deterrence by denial (Opens in new window)”. Washington views allied exercises as credible deterrence; Beijing can portray them as breaching that consensus.
The second is implementation. Nuclear risk offers another test. US and Chinese officials met at least three times this year (Opens in new window) on the margins of the five nuclear powers’ dialogue, with Washington seeking more advance notice of missile tests. The reported meetings establish engagement, but not a shared launch-notification procedure.
The calendar now matters. Trump is expected in Shenzhen (Opens in new window) for APEC on 18–19 November, and Xi in Miami for the G20 on 14–15 December (Opens in new window).
Two indicators deserve attention. The first is operational: whether both governments agree on the memorandum’s purpose and scope, sign it, and use its procedures when an interception goes wrong. The second is whether the PLA’s November–December peak drill season (Opens in new window) passes without a large exercise around Taiwan. Neither would prove the framework caused restraint, but together they would suggest stability is becoming practice rather than language.
The region should also look beyond the bilateral line. Incidents involving coast guards and allies can also escalate. Extending rules for unplanned encounters to coast guards, and linking allied, regional and US–China channels, would do more for stability than another summit communiqué. Without that, the formula will have stabilised the conversation, not the competition. High-level stabilisation will remain incomplete where maritime incidents are most likely to occur.
Dr Sophie Wushuang Yi is a Postdoctoral Teaching Fellow at Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University. She is also a Non-Resident Research Fellow at the Grandview Institution in Beijing and the Wang Gungwu Visiting Fellow at the ISEAS – Yusof Ishak Institute in Singapore.

The Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will meet on November 18, 2026, and November 19, 2026, as a hybrid meeting via webinar and in person, in connection with a joint meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ) and the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Market (SOM) which is scheduled at the same time via webinar and in person.
November 18, 2026, and November 19, 2026.
The location details of the SEQ and SOM webinar meeting are under the control of the IEA Secretariat, located at 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, France. The in-person meeting will take place at IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, France.
Mr. Matthew Zogby, Acting Assistant General Counsel for International and National Security Programs, Department of Energy, 1000 Independence Avenue SW, Washington, DC 20585, (202) 586-5000, matthew.zogby@hq.doe.gov.
In accordance with section 252(c)(1)(A)(i) of the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (42 U.S.C. 6272(c)(1)(A)(i)) (EPCA), the following notice of meetings is provided:
A meeting of the Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will be held in person and via webinar at the IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, commencing at 9:30 a.m., Paris time, on November 18, 2026. The purpose of this notice is to permit attendance by representatives of U.S. company members of the IAB at a joint meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Market (SOM) and the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ), which is scheduled to be held at the same location in person and via webinar at the same time.
The agenda of the meeting is under the control of the SOM and the SEQ. It is expected that the SOM and the SEQ will adopt the following agenda:
1. Adoption of the Agenda
2. Approval of Summary Record of the 18 June 2026 Meeting of the SEQ/SOM
3. Update on the Current Oil Market Situation
4. Outlook for Global Refining and Fuel Markets
5. Update on Russia/Ukraine Energy Situation
6. Oil Market Update: Trade house perspectives
7. Update on the Tanker Market
8. Middle East—Broader Context and Geopolitics
9. Update on the Global Gas Market
10. China's Response to the Energy Crisis
12. Longer-term Implications of the Energy Crisis
A meeting of the Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will be held in person and via webinar at the IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, commencing at 9:30 a.m., Paris time, on November 19, 2026. The purpose of this notice is to permit attendance by representatives of U.S. company members of the IAB at a meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ), which is scheduled to be held at the same location in person and via webinar at the same time. The IAB will also hold an online preparatory meeting among company representatives at 2:00 p.m., Paris time, on November 10, 2026. The agenda for this preparatory meeting is to review the agenda for the SEQ meeting. In addition, on November 17, 2026, the IEA will hold an Oil Security Workshop at which IAB company representatives may be present.
The agenda of the SEQ meeting is under the control of the SEQ. It is expected that the SEQ will adopt the following agenda
Closed SEQ Session—IEA Member Countries Only
1. Adoption of the Agenda
2. Approval of Summary Record of Meeting of 26 June 2026 SEQ meeting
3. Stockholding Levels of IEA Member Countries
4. IEA Collective Action and Reflections on Oil Security Workshop
Open SEQ Session—Open to Association Countries
5. Recent Oil Market and Policy Developments in Member Countries
6. Emergency and Security Review (ESR) of Japan
7. Mid-term Review Update from Denmark
8. Emergency and Security Review (ESR) of Morocco
9. Mid-term Review Update from Estonia
10. Climate Risks to International Oil & Gas Shipping
11. Update on Ongoing Work on Natural Gas Security
12. Industry Advisory Board Update
13. Update on Critical Minerals Reviews
14. IEA Workshop on Oil Security, Emergency Response, and Stockholding in ASEAN
15. Update on Work with Non-IEA Member Countries
The topic of the IEA's Oil Security Workshop on November 17, 2026, is expected to be “Taking stock of the 2026 oil supply crisis and the IEA Collective Action” with the following agenda:
Setting the scene: How the 2026 oil supply disruption unfolded
What have we learnt about oil markets and what are the implications for oil emergency preparedness?
Reviewing the implementation of the March 2026 IEA Collective Action
Lessons learned from the 2026 oil supply crisis so far (break-out groups)
As provided in section 252(c)(1)(A)(ii) of the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (42 U.S.C. 6272(c)(1)(A)(ii)), the meetings of the IAB are open to representatives of members of the IAB and their counsel; representatives of members of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions and the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Markets; representatives of the Departments of Energy, Justice, and State, the Federal Trade Commission, the General Accounting Office, Committees of Congress, the IEA, and the European Commission; and invitees of the IAB, the SEQ, the SOM, or the IEA.
Signing Authority: This document of the Department of Energy was signed on November 9, 2026, by Daniel Byers, Deputy Assistant Secretary for Europe, Eurasia, Africa and the Middle East, Office of International Affairs, pursuant to delegated authority from the Secretary of Energy. On The World This Week with Gavin Lee, our panel distills the breaking news and global stories of the past 7 days into 45 minutes. Ukraine: Who will speak for Europe? In a week thats seen the first direct talks between Ukraine and Russia since February, with the US in the room and the Europeans relegated to the lobby according to Moscow. A new ‘European Security Architecture’ is discussed.

The Downfall of Jensen Huang

In a week of scandalous headlines of sex, spies and Silicon Valley, revelations mounted about the affairs of Jensen Huang — the so-called Taylor Swift of AI, - which ultimately cost him his job. It leaves significant questions for the White House over the effect of alleged Chinese espionage. Denied by Beijing. We assess the whole affair

European Protests & Election Manouvres

We’ll discuss the ongoing wave of demonstrations, with Spain now making headlines with the first general strike in 14 years taking place over housing and living costs. Here in France, unions rejected the prime minister’s offer to increase the national minimum wage, and Olympic Gold Medal Winning Judoka Teddy Riner throwing his hat on the tatami for a run for the Presidency

zh_title: 我们对中国在台湾周边军事演习的了解
summary: 11 月 5 日，X 上的一篇帖子写道：“刚刚到来：中国接管台湾”，其中有一张动画地图，旨在显示对该岛正在进行的吞并。 “在过去的几个小时里，中国的飞机和海上巡逻队正在关闭对台湾的监视，现在更加明确并证实，任何进出台湾的行动现在都受到中国军事存在的控制，”它补充道。社交媒体用户声称，这段发布于 2026 年 11 月 5 日的视频记录了中国军队在台湾附近进行的演习。但实际上，它对美国的军事行动做出了错误的解释。
content:
11 月 5 日，X 上的一篇帖子写道：“刚刚到来：中国接管台湾”，其中有一张动画地图，旨在显示对该岛正在进行的吞并。 “在过去的几个小时里，中国的飞机和海上巡逻队正在关闭对台湾的监视，现在更加明确并证实，任何进出台湾的行动现在都受到中国军事存在的控制，”它补充道。

 社交媒体用户声称，这段发布于 2026 年 11 月 5 日的视频记录了中国军队在台湾附近进行的演习。然而，实际上，它对正在进行的军事行动提出了错误的解释。资料来源：X.

要显示来自 X (Twitter) 的此内容，您必须启用广告跟踪和受众测量。

动画地图显示，数十架飞机从[中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)起飞，飞往[台湾](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/taiwan/)，包围该岛并将其与空中隔离。与此同时，中国海军的数十艘舰艇似乎也在台湾周围形成严密的封锁。其他船只似乎正在与两艘中国航母“福建”号和“辽宁”号并肩行驶。该地图在多个不同的 X 帖子中获得了超过 700,000 次浏览。

## **由可疑帐户共享的地图**

然而，这种对中国人民解放军演习的解读是有误导性的。
自11月2日以来，中国确实部署了重要的[军事](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/military/)手段。台湾国家安全委员会秘书长[Joseph Wu](https://x.com/josephwutw/status/2117592613905895766?a=Oe0s7ZBTG2fc-4vIjCk&s=20)， 11月3日报道称，中国海军和海警的100艘舰艇在西太平洋。与此同时，台北国防部当天报告称，在台湾附近发现了49架中国军用飞机。

然而，巴黎高等商学院地缘政治系副研究员伊曼纽尔·贝隆表示，这一部署并不意味着对台湾实施了封锁。 “这种说法绝对是错误的，”他说。 “这要么是[影响者](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/influencers/)的夸大其词，要么是中国的宣传声称‘就是这样’，中华人民共和国控制着台湾。”
共享这张地图的帐户之一 Fablex 的传记信息引起了我们的怀疑。虽然个人资料声称 Fablex 位于[加利福尼亚](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/california/)，但 X 帐户的信息显示它位于[乌干达](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/uganda/)。虽然使用VPN有可能改变账户的位置，但这条线索表明——连同对其他主题的其他帖子的分析，其中包括[爱泼斯坦事件](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261012-inside-jeffrey-epstein-s-network-how-favours-money-and-influence-kept-it-running)——它实际上只是一个点击诱饵帐户。这意味着它的目标是通过分享病毒式和耸人听闻的帖子来获得观点。

 Fablex 的账户关于其位置的信息相互矛盾。 © X

## **民用船只仍在台湾周围航行**

台湾国防部在[X](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2119595834820251735?a=h5MvRe3e6Or4tvEbnoo&s=20)上发布的一份报告中还表示，在11月8日至9日的24小时内，只有一架中国飞机被统计到台湾以北——比第49架飞机有所下降

【原文 English Original】
“Just in: China takes over Taiwan,” reads a post on X from November 5, featuring an animated map meant to show the ongoing annexation of the island. “In the past few hours, Chinese aircrafts and marine patrols were closing [sic] monitoring Taiwan and now its more clear and confirmed that any movements to and from Taiwan is now controlled by the Chinese military presence," it added.

 Social media users claimed this video, posted on November 5, 2026, documented Chinese army exercises carried out near Taiwan. However, in reality, it presents an erroneous interpretation of the military actions underway. Source: X.

To display this content from X (Twitter), you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

The animated map shows dozens of planes taking off from continental [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) and flying towards [Taiwan](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/taiwan/), encircling the island and isolating it from the air. Meanwhile, dozens of ships from the Chinese navy also seem to be forming an airtight blockade, surrounding Taiwan. Other ships seem to be moving alongside two Chinese aircraft carriers, the Fujian and the Liaoning. The map garnered more than 700,000 views across several different X posts.

## **Map shared by a suspicious account**

However, this interpretation of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army’s manoeuvres is misleading.

China has indeed deployed significant [military](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/military/) means since November 2. [Joseph Wu](https://x.com/josephwutw/status/2117592613905895766?a=Oe0s7ZBTG2fc-4vIjCk&s=20), the secretary general of Taiwan’s National Security Council, reported on November 3 that 100 ships from the Chinese navy and coast guard were in the western Pacific. Meanwhile, Taipei's Ministry of National Defence reported the same day that 49 Chinese military aircraft had been detected near Taiwan.

However, this deployment does not mean a blockade has been implemented on Taiwan, says Emmanuel Véron, an associate researcher in the geopolitics department at HEC Paris. “This claim is absolutely false,” he said. “It’s either exaggerations made by [influencers](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/influencers/) or Chinese propaganda claiming ‘that’s it’, the People’s Republic of China controls Taiwan.”

Our suspicions were raised by the biographical information on one of the accounts that shared this map, Fablex. While the profile claims Fablex is located in [California](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/california/), the X account's information says it is based in [Uganda](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/uganda/). While it is possible that the location of an account can be altered with the use of a VPN, this clue suggests– along with an analysis of its other posts about, among other topics, [the Epstein affair](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261012-inside-jeffrey-epstein-s-network-how-favours-money-and-influence-kept-it-running)– that it is actually just a clickbait account. That means it aims to get views by sharing viral and sensationalist posts.

 Fablex’s account has contradictory information about its location. © X

## **Civilian ships still moving around Taiwan**

In a report posted on[X](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2119595834820251735?a=h5MvRe3e6Or4tvEbnoo&s=20), the Taiwanese Ministry of National Defence also said that during a 24-hour period between November 8 and 9, just one Chinese aircraft was counted north of Taiwan - a drop from the 49 flights recorded on November 3. On the same day, just eight Chinese ships were spotted near Taiwan. “Eight ships are just not enough to organise a blockade,” Véron says. “It is possible that we are seeing the winding down of these operations.”

According to[MarineTraffic](https://www.marinetraffic.com/en/ais/home/centerx:121.0/centery:23.7/zoom:8), civilian ships have continued to circulate Taiwan. The container ship One Hanoi, for example, left the Kaohsiung port in the south of Taiwan on November 3, during the height of the operations carried out by the People’s Liberation Army around Taiwan. The ship then entered the Taiwan Strait.

 The image above shows the marine traffic around Taiwan on November 3, 2026, which was the day when the highest number of flights by Chinese army aircraft around Taiwan was recorded. The image below shows the trajectory of the container ship One Hanoi on November 3. © MarineTraffic

## **‘Gigantic operation’ on several fronts**

What is China’s goal in carrying out these military manoeuvres? Unlike[last year's](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20251229-china-conducts-large-scale-taiwan-drills-amid-rising-tensions) military drill, Chinese authorities didn’t announce the operations before they began, no doubt by design.

“The aim is to play with communication,” Véron says. “They might make an announcement after the exercises. They also might be trying to remain relatively discreet ahead of the next APEC summit [Editor’s note: Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation], which will be held in China [Editor’s note: on November 18].”

However, Véron does say that the extent of the Chinese military operations underway is unprecedented:

> “For several days now, we’ve seen a gigantic naval operation underway. The different branches of the army are participating, but the naval contingent is actually huge and involves the mobilisation of about a hundred ships from the Chinese navy as well as the Coast Guard and even auxiliary fishing ships across different fronts. And in that, we are seeing a kind of first.”
>
>
> Up until now, the large military exercises aimed at putting pressure on Taiwan largely took place on the side of the island facing China. Now we are seeing operations take place in the north, the south and the centre.”

A map shared by the [Institute for the Study of War](https://understandingwar.org/research/china-taiwan/china-taiwan-update-november-3-2026/), a research organisation based in the United States, showed that on November 3, the Chinese navy was not just deployed around Taiwan but also in the South China Sea, the East China Sea and the Philippine Sea.

 This map shows the deployment of the Chinese navy on November 3. Source: the Institute for the Study of War (ISW)

To display this content from X (Twitter), you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

## **Simulation, not an invasion**

The size of the operations underway does not indicate an imminent invasion of Taiwan, says Véron:

> “We are not going to wake up tomorrow to an operation where Taiwan is being taken by force. This is a ‘drill’, as soldiers say, a training exercise carried out in real geographic and operational conditions. The aim is to simulate a real military operation to train, to test and to exert pressure on the Taiwanese government and Taiwan’s allies. It’s a continuation of the pressure that China has long put on Taiwan.”

content:
中国最高外交官在会见韩国部长时呼吁扩大合作海峡时报
中国最高外交官在会见韩国部长时呼吁扩大合作
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
2026 年 11 月 12 日，中国外交部长王毅出现在中国北京人民大会堂。路透社/Maxim Shemetov
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 晚上 11:19
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 11:19
北京11月13日电外交部长王毅周五表示，中国愿扩大与韩国在人工智能、生物医药等传统和新兴领域的合作。
• 根据中国外交部发布的声明，王毅在会见韩国外长赵贤时表示，两国是“搬不走的近邻”，“保持睦邻友好是双方的正确选择”
• 韩国外交官将于周五开始对中国进行为期两天的访问
• 王说，自去年底两国领导人交往以来，中韩关系“重回正轨”
• 韩国总统李在明的前任尹石烈领导下，两国关系恶化，他拉近了首尔与华盛顿和东京的距离
• 李明博于 2025 年 6 月上任，寻求恢复关系，于 2025 年底在庆州接待中国国家主席习近平，并于 1 月对中国进行国事访问
• 王毅表示，中方愿同韩方进一步增进互信，扩大共同利益
• 下周，韩国总统李在明将访华并出席在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议 路透社

China's top diplomat calls for expanding cooperation in meeting with South Korean minister
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi is seen at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, China, November 12, 2026. REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov
Published Nov 13, 2026, 11:19 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 11:19 PM
BEIJING, Nov 13 - China is willing to expand cooperation with South Korea in traditional and emerging sectors including artificial intelligence and biomedicine, Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Friday.
• In a meeting with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun, Wang said the two countries are "close neighbours that cannot be moved away" and "maintaining good-neighbourliness and friendship is the right choice for both sides," according to a statement released by China's Foreign Ministry
• The South Korean diplomat is on a two-day visit to China starting Friday
• China-South Korea relations were "back onto the right track" after their leaders' exchanges since late last year, Wang said
• Ties soured under Yoon Suk Yeol, the predecessor of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who drew Seoul closer to Washington and Tokyo
• Lee, who took office in June 2025, has sought to restore relations, hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Gyeongju in late 2025 and making a state visit to China in January
• China is willing to further enhance mutual trust with South Korea and expand their common interests, Wang said
• Next week, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will visit China and attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting in Shenzhen REUTERS

zh_title: 黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？
summary: 黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？ |海峡时报 黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展 英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 5 月份在北京向媒体发表讲话，他因成为外国情报机构的目标而受到调查。发布于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 10:05 更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 10:05 黄仁勋在 Nvidia 的辞职引发了人们的担忧，即美国可能会收紧芯片控制，威胁中国获得先进人工智能计算的机会。中国称间谍指控“毫无根据”
content:
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？ |海峡时报
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋五月份在北京向媒体发表讲话，他因成为外国情报机构的目标而受到调查。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 10:05
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 10:05
黄仁勋在英伟达的辞职引发了人们的担忧，即美国可能会收紧芯片控制，威胁中国获得先进人工智能计算的机会。
中国称这些间谍指控“毫无根据”，并表示美国正在利用这些指控作为对中国“技术封锁”的借口。
分析师表示，短期内中国人工智能企业面临的压力可能会增加，但这种冲击也可能会加速国内芯片的发展。
北京 — — 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋突然辞职引发了有关中国获取美国先进人工智能芯片的新问题，北京指责华盛顿利用间谍指控为更严格的技术限制辩护，尽管中国分析人士淡化了潜在影响。
黄仁勋曾亲自游说美国总统唐纳德·特朗普放宽对中国芯片销售的限制，他是保持美国技术流向世界第二大经济体的最直言不讳的倡导者之一。
在美国立法者敦促对中国获取先进计算能力进行更严格控制之际，他的离开可能会削弱华盛顿的这种声音，这可能会增加北京推动半导体自给自足的紧迫性。
中国分析师表示，后果可能是双向的——进一步的限制可能会在短期内限制中国人工智能开发商，同时加强对国内替代品的推动，并为华为等中国芯片制造商创造机会。
黄先生于 11 月 12 日辞职，此前他的婚外情被曝光，其中包括一名被美国官员指控与中国情报部门有联系的中国女性。这标志着他 33 年任期的结束，在此期间，他将 Nvidia 打造成全球领先的人工智能芯片供应商。
他长期以来一直认为，将中国排除在美国芯片技术之外会适得其反，会剥夺美国公司的收入，同时鼓励中国竞争对手开发自己的替代品。
自从黄与一名所谓的中国间谍有牵连的消息传出后，中国外交部一再否认这些间谍指控，称这些指控“毫无根据”，是对中国的“抹黑”。美国官员尚未提供证据证明他们的说法。
在11月12日的例行记者会上，中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，美国“应该停止编造中国间谍故事作为实施技术封锁的借口”，并补充说，中国的技术进步是由自主创新和开放合作驱动的。
中国官方媒体《环球时报》也批评了其所称的对美国科技公司日益增长的政治干预，认为黄的离职反映出越来越多地利用国家安全担忧来限制涉及中国的商业决策。
复旦大学美国研究中心主任吴心伯淡化了这对中国人工智能雄心的潜在影响，他表示，中国已经致力于发展自己的半导体能力，无论华盛顿是否
