Department of Commerce International Trade Administration
Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, Department of Commerce.
The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG) from Taiwan is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is April 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
Applicable November 10, 2026.
Javeria Ali or Jacob Waddell, AD/CVD Operations, Office VI, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0462 or (202) 482-1369, respectively.
This preliminary determination is made in accordance with section 733(b) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act). Commerce published the notice of initiation of this investigation on May 5, 2026.[1] On August 28, 2026, Commerce postponed the preliminary determination of this investigation and the revised deadline is now November 4, 2026.[2]
For a complete description of the events that followed the initiation of this investigation, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.[3] A list of topics ( printed page 72518) included in the Preliminary Decision Memorandum is included as Appendix II to this notice. The Preliminary Decision Memorandum is a public document and is on file electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), which is available to registered users at https://access.trade.gov. In addition, a complete version of the Preliminary Decision Memorandum can be accessed directly at https://access.trade.gov/​frnotices.
The product covered by this investigation is PTMEG from Taiwan. For a complete description of the scope of this investigation, see Appendix I.
In accordance with the Preamble to Commerce's regulations,[4] the Initiation Notice set aside a period of time for parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[5] Certain interested parties commented on the scope of the investigation as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. For a summary of the product coverage comments and rebuttal comments submitted to the record for this preliminary determination, and accompanying discussion and analysis of all comments timely received, see the Preliminary Scope Decision Memorandum.[6] Commerce is preliminarily not modifying the scope language as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. See the scope in Appendix I to this notice.
Commerce is conducting this investigation in accordance with section 731 of the Act. Commerce has calculated export prices in accordance with section 772(a) of the Act. Normal value is calculated in accordance with section 773 of the Act. Pursuant to section 776(a) and (b) of the Act, Commerce has preliminarily relied upon facts otherwise available, with adverse inferences, for Formosa Asahi Spandex Co., Ltd (FAS). For a full description of the methodology underlying the preliminary determination, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.
Sections 733(d)(1)(ii) and 735(c)(5)(A) of the Act provide that in the preliminary determination, Commerce shall determine an estimated all-others rate for all exporters and producers not individually examined. This rate shall be an amount equal to the weighted average of the estimated weighted-average dumping margins established for exporters and producers individually investigated, excluding any zero and de minimis margins, and any margins determined entirely under section 776 of the Act.
In this investigation, Commerce preliminarily assigned a rate based entirely on adverse facts available to FAS. Therefore, the only rate that is not zero, de minimis or based entirely on facts otherwise available is the rate calculated for Dairen Chemical Corporation (Dairen). Consequently, the rate calculated for Dairen is also assigned as the rate for all other producers and exporters.
Commerce preliminarily determines that the following estimated weighted-average dumping margins exist:
Exporter/producer Estimated weighted- average dumping margin (percent) Dairen Chemical Corporation 7.46 Formosa Asahi Spandex Co., Ltd * 26.42 All Others 7.46 * Rate based on facts available with adverse inferences.
In accordance with section 733(d)(2) of the Act, Commerce will direct U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to suspend liquidation of entries of subject merchandise, as described in Appendix I, entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after the date of publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Further, pursuant to section 733(d)(1)(B) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(d), Commerce will instruct CBP to require a cash deposit equal to the estimated weighted-average dumping margin or the estimated all-others rate, as follows: (1) the cash deposit rate for the respondents listed above will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margins determined in this preliminary determination; (2) if the exporter is not a respondent identified above, but the producer is, then the cash deposit rate will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margin established for that producer of the subject merchandise. These suspension of liquidation instructions will remain in effect until further notice.
Commerce intends to disclose its calculations and analysis performed to interested parties in this preliminary determination within five days of any public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b).
Consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(e), Commerce will analyze and, if appropriate, correct any timely allegations of significant ministerial errors by amending the preliminary determination. However, consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(d), Commerce will not consider incomplete allegations that do not address the significance standard under 19 CFR 351.224(g) following the preliminary determination. Instead, Commerce will address such allegations in the final determination together with issues raised in the case briefs or other written comments.
As provided in section 782(i)(1) of the Act, Commerce intends to verify the information relied upon in making its final determination.
Non-scope related case briefs or other written comments may be submitted to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance no later than seven days after the date on which the last verification report is issued in this investigation. Rebuttal briefs, limited to issues raised in the case briefs, may be filed not later than five days after the date for filing case briefs.[7] Interested parties who submit case briefs or rebuttal briefs in this proceeding must submit: (1) a table of contents listing each issue; and (2) a table of authorities.[8]
As provided under 19 CFR 351.309(c)(2)(iii) and (d)(2)(iii), we request that interested parties provide at the beginning of their briefs a public, executive summary for each issue raised ( printed page 72519) in their briefs.[9] Further, we request that interested parties limit their executive summary of each issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. We intend to use the executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the issues and decision memorandum that will accompany the final determination in this investigation. We request that interested parties include footnotes for relevant citations in the executive summary of each issue. Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[10]
Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.310(c), interested parties who wish to request a hearing, limited to issues raised in the case and rebuttal briefs, must submit a written request to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance, U.S. Department of Commerce, within 30 days after the date of publication of this notice. Requests should contain: 1) the party's name, address, and telephone number; 2) the number of participants and whether any participant is a foreign national; and 3) a list of the issues to be discussed. If a request for a hearing is made, Commerce intends to hold the hearing at a time and date to be determined. Parties should confirm by telephone the date, time, and location of the hearing two days before the scheduled date.
Postponement of Final Determination and Extension of Provisional Measures
Section 735(a)(2) of the Act provides that a final determination may be postponed until not later than 135 days after the date of the publication of the preliminary determination if, in the event of an affirmative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by exporters who account for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise, or in the event of a negative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by the petitioner. Section 351.210(e)(2) of Commerce's regulations requires that a request by exporters for postponement of the final determination be accompanied by a request for extension of provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not more than six months in duration.
On August 20, 2026, pursuant to 19 CFR 351.210(e), Dairen requested that Commerce postpone the final determination and that provisional measures be extended to a period not to exceed six months.[11] In accordance with section 735(a)(2)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.210(b)(2)(ii), because: (1) the preliminary determination is affirmative; (2) the requesting exporter accounts for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise; and (3) no compelling reasons for denial exist, Commerce is postponing the final determination and extending the provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not greater than six months. Accordingly, Commerce will make its final determination no later than 135 days after the date of publication of this preliminary determination.
U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) Notification
In accordance with section 733(f) of the Act, Commerce will notify the ITC of its preliminary determination of sales at LTFV. If the final determination is affirmative, the ITC will determine before the later of 120 days after the date of this preliminary determination or 45 days after the final determination whether these imports are materially injuring, or threaten material injury to, the U.S. industry.
This determination is issued and published in accordance with sections 733(f) and 777(i)(1) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.205(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by the investigation is polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG), which is a polymer consisting of linear diols ( i.e., organic chemical compound that has two hydroxyl (- OH) functional groups) with a molecular backbone of repeating tetramethylene units (- CH2CH2CH2CH2-) interconnected through ether bonds ( i.e., a single oxygen atom bonded to two carbon atoms), with a chemical formula HO{(CH2)4}nOH. PTMEG is also referred to as Polytetrahydrofuran, PTHF, Polytetramethylene ether glycol, PTMG, and Polybutylene glycol. PTMEG is typically blended with butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) or another stabilizer such as higher molecular weight hindered phenols or phosphoric acid. In addition to a stabilizer, PTMEG is sometimes blended with a modifier or additive, such as phosphoric acid or sulfuric acid. The scope includes all blends consisting of PTMEG and stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, where the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively account for no more than two percent of the total weight of the PTMEG blend. PTMEG is normally associated with Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number 25190-06-1.
The scope includes all forms of PTMEG, regardless of physical form, purity, molecular weight, number of hydroxyls, number of acids, color, density, softening point, glass transition point, flash point, water content, viscosity, and packaging. PTMEG that has been blended with other products is included within this scope when such blends include constituent parts that have been intermingled but that have not been chemically reacted with each other to produce a different product. For such blends, only the PTMEG component of the mixture, inclusive of any stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively accounting for no more than two percent of the combined weight of the PTMEG component and the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The scope includes merchandise matching the above description that has been processed in a third country, including by commingling, diluting, introducing, or removing stabilizers, modifiers, or additives, or performing any other processing that would not otherwise remove the merchandise from the scope of the investigation if performed in the subject country. The scope also includes PTMEG that is commingled or blended with PTMEG from sources not subject to the investigation. Only the subject component of such commingled products is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The subject merchandise is classifiable in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) under subheading 3907.29.0000. Subject merchandise may also be imported under HTSUS subheadings 2932.11.0000 and 3404.90.5150. Although the HTSUS subheading and CAS registry number are provided for convenience and customs purposes, the written description of the scope is dispositive.

资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的国际消费类电子产品展览会(CES)上发表主题演讲。(2025年1月6日)
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)已辞职，公司董事会在星期四(11月12日)发布的一份新闻稿中宣布了这一消息。就在几天前，黄仁勋承认曾与一名女子发生婚外情；美国情报官员据报怀疑这名女子为中国从事间谍活动。
英伟达在一份声明中感谢黄仁勋“为公司及行业所做出的不可估量的贡献”，并说执行副总裁科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)将担任临时首席执行官。
克雷斯说，“我们将继续推进各项工作，这些工作使英伟达成为加速计算和人工智能领域的领军者，并把握未来机遇，”“我们的工作重心依然是服务我们的客户、合作伙伴、开发者和股东。”
在报道披露黄仁勋与女商人、新加坡科技公司Megaspeed的前高管黄乐(Alice Huang)存在婚外情后，英伟达采取了行动。
美国情报机构据报已认定黄乐曾为中国从事间谍活动，中方则否认了这一指称。
黄仁勋星期日发表声明，向其家人及公司致歉，称自己的行为“没有任何借口”。他承诺将全力配合调查。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)星期一对记者说，联邦调查局正在调查此事。
特朗普说，他与黄仁勋进行了交谈；黄仁勋告诉特朗普，“他完全不知道所涉之人是一名间谍。”
特朗普星期四在其真相社交(Truth Social)网络上发帖说，“既然表现极其出色的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，那么接替他的人选只有一个，那就是苹果公司的蒂姆·库克(Tim Cook)。这叫传奇接替传奇！”
在英伟达成长为产业巨头的过程中，黄仁勋曾就超级智能(通常称人工智能，即AI)相关政策向特朗普进行过咨询。黄仁勋当时寻求获得更大的市场准入，向中国销售公司的芯片。

华盛顿——太空发展局 (SDA) 授予 SpaceX 一份价值近 1000 万美元的合同，研究该公司的激光通信终端如何最好地与该机构的导弹防御相关卫星集成。

SDA 发言人今天告诉 Breaking Defense，该研究将着眼于硬件、软件和连接方面的挑战，包括从该机构的导弹预警跟踪层传输数据、使用 SpaceX 即插即用型或 Plaser 光通信终端 (OCT) 跟踪和瞄准近地轨道 (LEO) 卫星。
Plasers 为太空部队新生的[空间数据网络骨干网](https://breakdefense.com/2026/05/spacex-wins-2-29b-to-speed-space-forces-leo-communications-backbone/) 的核心提供卫星到卫星激光链路，该网络由 SpaceX 建造，旨在提供国防部卫星之间的高速、低延迟通信 - 近期重点关注特朗普卫星政府的[金顶](https://breakingdefense.com/tag/golden-dome/)导弹防御计划。

该合同[周三宣布](https://www.war.gov/News/Contracts/Contract/Article/4645969/contracts-for-nov-10-2026/)价值990万美元，期权价值高达近1270万美元，涵盖截至2027年10月7日的工作，包括完成“降低风险研究、交付代表性硬件以及对导弹预警和跟踪系统的支持”整合”。

SDN 主干网、SDA 跟踪层和正在开发的中地球轨道导弹预警/跟踪卫星之间的连接问题

# SDA explores integration of SpaceX laser communication terminals with missile tracking sats

An SDA spokesperson told Breaking Defense that the new study is a first step, and thus there are a number of potential hardware and software integration pathways for consideration.

By [Theresa Hitchens](https://breakingdefense.com/author/thitchens/) on November 12, 2026 3:23 pm

 L3Harris will provide next-generation technology to support SDA's Accelerated Missile Defense Tranche 3 (AMDT3) mission. (Image: L3Harris)

WASHINGTON — The Space Development Agency (SDA) has awarded SpaceX a contract worth almost $10 million to study how the company’s laser communications terminals can best integrate with the agency’s missile defense related satellites.

The study will look at hardware, software and connectivity challenges with transmitting data from the agency’s Tracking Layer of missile warning, tracking and targeting satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) with the SpaceX Plug and Play, or Plaser, optical communications terminals (OCTs), an SDA spokesperson told Breaking Defense today.

The Plasers provide the satellite-to-satellite laser links at the heart of the Space Force’s nascent [Space Data Network Backbone](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/05/spacex-wins-2-29b-to-speed-space-forces-leo-communications-backbone/), being built by SpaceX to provide high speed, low latency communications between Defense Department satellites ― with a near-term focus on the Trump administration’s [Golden Dome](https://breakingdefense.com/tag/golden-dome/) missile defense initiative.

The contract, [announced on Wednesday,](https://www.war.gov/News/Contracts/Contract/Article/4645969/contracts-for-nov-10-2026/) is worth $9.9 million with options worth up to nearly $12.7 million and covers work through Oct. 7, 2027, including completion of a “risk reduction study, the delivery of representative hardware, and support to missile warning and tracking system integration.”

Issues with connectivity between the SDN Backbone, SDA’s Tracking Layer and the medium Earth orbit missile warning/tracking satellites being developed by Space Systems Command (SSC) now are a key concern for the Space Force. [As first reported by Breaking Defense,](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/11/key-space-force-satellites-cant-talk-to-each-other-likely-requiring-1b-solution-sources/) the OCTs on those constellations are incompatible because they each use a difference optical waveform standard for data transmission.

One approach for integrating SDA’s Tracking Layer with the Plasers, experts previously told Breaking Defense, is to place SDA OCTs on board translator satellites, called [Space Exchange Points,](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/11/key-space-force-satellites-cant-talk-to-each-other-likely-requiring-1b-solution-sources/) being developed by SSC to link its missile tracking/warning birds to the SDN Backbone. Other approaches include buying Plasers to equip future Tracking Layer birds or even developing new transmission standards.

The SDA spokesperson said the new study is a first step, and thus there are a number of potential hardware and software pathways for consideration.

title: What Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit means for Washington, Wall Street, and Beijing
zh_title: 黄仁勋退出英伟达对华盛顿、华尔街和北京意味着什么
summary: 黄仁勋退出 Nvidia 对华盛顿、华尔街和北京意味着什么 - 大西洋理事会东亚科技与创新美国和加拿大 黄仁勋退出 Nvidia 对华盛顿、华尔街和北京意味着什么 有很多事情需要处理。周四，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因婚外情报道而辞职，其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情。但其影响超出了该人和他的前公司的范围，该公司因其领先的计算机处理器而成为人工智能（AI）繁荣的关键引擎。下面，大西洋理事会的专家们
content:
黄仁勋退出英伟达对华盛顿、华尔街和北京意味着什么 - 大西洋理事会
东亚科技与创新美国和加拿大
黄仁勋退出英伟达对华盛顿、华尔街和北京意味着什么
有很多事情需要处理。周四，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因婚外情报道而辞职，其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情。但其影响超出了该人和他的前公司的范围，该公司因其领先的计算机处理器而成为人工智能（AI）繁荣的关键引擎。下面，大西洋理事会专家将探讨人事变动如何影响美国政策、全球市场等。
今天为您带来的专家反应
Trisha Ray：地质技术中心副主任兼常驻研究员
Graham Brookie (@GrahamBrookie)：技术项目和战略副总裁
Jessie Yin：地缘经济中心副主任
Kenton Thibaut (@kentonthibaut)：数字取证研究实验室中国高级研究员
Trisha 解释道，英伟达的先进芯片是“美国减缓对手人工智能能力的关键”。但这种优势也是“单点故障”，因为美国的出口管制力度取决于少数公司及其内部人员的安全措施。
格雷厄姆认为，这一事件并不是美国情报部门的失败，“而是美国政府在管理国家安全威胁方面协调和政策执行方面的更广泛的失败”。由于人工智能行业容易受到知识产权盗窃和直接攻击，华盛顿在风险管理和出口政策执行方面“措手不及”。
“对于投资者来说，将英伟达的成功与黄仁勋分开是很困难的，而对于华盛顿来说，将英伟达与国家安全分开也几乎同样困难，”杰西说。她现在认为国会有机会对该公司对国家安全的影响进行更大的监督，并加强半导体出口管制。肯顿指出，国会对芯片限制的势头不断增强，例如《人工智能监督法案》、《芯片安全法案》和《匹配法案》。
展望未来，特丽莎敦促政府加强审查。她认为，“鉴于支持美国人工智能领先地位的公司很少，政策制定者应该认真考虑政府的直接监督”，例如对公司领导层及其主要客户的安全许可要求，以及对出口实体的安全审计作为出口许可证的先决条件。
由于英伟达股价下跌，今天市场小幅下跌。黄仁勋的离开让投资者怀疑，如果没有这位已成为其成功代名词的领导者，英伟达能否维持其主导地位。杰西推测，公司“将在一段时间内不稳定”。
这些股份比英伟达的股价还要高。格雷厄姆警告说，美国经济已经高度依赖于少数人工智能公司的命运，这些公司“也恰好是该国在地缘政治竞争的决定性领域中的主要战略资产”。其中一个失败可能会影响整个美国经济和国家安全生态系统。
除了销售芯片之外，英伟达还成为人工智能热潮的主要融资者——被称为“人工智能中央银行”——投资初创企业并为购买其产品的客户提供支持。杰西表示，未来几个月将展示“英伟达对人工智能需求本身的整合程度如何”。

What Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit means for Washington, Wall Street, and Beijing - Atlantic Council
East Asia Technology & Innovation United States and Canada
What Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit means for Washington, Wall Street, and Beijing
It’s a lot to process. On Thursday, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. But the implications extend beyond the man and his former company, a critical engine of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom because of its leading-edge computer processors. Below, Atlantic Council experts work through how the personnel shakeup could impact US policy, global markets, and more.
TODAY’S EXPERT REACTION BROUGHT TO YOU BY
Trisha Ray: Associate director and resident fellow at the GeoTech Center
Graham Brookie (@GrahamBrookie): Vice president for technology programs and strategy
Jessie Yin: Associate director with the GeoEconomics Center
Kenton Thibaut (@kentonthibaut): Senior resident China fellow at the Digital Forensic Research Lab
Nvidia’s advanced chips are “the linchpin of the United States’ leverage in slowing down the AI capabilities of its adversaries,” Trisha explains. But that advantage is also “a single point of failure,” since US export controls are only as strong as the security practices of a handful of companies and people within them.
Graham sees the incident not as a failure in US intelligence, “but rather a broader failure of coordination and policy execution in how the US government manages national security threats.” With the AI industry vulnerable to intellectual property theft and direct targeting, Washington was “caught flat footed” in risk management and export policy enforcement.
“As difficult as it is for investors to separate Nvidia’s success from Jensen Huang, it has become nearly as difficult for Washington to separate Nvidia from national security,” Jessie argues. She now sees an opening for Congress to exert greater oversight of the company’s impact on national security and tighten semiconductor export controls. Kenton points to growing momentum in Congress behind chip restrictions such as the AI Overwatch Act, the Chip Security Act, and the MATCH Act.
Going forward, Trisha urges greater government scrutiny. “Given how few companies underpin the US AI lead, policymakers should seriously consider direct government oversight,” she argues, such as security clearance–like requirements for company leadership and their major customers, as well as security audits of the exporting entities as a precondition for export licenses.
Markets were down slightly today, as Nvidia shares took a hit. Huang’s departure has investors wondering if Nvidia can sustain its dominance without the leader who became a synonym to its success. The company is “going to be unsteady for a while,” Jessie surmises.
The stakes are higher than Nvidia’s stock price alone. The US economy is already highly exposed to the fortunes of a handful of AI companies that “also happen to be the country’s primary strategic assets in a determinative domain of geopolitical competition,” Graham warns. A failure at one could reverberate across the US economy and national security ecosystem.
Beyond selling chips, Nvidia has become a major financier of the AI boom—known as “the central bank of AI”—investing in startups and supporting customers that buy its products. Jessie says that the coming months will show “how integral Nvidia has become to AI demand itself.”
Sign up to receive rapid insight in your inbox from Atlantic Council experts on global events as they unfold.
Ahead of a planned meeting next week between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Beijing warned Washington earlier today against further technology restrictions, Kenton notes.
Huang had long opposed strict export controls and was able to speak with both Trump and Xi. “But with Huang out of the picture, there is potentially more political leeway to push forward on a more hawkish approach,” Kenton says.
Jessie adds that the scandal has “permanently damaged the company’s credibility to push back on export controls,” relationships aside.
But tougher controls could invite retaliation, Kenton warns. “Beijing could answer new restrictions with curbs on critical minerals or probes of other American firms,” potentially complicating the upcoming Trump-Xi meeting.

content:
阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰“迈克尔·墨菲”号 (DDG 112) 搭载直升机海上打击中队 (HSM) 第 71 分遣队，在美国第 3、第 7 和第 5 舰队作战区域部署了 11 个月后返回其夏威夷珍珠港-希卡姆联合基地的母港，特别是在史诗狂怒行动期间的持续战斗行动， 11 月 12 日。

迈克尔·墨菲号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开珍珠港，作为第 21 驱逐舰中队 (DESRON) 下的第 3 航母战斗群 (CSG) 3 的一部分，与旗舰尼米兹级航空母舰亚伯拉罕·林肯号 (CVN 72)、阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号 (DDG 111) 和小弗兰克·彼得森号 (DDG) 一起行动121）和舰载机联队（CVW）9。

迈克尔·墨菲号于 2026 年 1 月下旬进入美国中央司令部责任区，该舰在史诗愤怒行动的前线服役。

为了表彰迈克尔·墨菲号航空母舰及其船员在执行数十次战斧对地攻击巡航导弹袭击以及防御敌方无人机和导弹攻击时所表现出的非凡英雄主义和战斗成就，被授予总统集体奖章（PUC）和战斗行动绶带（CAR）。
“迈克尔·墨菲号的水手们在这次部署中表现出了无与伦比的勇气、专业精神和卓越的作战能力，”海军中校说。大卫·尼古拉斯，迈克尔·墨菲的指挥官。 “无论是击败来袭的空中和地面威胁，还是通过有争议的咽喉要道领导行动，这支部队都毫不犹豫。他们响应了我们国家的每一个召唤，保卫了我们的盟友，不辜负英雄的同名。我为这支部队感到无比自豪。”

在整个部署过程中，迈克尔·墨菲在北阿拉伯海、阿曼湾和霍尔木兹海峡执行 60 年来首次海上封锁中发挥了重要作用。作为第 50 特遣部队 (TF-50) 水面行动小组指挥官，迈克尔·墨菲指挥并协调了 14 艘联军和美国船只的防御，包括驱逐舰、濒海战斗舰、六艘美国海岸警卫队快速反应快艇和后勤舰队加油船。该船在水面、空中和水雷攻击的威胁下完成了 12 次有争议地通过霍尔木兹海峡，护送四艘商船到达安全地带。
在为期 11 个月的部署过程中，迈克尔·墨菲仍然留在战区，并继续在 TF-50 的领导下与 CSG-10 和 CSG-5 的参谋人员、舰艇和飞机一起行动。该舰航行了超过 97,000 海里，进行了 43 次海上补给和 8 次战斗港口加油，运输了超过 800 万加仑的 F-76 船用柴油和 200 万加仑的 JP-5 喷气燃料。该舰在战斗条件下安全接收了 1,100 托盘食品、物资、维修零件和邮件。

直升机海上打击中队（HSM）第71第2支队飞行330架次，无事故飞行900多个小时，其中战斗飞行273.4小时。

在美国第七舰队服役期间，迈克尔·墨菲在南中国海和菲律宾海开展了战区水面和反潜行动，为盟友提供了保障，并对我们的对手提供了威慑。

作为美国太平洋舰队的一个组成部分，美国第三舰队领导该地区的海军部队，并提供必要的现实、相关的训练，以在从作战行动到人道主义援助和救灾等全方位的军事行动中履行我们海军的职责

【原文 English Original】
Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Michael Murphy (DDG 112), with embarked Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron (HSM) 71 Detachment 2, returned to its homeport of Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Hawaii following an 11-month deployment to the U.S. 3rd, 7th, and 5th Fleet areas of operations, highlighted by sustained combat actions during Operation Epic Fury, Nov. 12.

Michael Murphy departed Pearl Harbor Dec. 1, 2025, operating as part of Carrier Strike Group 3 (CSG) 3 under Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 21, operating alongside flagship Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72), Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyers USS Spruance (DDG 111) and USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. (DDG 121), and Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 9.

Michael Murphy entered the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility in late January 2026, where the warship served on the front lines of Operation Epic Fury.

In recognition of extraordinary heroism and combat achievement while executing dozens of Tomahawk land-attack cruise missile strikes and defending against hostile drone and missile attacks, USS Michael Murphy and its crew were awarded the Presidential Unit Citation (PUC) and the Combat Action Ribbon (CAR).

“The Sailors of Michael Murphy demonstrated unmatched grit, professionalism, and warfighting excellence during this deployment,” said Cmdr. David Nicolas, commanding officer of Michael Murphy. “Whether defeating incoming air and surface threats or leading operations through contested choke points, this crew never hesitated. They answered every call of our nation, defended our allies, and lived up to the heroic namesake. I could not be prouder of this crew.”

Throughout the deployment, Michael Murphy played an essential role in enforcing the first naval blockade in 60 years, operating in the North Arabian Sea, Gulf of Oman, and Strait of Hormuz. Serving as Surface Action Group Commander for Task Force 50 (TF-50), Michael Murphy commanded and coordinated the defense of 14 coalition and U.S. vessels, including destroyers, Littoral Combat Ships, six U.S. Coast Guard Fast Response Cutters, and logistics fleet oilers. The ship completed 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz under threat of surface, air, and mine attack, escorting four merchant tankers to safety.

Over the course of the 11-month deployment Michael Murphy remained in theater and continued to operate under TF-50 leadership, alongside the staffs, ships, and aircraft of CSG-10 and CSG-5. The warship steamed more than 97,000 nautical miles, conducted 43 replenishments-at-sea and eight combat in-port refuelings, transferring over 8 million gallons of F-76 marine diesel fuel and 2 million gallons of JP-5 jet fuel. The ship safely received 1,100 pallets of food, stores, repair parts, and mail under combat conditions.

The air detachment of Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron (HSM) 71 Detachment 2 flew 330 sorties and over 900 mishap-free flight hours, including 273.4 combat flight hours.

While operating in U.S. 7th Fleet, Michael Murphy conducted theater surface and anti-submarine operations in the South China and Philippine Seas, assuring allies and providing deterrence to our adversaries.

An integral part of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, U.S. 3rd Fleet leads naval forces in the region and provides the realistic, relevant training necessary to execute our Navy's role across the full spectrum of military operations – from combat operations to humanitarian assistance and disaster response. U.S. 3rd Fleet works together with allies and partners to advance freedom of navigation and overflight, the rule of law, and other principles that underpin security for the region.

title: Destroyer returns from 11-month-deployment
zh_title: 驱逐舰结束 11 个月的部署返回
summary: 夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。斯普鲁亚
content:
夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。另一艘阿利伯克级驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号在经过 12 个月的部署后于今天返回家园，驻日本的约翰·芬恩号船员被告知预计将进行 13 至 14 个月的部署。正如《防务一号》10 月 22 日报道的那样，海军官员告诉家属，在可预见的未来，部署时间预计为 10 到 10 个月，这与近几十年来典型的 7 个月部署形成鲜明对比。海军最高军士长、海军军士长约翰·佩里曼 (John Perryman) 一周后证实了这一点，并表示至少在未来几年内，10 至 11 个月将成为常态。迈克尔·墨菲号中校表示，“迈克尔·墨菲”号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开夏威夷，穿过南中国海和马六甲海峡，然后到达北阿拉伯海，并在那里度过了大部分部署时间。大卫·尼古拉斯一个月前接任这艘驱逐舰的指挥。
尼古拉斯说，“迈克尔·墨菲”号在“史诗狂怒”行动期间发动了“战斧”导弹袭击，并参与了霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。“我非常自豪能够成为这个团队的一员，”他说。 “这是我有幸共事过的最有韧性的团队。”尼古拉斯此前指挥过另一艘导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号。据海军新闻稿称，当他于 9 月 10 日将掌权交给继任者时，他将成为罗德岛州水面作战学校的教官。但一名海军官员向《国防一号》证实，当“迈克尔·墨菲”号的前任上司中校改变了他的计划。凯特琳·坎宁安 (Caitlin Cunningham) 在执掌约 11 个月后，因“失去信心”而于 9 月 27 日被解职。在周四的返校节上，三等士官杰西·布莱森第一个下船，成为“初吻”抽奖的获胜者。他和妻子阿里安娜·里奥斯站在一起，开玩笑说这次部署涉及“大量的水”。 “加入海军，看看世界——但世界 70% 都是水，”他笑着说。但是，他补充说，工作人员很棒。 “我认为你可以把这艘船上的任何人放在任何其他船上，他们都会脱颖而出，”布莱森说。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii —After a 346-day deployment that included operations in the South China Sea, 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz, 43 replenishments at sea and the removal of its commander 10 months in, the guided-missile-destroyer Michael Murphy returned home Thursday, welcomed by hula dancers and a rainbow stretching over the channel. The ship was attached to the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group for much of its deployment, though the aircraft carrier returned to its home in San Diego on Oct. 8. But any deployment-length records it may have broken were short lived. The Spruance, another Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, returned home today after a 12-month deployment, and the Japan-based John Finn crew has been told to expect a 13- to 14-month deployment. As Defense One reported on Oct. 22, Navy officials have told families to expect 10- to 10-month deployments for the foreseeable future—a stark contrast from the typical 7-month deployments of recent decades. The Navy’s top enlisted sailor, Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy John Perryman, confirmed that a week later, saying 10-11 months will be the norm for at least a few years. The Micheal Murphy left Hawaii on Dec. 1, 2025, and sailed through the South China Sea and Strait of Malacca before reaching the North Arabian Sea, where it spent the bulk of the deployment, said Cmdr. David Nicolas, who took command of the destroyer a month ago. The Michael Murphy launched Tomahawk missile strikes during Operation Epic Fury and took part in the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Nicolas said. “I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team,” he said. “This is the most resilient crew that I’ve had the pleasure to serve with.” Nicolas previously commanded the Oscar Austin, another guided-missile destroyer. When he handed over the helm to his successor on Sept. 10, he was slated to become an instructor at Surface Warfare Schools in Rhode Island, according to a Navy press release . But a Navy official confirmed to Defense One that his plans were changed when the Michael Murphy’s previous boss, Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham, was relieved on Sept. 27 due to a “loss of confidence” after roughly 11 months in charge.    At Thursday’s homecoming, Petty Officer 3rd Class Jesse Bryson was first off the ship, as the winner of the “first kiss” raffle. Standing with his wife, Arianna Rios, he joked that the deployment involved “a lot of water.” “Join the Navy, see the world—but the world is 70-percent water,” he said with a laugh. But, he added, the crew was great. “I think you could put anyone from this ship on any other ship and they’d stand out,” Bryson said. ]]>

title: Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India
zh_title: 日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约
summary: 日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约 - 《日本时报》2016 年 11 月在东京举行的日本与印度和平利用核能合作条约签署仪式上，日本尚未充分利用与印度首相安倍晋三（右）和印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（左二）签署的核电设备出口条约。 | JIJI X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 新德里——从日本出口核电站设备方面尚未取得具体进展
content:
日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约 - 日本时报
日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约
2016 年 11 月，日本首相安倍晋三（右）和印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（左二）在东京举行的日本与印度和平利用核能合作条约签字仪式上。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
新德里 — — 自十年前两国签署和平利用核能合作条约以来，日本向印度出口核电站设备方面尚未取得具体进展。
尽管印度已经建立了法律框架，使外国公司更容易向该国供应核电站，因为政府寻求扩大核电站的装机容量或最大潜在电力输出。
该条约于2016年11月签署，并于2017年7月生效，允许日本出口核电技术和设备。印度的核责任法是阻碍日本核电站出口的因素之一。
该法律规定，不仅核电站运营商，而且设备供应商也要对核事故造成的损害承担责任。该规定阻碍了公司进入该行业。
去年12月，印度制定了一项法律，允许设备供应商避免承担责任，除非他们通过合同协议明确承担责任。该法律还部分允许包括外国公司在内的公司建造和运营核电站。
“出口机会可能会扩大，包括通过与外国制造商合作，”行业组织日本原子工业论坛的一位官员表示。该组织表示，日本公司有向美国制造的核电站供应设备的记录。
目前，印度有24座核反应堆在运行，总装机容量约为8.78吉瓦。纳伦德拉·莫迪总理政府的目标是到 2047 年印度独立 100 周年时将装机容量提高到 100 吉瓦。
莫迪政府还计划到 2070 年将温室气体排放量减少到净零。
印度海得拉巴市沃克森大学副教授达亚·香卡 (Daya Shankar) 表示：“运行中温室气体排放量可以忽略不计的核电对于这条道路是不可或缺的。”
该核合作条约在签署时在日本国内引起了争议，因为这意味着日本这个唯一遭受原子武器袭击的国家将被允许向印度这个非《核不扩散条约》成员国的核国家出口核电站。
香卡表示，2011 年福岛县核事故发生后，“日本国内政治中的反核情绪依然强烈”。他补充说，任何“向非《不扩散核武器条约》签署国出口核技术的举动都会招致国内的尖锐批评”。
环保主义者E.A.S.反对日印条约的前印度政府官员萨尔马表示，“请思考一下核电站会给当地社区的生活造成的破坏，以及当核电站发生时，它如何使大片人口稠密的地区遭受类似福岛灾难的祸害。”

【原文 English Original】
Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India - The Japan Times
Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India
Prime Minister Shinzo Abe (right) and India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi (second from left) at a signing ceremony for a treaty of cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy between Japan and India, during November 2016 in Tokyo. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
New Delhi – No concrete progress has been made in exporting nuclear power plant equipment from Japan to India since the two countries signed a treaty of cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy a decade ago.
This is despite India having established a legal framework that made it easier for foreign firms to supply nuclear plants to the country as the government seeks to expand the installed capacity, or the maximum potential output of electricity, of nuclear plants.
The treaty, which allows Japan to export nuclear power technology and equipment, was signed in November 2016 and took effect in July 2017. One of the factors hindering Japan’s nuclear power plant exports had been India’s nuclear liability law.
The law stipulated that not only plant operators but also equipment suppliers would be held liable for damage from nuclear accidents. The provision discouraged companies from entering the business.
In December last year, India established a law that allows equipment vendors to avoid liability unless they explicitly assume it through contractual agreements. The law also partially allows companies, including foreign firms, to build and operate nuclear power plants.
“Export opportunities may expand, including through collaboration with foreign manufacturers,” said an official at Japan Atomic Industrial Forum, an industry group. The group said that Japanese firms have a track record of supplying equipment to U.S.-made nuclear power plants.
Currently, 24 nuclear reactors are in operation in India, with a total installed capacity of approximately 8.78 gigawatts. The administration of Prime Minister Narendra Modi has a goal of boosting that capacity to 100 gigawatts by 2047, when India marks its 100th year of independence.
The Modi administration also aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to net zero by 2070.
“Nuclear power, with negligible operational greenhouse gas emissions, is indispensable to that pathway,” said Daya Shankar, associate professor at Woxsen University in the Indian city of Hyderabad.
The nuclear cooperation treaty caused a controversy in Japan at the time of its signing because this meant that Japan, the only country hit by atomic weapons, would be allowed to export nuclear plants to India, a nuclear state that is not a member of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).
“Antinuclear sentiment remains strong within Japan’s domestic politics” following the 2011 nuclear accident in Fukushima Prefecture, Shankar said. Any “move to export nuclear technology to a non-NPT signatory invited sharp domestic criticism,” he added.
Environmentalist E.A.S. Sarma, a former Indian government official who opposed the Japan-India treaty, said, “Please ponder over the disruption that a nuclear power plant will cause in the lives of the local communities and how it exposes vast stretches of thickly populated areas to the scourge of a Fukushima-like disaster, as and when it happens.”

台湾官员称，中国在太平洋进行未经宣布的演习，以进行“无声恐吓”
去年12月30日，北京，一块大屏幕上播放着中国“正义使命2025”环台军演的新闻报道。台北官员表示，中国本月初在西太平洋和台湾周边地区进行了一次大规模、未经宣布的军事演习。 |路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
台北 — — 中国于 11 月初在西太平洋和台湾周边地区进行了一次大规模、未经宣布的军事演习，台北官员称这是一场“无声恐吓”活动，旨在在重大国际会议之前向台湾和其他国家政府施压。
一名因此事敏感性而要求匿名的台湾高级安全官员表示，中国军队和海岸警卫队本月初曾在该地区集结了 100 多艘船只，进行演习，其中包括模拟攻击包括台湾在内的其他军队和城市。
这位官员表示，此次海军部署规模超过“正义使命2025”，这是中国近一年前最后一次正式命名的针对台湾的演习，也是迄今为止中国最大规模的海军部署之一。

China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘silent intimidation’ push: Taiwan officials - The Japan Times
China stages unannounced Pacific drills in ‘silent intimidation’ push: Taiwan officials
A giant screen shows a news report on China's "Justice Mission 2025" military drills around Taiwan, in Beijing on Dec. 30 last year. Taipei officials said China carried out a large, unannounced military exercise across the western Pacific and around Taiwan early this month. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
TAIPEI – China carried out a large, unannounced military exercise across the western Pacific and around Taiwan in early November, in what officials in Taipei have described as a campaign of “silent intimidation” aimed at pressuring Taiwan and other governments before major international meetings.
A senior Taiwan security official, speaking on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter, said China’s military and coast guard had at one point massed more than 100 vessels in the region early this month, conducting drills that included simulated attacks on other militaries and cities including Taiwan’s.
The naval deployment was larger than “Justice Mission 2025,“ China’s last formally named drills targeting Taiwan nearly a year ago and one of the largest Chinese naval deployments to date, the official said.

（中央社台北13日電）據美聯社報導，獲美國政治庇護的六四民運人士唐元雋，承認代表中國政府從事間諜活動，並監控位在紐約的中國民運人士長達5年。他12日在曼哈頓聯邦法院被判3年刑期，但獲得緩刑的處分。
現年69歲的唐元雋，多年來公開批評中國共產黨。他於2025年9月認罪，承認未按規定向美國司法部長辦公室登記為「中華人民共和國代理人」；他也承認受中國政府指使，對其他異議人士進行長達5年的監視。
唐元雋透過參與在曼哈頓中國領事館外舉行的每月抗議活動，並於2002年在居住地紐約皇后區法拉盛創辦一家非營利組織，贏得海外民運圈內人士的信任。
檢方指出，唐元雋至少在2018年至2023年間，向中國當局提供了數十人的相關訊息；他甚至讓一名中方聯絡人混入一個名為「中國民主黨之友」的線上群組，該群組由唐元雋發起，成員包括140名美籍華人。
唐元雋的辯護律師表示，唐元雋是一名民主倡導者、作家和活動人士，他當時非常渴望回中國探望患病的父母和兄弟，並因此與一名聲稱能幫他實現這一願望的人建立了聯繫。
唐元雋透過一名翻譯向法官表示，他違背了自己的政治信念，前往中國是為了「再見父母一面」。他說：「我對自己做的一切深感悔恨」，承認「我的行為給他人造成了一定的傷害」。
唐元雋曾參與1989年由學生主導的六四運動，因而在中國被關押12年。2002年，他出逃至台灣，隨後前往美國並獲得政治庇護。2018年7月，歸化成為美國公民。
此後，唐元雋開始向中國國家安全部提供情報，每年獲得約4200美元的報酬，於2024年10月被捕。在此之前，美國對中國試圖騷擾和壓制海外異議人士的行為展開多項調查，聯邦官員稱之為「跨國鎮壓」的一部分。（編輯：朱建陵/楊昇儒）1151113

（中央社記者李雅雯上海13日電）中國國防部新聞發言人陳曦今天表示，中美兩國防務部門保持溝通協調，妥善管控分歧。對於美國戰爭部長赫格塞斯、美國太平洋司令部司令帕帕羅可能訪問中國的消息未加以回應。
據央視新聞13日報導，記者提問中美兩軍近期多次互動，還有赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）、帕帕羅（Samuel Paparo）近期可能訪問中國的消息，「請介紹中美兩軍交往有關情況」。
陳曦回應，中美兩軍於11月2至3日在華盛頓舉行第4次危機溝通與預防工作組會議，雙方對於落實兩國元首共識、加強溝通交流、避免誤解誤判等深入交換意見。中美兩軍保持關係穩定、健康、可持續發展符合雙方共同利益，也是國際社會的普遍期待。
他說，中方重視中美兩軍戰略溝通，兩國防務部門就各層級交流對話保持著溝通協調。希望美方與中方一道，共同落實好兩國元首重要共識，加強溝通對話，妥善管控分歧，為構建中美建設性戰略穩定關係增添積極因素。
陳曦對於赫格塞斯、帕帕羅近期可能訪問中國的消息未加以證實與回應。
南華早報先前報導，美中關係全國委員會會長歐倫斯（Stephen Orlins）6日在中國海南三亞舉行的全球海洋合作與治理論壇上透過視訊談話透露，赫格塞斯、帕帕羅可能很快會訪問中國。歐倫斯認為，兩人訪中將有助於推動兩軍溝通機制常態化。
帕帕羅倘若訪中，將是美國太平洋司令部司令自2015年以來首次訪中。在美國共和黨期中選舉失利後，相關安排是否有所改變尚不清楚。（編輯：廖文綺）1151113

中華亞太菁英交流協會13日舉行「誰的孫中山？—中共紀念大會的對台統戰」座談會，由中華亞太菁英交流協會秘書長王智盛（右1）主持，由右2至左與會學者分別為國父紀念館研究典藏組研究員鍾文博、中央研究院近代史研究所兼任研究員陳儀深、台灣師範大學東亞學系教授范世平、國防安全研究院國家安全研究所副研究員王占璽、台北海洋科技大學通識教育中心助理教授吳瑟致。中央社記者廖文綺攝 115年11月13日
（中央社記者廖文綺台北13日電）中共昨天舉辦「紀念孫中山先生誕辰160週年大會」，學者分析，中共自稱是孫中山的繼承者，卻迴避其民權與共和精神；此時大張旗鼓紀念孫中山，是將孫中山作為兩岸連結的政治符號，擴大對台統戰宣傳。
中華亞太菁英交流協會今天舉行「誰的孫中山？—中共紀念大會的對臺統戰」座談會，由中華亞太菁英交流協會秘書長王智盛主持，多位學者與會，針對昨天中共舉辦「紀念孫中山先生誕辰160週年大會」，以及中共總書記習近平在活動上發表的講話進行分析。
中央研究院近代史研究所兼任研究員陳儀深指出，觀察習近平講話前後文，談及「繼承」時，習近平自稱中共是孫中山革命事業「最忠實的繼承者」，這種論調一方面跳過中華民國民國史，也使國民黨的立場與繼承資格陷入尷尬處境。
他續指，觀察習近平講話前後文，「他不敢去說繼承的內容是什麼」，只能籠統地講愛國主義精神、奮力實現祖國繁榮富強、愛黨愛社會主義。而習近平講到「堅持黨的全面領導和黨中央的集中統一領導」則又「露出馬腳」，陳儀深說，以孫中山立場而言，不會在此時還堅持「黨的全面領導」。
國父紀念館研究典藏組研究員鍾文博則認為，中共對孫中山的話語所做的解讀，有些超譯甚至誤讀的部分。例如孫中山談「民族主義」強調濟弱扶貧的觀念，也強調和平理念。
又如習近平引述孫中山提過「統一是中國全體國民的希望」，鍾文博指，這句話缺乏完整前後脈絡，有斷章取義之嫌。
這句話的後半段是「能夠統一全國人民便享幸福，不能統一便會受害」。他說，孫中山更強調的其實是「幸福」，孫中山認為一個國家的偉大在於人民能夠幸福，而這句話放在時代脈絡來看，是針對當時飽受中國分裂所苦的人民，是站在「民本思想」所發表的言論。
國防安全研究院國家安全研究所副研究員王占璽則認為，中國共產黨並不在乎對孫中山的理解是否錯誤，「他在乎的是他怎麼樣用孫中山這樣的一個政治符號，把他想講的話說出來」。其中也反映出中共統戰敘事的特色，即經常單方面設定價值框架。
王占璽指出，近年中共以紀念孫中山試圖建立兩岸共同性，也是單方面政治主張，忽略兩岸政治體制、社會運作與人民需求的差異。目標即是透過這種單方面敘事在台灣內部尋找能夠與他們論述相呼應的群體，進而為他們的政治目標服務。
台北海洋科技大學通識教育中心助理教授吳瑟致表示，中共高規格紀念孫中山目的包括爭奪歷史詮釋權、利用民族復興概念包裝對台統一目的、透過紀念活動擴大對台統戰作為。
他指出，在歷史方面，北京只繼承孫中山的民族主義，卻沒有強調民權與共和精神，凸顯中共政治矛盾；兩岸方面，北京試圖將民族情感與政治認同掛鉤，試圖將共同的歷史變成共同責任，甚至變成是接受統一的共同政治義務。此外，台灣即將進行九合一地方選舉，也需謹慎中共透過操作議題連線，將反對中國統一主張者貼上破壞民族團結的標籤。
吳瑟致指出，台灣不需要陷入北京所設定歷史正統性爭論，也不必爭論誰才是孫中山真正的繼承者，否則很容易落入中共設定框架。而是應該強調孫中山的民權與共和精神相關論述有沒有被落實，而台灣如今的民主正是凸顯民權精神在當代政治實踐的重要象徵。（編輯：陳鎧妤）1151113

content:
唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)将于下星期在亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议期间与中国领导人习近平举行会晤。他是否会在峰会期间再度向习近平提出要求释放香港《壹传媒》创办人黎智英引发外界关注。特朗普星期四(11月12日)透露，中方对黎智英“恨意极深”，要成功让黎智英获释，困难重重。分析人士指出，中共现政权显然认为，如何处置黎智英关系到中共的存亡。
因“串谋勾结外国势力”等罪名被判入狱的香港《壹传媒》创办人黎智英，能否早日重获自由，备受国际社会关注。在美中元首再次会晤前夕，特朗普星期四接受美国塞勒姆新闻频道(Salem News Channel)专访，在被问及与习近平会晤时，会否以中国近日涉嫌向美国企业实施间谍活动，向对方施压，设法让黎智英获释。此前，美国芯片巨头英伟达(Nvidia)前总裁黄仁勋婚外情对象疑为中国间谍一事引发全球高度关注。
特朗普表示，中国国家主席习近平对黎智英怀有“极大憎恨”，他对北京同意释放黎智英并不乐观。
特朗普说，“我曾帮助其他人获释，但黎智英的情况稍有不同。”今年5月，特朗普在北京与习近平会晤时，曾向对方提及北京锡安教会创始人金明日的个案，两个月后，金明日获释返回美国。
特朗普分析北京拒绝释放黎智英的原因。他认为当中存在“极深恨意”(great level of hatred)和敌意(great animosity)，他又强调，这样说已经“比较客气”。
据彭博社和法新社报道，特朗普总统说，习近平曾向他解释香港发生的事情，指黎智英是民主运动的领袖，给中国当局带来“极大困扰”。
特朗普总统今年5月在北京会晤习近平时提了黎智英的案子。今年10月，特朗普透露，两人在华盛顿举行会晤时，讨论了黎智英的案子。
国际人权组织《人权观察》(HRW)亚洲区副主任王松莲对美国之音表示，北京对黎智英的敌意，源于黎智英被捕前长期支持香港和中国大陆的民主运动，被认为对中国的政治制度构成威胁，也跟黎智英的传奇背景为不少中国人带来憧憬有关。
王松莲说：“生于中国的黎智英来到香港后获得发展的机会，成为非常成功的国际商人。他的成功故事跟香港的自由紧紧相关。在中国，由于社会的不公，普通的年轻人很难往上走，除非你是党员。黎智英整个人生的传奇故事，代表了民主可以给无权无势的人一个机会。”
王颂莲说，现政权显然认为，如何处置黎智英关系到中共的存亡。
王松莲说：“中国政府认为他(黎智英)是很严重的威胁。他代表了一个另类的中国梦，就好像是许志永、刘晓波这类人物，代表了中国可以有另一个发展的未来(可能)。这未来是建基于没有共产党的未来。”
日本神奈川大学亚洲研究中心客席研究员叶锦龙接受美国之音采访时表示，相信北京正企图利用黎智英转移视线。
叶锦龙说：“与其说北京对黎智英有仇，倒不如说，它对于黎智英所代表的香港整体社群有仇。中共不愿承认，它在香港已得不到民心。它必须利用一些‘稻草人’去扮演勾结外国势力的角色，让‘故事’更为圆满：社会运动或港人对于社会的不满，必定与外部因素有关。”
78岁的黎智英因为“串谋勾结外国势力”和“发布煽动刊物”等罪名，今年2月被判囚20年，目前在香港赤柱监狱被单独囚禁。据家属披露，近期黎智英体重锐减，身体状况大不如前。多国政府与国际人权组织一直要求港府放人。
今年5月13日，唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统抵达北京访问的同一天，美国国会众参两院先后无异议通过决议案，呼吁美国总统在未来与中国领导人进行接触时，应优先致力于推动释放包括黎智英在内等多位政治犯和宗教界人士。
9月，美国国会行政当局中国委员会(CECC)曾举行听证会，讨论黎智英被囚、香港新闻自由及法治状况。当时黎智英儿子黎崇恩呼吁国际社会在特朗普与习近平会面前，继续向北京施压。
《人权观察》的王松莲相信，从目前情况看来，北京根本无意释放黎智英。
王松莲说：“目前中国正处于强势年代。‘筹码’这说法基本上不成立，因为中国政府不认为他们是筹码。现在中国是世界上第二大经济体，所以它不需要交换一些什么，在习近平的统治下，政治还有意识形态被放到最高点。它(中国)既不太在乎与美国或其他国家的经济关系，更不会牺牲对于黎智英的控制。”
华裔美国地震学家陈友麟和美籍缅甸裔学者敏辛等人被中国当局逮捕、拘留，至今仍未获释。身在日本的香港学者叶锦龙认为，从北京对待这批外籍人士的轨迹判断，黎智英在短期内重获自由不容乐观。

content:
资料照片：台湾国防部公布的照片显示一艘台湾军舰在2023年9月监控远处中国航母“山东号”在台湾附近水域活动。
台湾国安官员说，中国这个月初在西太平洋和台湾周边进行的无代号大规模演习，是一场“无声的恫吓”行动，意在国际领导人会谈及台湾“九合一”地方选举前对地区国家和台湾施压。
路透社星期五(11月13日)援引不具名台湾资深安全官员的话报道，中国解放军与海警这个月早些时候在地区开展了一场大规模、未公布的军事演习，模拟对台湾和其他国家的军队与城市的攻击，一度还曾集结了100多艘舰艇，而且这次解放军的海军部署较2025年正式命名为“正义使命”的环台演习规模更大。
该名台湾官员说：“这是一场无声的演习——实际上，是无声的恫吓。”
中国正为下星期将在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织(APEC)峰会进行准备，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)、中国国家主席习近平将在此次峰会上进行今年以来的第三次会面。台湾政府也已宣布，将由电脑大厂宏碁(ACER)集团创办人施振荣作为领袖代表参加此次峰会。
中国将台湾视为其一省，北京当局在“中国台湾”的政治框架下将其称为“台湾地区”，并坚持台湾参与国际组织须在其“一个中国原则”下处理，台湾参与APEC则是依据入会时该组织谅解备忘录规定，以“中华台北”名称出席相关活动。
台北拒绝中国的主权宣示，坚持中华民国与中华人民共和国“互不隶属”。台湾总统府发言人郭雅慧说，依据1991年签署的入会备忘录，台湾作为APEC正式会员，持续在平等基础上参与各项会务，这是APEC惯例，与所谓的“一个中国原则”无关，她呼吁北京履行主东道主职责并作出书面保证，确保台湾代表团在平等地位上参与各项会议。
台湾中央社星期五援引国安人士的分析报道说，这场不挂演习代号的军事活动可从三方面解读，首先是APEC与台湾“九合一”地方选举前施压的“双重算计”，若在会前高调宣布对台军演势必引起国际强烈反弹、破坏峰会主场外交氛围，因此采取“无声”模式可维持军事威慑并保留外交回旋空间；在台湾选前施压也是要营造“兵凶战危气氛”恐吓台湾人民，不公布演习可避免引发台湾人民反感。
其次，这名国安人士说，从解放军实际部署及演练项目来看，此次“剧本式围台演练”实际反映了北京对第一岛链“系统性的战区级兵力投射与军事压制的真实企图”，协调北部、东部与南部战区的海军兵力，其动员已远超过中国自身国土防卫的必要，显示中国将各区域舰队整合为单一远海作战任务，在西太平洋联合作战环境进行实战化验证。
第三，这是中共领导人习近平开展军中大清洗后首次军委会级别的全军战略演习，因为中共清洗解放军高层领导后，军委会级别的全军战略演习去年一度停摆，这是第一次重新启动。
台湾国安会秘书长吴钊燮11月3日在社交媒体平台X贴文，公布中共海军与海警在台海及第一岛链周边的常态化和跨区军事部署，并以谷歌地图表示，中共海军与中国海警在西太平洋部署了超过100艘舰艇。
美国智库战争研究所(ISW)与美国企业研究所(AEI)在上星期五发布的《中国-台湾情势更新》(China-Taiwan Update)一文指出，中国可能在台湾周边举行一场未宣布的重要演习，规模要比解放军2025年的“正义使命”环台演习更大，参演部队来自东部、北部和南部战区，很可能意味着中国正试图将这三个沿海战区的水面作战舰艇协调起来进行一个远海行动。
“中国决定不公布这场演习是一个显著的异常做法，它可能意图营造一种印象，就是解放军能随心所欲将台湾孤立，其目的是要削弱台湾对其自我防卫能力的信心，以及对美国在台湾遭到入侵或封锁的紧急情况时，是否有意愿和有能力援助台湾的信心，”文章说。
台湾国防部长顾立雄星期二表示，中国正在西太平洋地区进行“区域拒止”演习，参与演习的部队包括“辽宁号”航空母舰及其他海军编队。
吴钊燮星期四在其官方社交媒体平台X上说，目前中国解放军在第一岛链的军舰数量已减少，但其北部、东部及南部战区及“辽宁号”航母打击团仍然在菲律宾东部水域活动，解放军战机也还在台湾附近活动。
七国集团(G7)外长这个星期在巴黎举行的最新一轮会议中发表联合声明，再次强调维护台湾海峡和平与稳定的重要性，并批评中国当局在台湾以东海域日益频繁的骚扰活动。
“鉴于中国在台湾以东海域日益强势的活动已威胁到区域稳定、航行自由及国际航运安全，我们重申反对任何单方面改变现状的企图，特别是通过武力、胁迫或以武力及胁迫相威胁，我们鼓励通过建设性对话解决台海议题，也表达我们对台湾有意义参与国际组织的支持，“联合声明说。

content:
2025年5月22日，台北国际电脑展期间，Megaspeed前中国高管黄乐(右)在台北一家餐厅参加由英伟达前首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋(左，身穿黑色背对摄像头)主持的晚宴。(视频截图)
美国芯片巨头英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)与疑似中国间谍黄乐(Alice Wong)的婚外情风波，意外将美国对华芯片出口监管的难度和漏洞推上台面。
新加坡注册的Megaspeed及其前中国籍高管黄乐曾成功购入价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进芯片,这些芯片如何通过所谓的“新加坡洗白”流入中国？将芯片部署在第三地数据中心，再远程向中国企业出租算力，是否已成为规避美国出口禁令的灰色地带？
随着事件发酵，美国国会多个议员已经呼吁进一步收紧对华芯片管制，专家们预测，相关操作空间也恐将受到压缩。
新加坡内政部(Ministry of Home Affairs)星期四(11月12日)晚间发布的一份声明，进一步揭露了Megaspeed令人生疑的运作。
新加坡警方和海关早在去年2月就对Megaspeed等多家公司及其主要负责人，包括时任董事长兼执行长的黄乐在内，就其涉嫌在购买服务器时做虚假申报以及其他相关违法行为展开调查。新加坡当局说，他们并非调查她是否涉及间谍活动。
结果显示，Megaspeed购入的伺服器，中转新加坡后再出口至马来西亚，期间未流入新加坡本地市场。目前警方还在追查这些伺服器运抵马来西亚后，是否违反对新加坡海关的申报，或甚至已被转运他国。
新加坡警方称其一度谘询美超微公司(Supermicro)，但有过走私芯片到中国的美超微合作意愿不高，美国当局提供的资讯也有限。
声明还说，去年6月24日，美国商务部工业与安全局(BIS)在黄乐陪同下，展开对Megaspeed装运伺服器后的实地核查，这是新加坡首次获知Megaspeed和黄乐遭美方锁定。
新加坡警方当日也同步录取黄乐的口供，且因她未在新加坡长住，依法扣押其护照以确保她配合后续调查。警方认定，黄乐于调查期间，提供不实信息且企图淡化其在Megaspeed的角色，但最后因证据不足，仅对她提出严厉警告，并于今年2月26日归还她的护照，并禁止她再次入境，黄乐也于同日离境。
美国之音以电邮致函Megaspeed进一步谘询，但截稿前未获回应，三度致电其新加坡总部电话，总机自动应答“电话不通”后即遭挂断，不禁令人质疑其正常运营现况。
纽约做空机构Culper Research早于今年5月就发布报告称，中国科技企头阿里巴巴是Megaspeed背后的金主，尤令人咋舌的是，Megaspeed的总资产从2023年的约3,300万美元，一年内就暴增90倍至2024年的近30亿美元，而且从默默无闻，一跃成为英伟达在亚太区的最大芯片买家。
根据新加坡工商注册资料，Megaspeed前身是2015年注册成立的7Road International，即中国游戏公司第七大道，2023年3月才更名为Megaspeed International。
Megaspeed现由在新加坡注册的Swiftdata全资拥有，Swiftdata成立于2023年10月，自称其为提供云算力和伺服器的服务公司，而非传统的数据中心建设和营运商。
分析人士认为，Megaspeed恐为空壳公司，但其“洗白”后的新加坡法人企业身分可规避美国禁令，向英伟达等美企大肆采购AI高级芯片。
台北智库科技、民主与社会研究中心(DSET)的经济安保组海外研究员曾稚骅曾稚骅说:“它(Megaspeed/新加坡)就是一个中转站、一个节点，这些(芯片)甚至都没有进到新加坡本地的市场，就直接出口，透过Aivres去采购(组装)，把它放到马来西亚跟印尼等地(的数据中心)，再把算力回租给阿里巴巴或其他中企，也有部分(芯片)疑似直接流回中国。”
Aivres原为中国伺服器巨头浪潮集团(Inspur)的海外子公司，美国于2023年将浪潮打入黑名单后，其美国子公司并更名为Aivres，至今未遭美国列名，继续在硅谷运营。
他说，Megaspeed的迂回操作对英伟达的客户认证(know your customers, KYC)造成挑战，也增加美国跨海进行终端用户查核(end-user check, EUC)的难度，尤其新加坡一再重申中立立场，不执行他国单边的出口管制，对美国芯片监管的配合度或有限。
不过，新加坡当局也坚称，绝不包庇外企利用与新加坡的关联，以不实手法规避他国出口管制的行径。
《黄仁勋传(The Thinking Machine)》一书作者、美国籍科技记者史蒂芬·维特（Stephen Witt）在接受《纽约时报》播客节目采访时表示，Megaspeed另设在马来西亚的数据中心也是其对华走私芯片的中转站，这是业界心照不宣的秘密。
他指出，业内推测两大可能手法，一是高级芯片运抵大马数据中心后，标签随即被撕除并换上伪造标签，真假调包后，循后门走私途径运抵中国；二是在大马数据中心建置算力机房，远端转租给中企使用。
维特表示，境外设空壳公司正是规避美国出口管制的典型走私伎俩。
以今年3月遭美国起诉的美超微走私案为例，内部人员就对装满英伟达芯片的外箱动过手脚，用吹风机热风软化胶水，撕除原厂出货标签后，再贴上假标签掩人耳目。
若Megaspeed循美超微模式非法转运AI芯片至中国，相关人士恐面临美国司法部的追诉。不过，若是后者算力转租的模式，美国目前似乎无法可办，唯美国各界已呼吁，严查Megaspeed或将其与Aivres打入黑名单。
对此，Megaspeed星期四发布声明称，将配合美国政府和BIS，全面清查旗下图形处理器(GPU)，以具体行动证明营运合规。
该公司接任黄乐的现任新加坡籍董事长暨执行长陈永邦(James Tan Yong Pong)强调，Megaspeed高度重视遵守美国出口管制法律的义务，将合规视为基本优先事项，也已委托美国知名律所独立查核，并全面配合美国政府相关机关的合规要求。
多年来，中国企业利用“新加坡洗白”的方式，将业务、控股结构或总部“出海”转移至新加坡，以隐藏与中国的连结并降低地缘政治风险，或借由新加坡的国际信誉进行“品牌或身份洗白”。
不过，此策略已引来新加坡人士的诟病，壳牌公司(Shell)亚太区国际/政府关系总监林瑞光就曾公开呼吁，新加坡应从政策上避免留下“脏水”的“新加坡洗白”，并建议来到新加坡的外企“浸泡”融入本地。
新加坡国立大学政治系副教授庄嘉颖也说，贸易中间人的角色让新加坡商有利可图，但不管是洗芯片，还是之前帮缅甸和北韩规避制裁买军火，当局应正视这种洗白手法对新加坡带来的商誉损失和风险，例如遭二级制裁(secondary sanction)的风险。
庄嘉颖告诉美国之音:“新加坡洗白这种行为，之前大国角逐没有那么剧烈……华盛顿或北京可能会有一些埋怨，(但)不会做什么。可是现在两边对于彼此的疑心更大，所以他们可能更愿意去制裁第三方。”
他说，美国对新加坡二级制裁的工具包括，限制新加坡对美投资的金流或提高审核门槛、或提高对新加坡产品的海关查验程度，甚至解除新加坡护照的美国免签优惠待遇等。
不过，台北研究人员曾稚骅说，随着黄仁勋风暴掀开芯片采购的可能“洗芯片”弊端，未来美国对华芯片禁令恐升级，也会压缩“新加坡洗白”的空间。
黄仁勋的婚外情丑闻曝光后，美国国会两院两党议员表示将立法加强芯片出口管控，并推动将有关限制措施写入必须尽快通过的年度《国防授权法案》(NDAA)。
曾稚骅说:“洗芯片、新加坡洗白这事，它未来的空间应该只会越来越小了，因为现在外部要检视新加坡或东南亚国家的压力只会越来越多，如KYC的压力等等，这个(洗芯片)空间本来就会很少。”
国际调研机构Counterpoint Research位于印度孟买的研究副总裁尼尔·沙（Neil Shah）以电邮接受美国之音采访时表示，Megaspeed惹议后，在新加坡注册的AI、云服务公司和经销商，未来恐面临更冗长的监管稽核，包括落实KYC审查等程序，这对规模较小或新设的主机托管业者带来冲击，整个亚太区域的企业订单处理也将放缓，以便查明芯片或算力负载的最终流向。
不过，他说，新加坡电信(Singtel)等既有业者或将受惠，因为相较来历不明的中间商，监管机关与供应商将更倾向直接与已上市、营运透明的电信业者合作。
尼尔·沙研判，当地企业未来也恐积极寻求英伟达以外的供应来源，如测试超威(AMD)及其他客制化芯片供应商的替代方案，以免于承受额外审查。

content:
资料照片：委内瑞拉卡比马斯(Cabimas)，马拉开波湖畔的一台抽油机。(2026年1月27日)
美国国务院星期四(11月12日)发布一份报告称，今年前九个月，国务院经手了超过120亿美元来自委内瑞拉石油及其他资源的收入，并将这笔资金几乎全部返还给了委内瑞拉。
华盛顿通过一套金融机制来管理这些收入。该机制是在2026年1月尼古拉斯·马杜罗(Nicolás Maduro)被捕后建立的。这些资金的管理属于与代总统德尔西·罗德里格斯(Delcy Rodríguez)领导的过渡政府所达成协议的一部分。
根据协议条款，委内瑞拉出售石油及其他资源所得的资金将进入一个由美国财政部管理的账户，这些资金的用途须经美国财政部批准。
根据该安排，资金被存入一个由美方管理的账户中。随后，委内瑞拉中央银行会提出领取这些资金的请求，而美方官员则需决定是否予以放行。
报告称，该机制旨在促进委内瑞拉自然资源收益的透明度、问责制以及负责任的管理。
美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥(Marco Rubio) 本星期在巴黎举行的七国集团(G7)外长会议期间向记者发表谈话时，强调了委内瑞拉政治过渡进程所取得的进展，并表示美方期望在建立新的司法和选举机构方面，能遵守关键的时间节点。
“所以，我认为我们进展良好。我们必须持续推进，以确保能够遵守这些时间期限。”卢比奥说。
这位美国最高外交官员解释道，该计划要求在12月中旬前任命新的最高法院大法官，随后不久将组建一个新的选举委员会。
卢比奥还强调了扩大委内瑞拉国际关系对于支持该国复苏的重要性。
“我们认为他们不仅能为委内瑞拉的复苏作出很多的贡献，而且在我看来，委内瑞拉越是多与俄罗斯、中国和伊朗以外的世界接触，就越能在经济和社会层面取得复苏进展。”卢比奥说。
这份由毕马威会计师事务所(KPMG)撰写的报告指出，截至2026年9月，大部分拨付的资金都是通过委内瑞拉商业银行开展的外汇交易进入该国经济。报告并未说明谁最终接受了这些资金。
此外，另有约1.33亿美元被调拨于向商品和服务供应商进行直接支付，以满足委内瑞拉过渡政府的运营及行政需求。
根据这一报告，2026年1月3日至9月30日期间，存入托管账户的资金超过122.6亿美元，其中121.1亿美元已拨付。
截至9月30日，另有1.6856亿美元仍由美国代管，未来委内瑞拉中央银行代表过渡政府提出后续的转移请求后再作授权释放。

content:
检方因无人机使用中国芯片起诉夫妇 - 聚焦台湾
检察官因无人机中的中国芯片起诉夫妇
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月13日电 台中检方周五起诉一名科技公司老板及其妻子，涉嫌向台湾军方采购的无人机提供中国制造的芯片，寻求每名被告至少五年有期徒刑。
台中地检署表示，总部位于台中的 Align Corp. 的所有者杜 (Du) 故意使用中国制造的芯片，尽管合同条款禁止使用中国产品和组件。
检察官称，他还涉嫌在原产地证书和产品保修中提供虚假信息，声称这些产品是在台湾设计和制造的。
在交货检查过程中发现涉嫌使用中国制造的芯片。
中华民国军事学院 (ROCMA) 在训练无人机中发现了北京 T31 系列芯片，而陆军后勤司令部在用于投掷爆炸物的无人机中发现了标有“中国”的芯片。
中华民国是台湾的正式名称。
军方随后向台中检察官报告了调查结果。
这张 CNA 档案照片中的一架台湾制造的无人机在空中飞行，以供说明
检察官称，在调查过程中，屠承认军用无人机使用了中国制造的部件，并指示员工不要在网上或向其他人透露此事。
检察机关称，涂某及其妻子黄某因违反国家安全法、伪造文件罪、诈骗罪等罪，被检察机关起诉，要求每人判处五年以上有期徒刑。
Align Corp. 总部位于台中市丰原区，由涂先生创立，最初是通过制造遥控直升机开展业务的。
黄先生担任该公司副总裁，负责监督政府合同投标、生产订单和合同履行。
Align Corp. 赢得了多项军事合同，包括向 ROCMA 和陆军后勤司令部供应训练无人机的招标，以及向海军左营后勤保障司令部供应遥控直升机的招标。

Prosecutors indict couple over Chinese chips in drones
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 13 (CNA) Taichung prosecutors indicted a technology company owner and his wife Friday for allegedly supplying Chinese-made chips in drones procured by Taiwan's military, seeking prison terms of at least five years for each defendant.
The Taichung District Prosecutors Office said Tu (杜), the owner of Taichung-based Align Corp., knowingly used Chinese-made chips despite contract terms prohibiting the use of Chinese products and components.
He also allegedly provided false information in certificates of origin and product warranties, claiming that the products were designed and manufactured in Taiwan, prosecutors said.
The alleged use of Chinese-made chips was discovered during delivery inspections.
The Republic of China Military Academy (ROCMA) found Beijing T31-series chips in training drones, while the Army Logistics Command found chips marked "China" inside drones designed to drop explosives.
The Republic of China is Taiwan's official name.
The military subsequently reported the findings to Taichung prosecutors.
A Taiwan-made drone takes to the air in this CNA file photo for illustrative purposes
During the investigation, Tu admitted that Chinese-made components had been used in the military drones and that he had instructed employees not to disclose the matter online or to others, prosecutors said.
According to the prosecutors' office, Tu and his wife, surnamed Huang (黃), were indicted on charges of violating the National Security Act and committing forgery and fraud under the Criminal Code, with prosecutors seeking prison terms of at least five years for each.
Align Corp., based in Taichung's Fengyuan District, was founded by Tu, who initially built the business by manufacturing remote-controlled helicopters.
Huang served as the company's vice president and oversaw its government contract bids, production orders and contract fulfillment.
Align Corp. has won several military contracts, including tenders to supply training drones to the ROCMA and Army Logistics Command, as well as remote-controlled helicopters to the Navy's Zuoying Logistics Support Command.

content:
台湾芯片供应商认为英伟达领导层变动影响有限 - 焦点台湾
台湾芯片供应商认为英伟达领导层变动的影响有限
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月13日电 行业高管和投资顾问周五表示，英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋的离职可能会加速人工智能(AI)芯片市场的多元化，但不太可能显着扰乱台湾的半导体供应链。
黄仁勋周四辞去了英伟达总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，此前有报道称，黄仁勋与两名女性有婚外情，其中包括一名美国情报官员怀疑与中国情报部门有联系的女商人。
英伟达任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）为临时首席执行官，同时董事会正在寻找永久继任者。
台新证券投资顾问公司在周五发布的一份报告中表示，黄仁勋的辞职可能会加速人工智能芯片订单的多元化，这可能有利于英伟达的竞争对手AMD和博通，以及亚马逊和谷歌，这些公司正在开发自己的专用集成电路（ASIC）或为特定任务设计的芯片。
接受 CNA 采访的几位半导体行业高管表示，ASIC 的发展可能会获得动力，但他们并不认为这会显着改变 ASIC 和图形处理单元 (GPU) 之间的竞争平衡，而图形处理单元 (GPU) 是英伟达人工智能业务的关键。
图片来自 Unsplash 仅供说明之用
半导体基板行业的一位高管表示，英伟达的 GPU 很难被取代，因为许多人工智能开发人员依赖 CUDA，这是英伟达用于开发和运行人工智能应用程序的软件平台，该平台旨在与英伟达的芯片配合使用。
台新的报告称，尽管人工智能芯片需求可能从 GPU 转向 ASIC，但由于芯片制造商与台湾供应商保持着密切关系，预计台湾半导体供应商将面临有限的干扰。
Mega International Investment Services分析师黄国伟也表示，英伟达的领导层变动不太可能对台湾供应商产生重大影响，在需求不断增长和努力减少对中国大陆的依赖的情况下，台湾供应商仍然是人工智能供应链不可或缺的一部分。
黄补充道，个别供应商将继续调整其运营，以应对产品需求和技术发展的变化。
一家半导体封装测试公司的高管表示，他们公司可能会重新分配2027年的部分预算，以降低短期风险。
不过，从长远来看，GPU 和 ASIC 都有着广阔的前景，该公司将根据客户需求继续开发这两种产品，该高管表示。
另一位半导体高管表示，英伟达领导层的变动不会影响英伟达从台湾供应商那里获得的订单，因为日益复杂的GPU技术和冗长的供应商资格审核流程使英伟达很难更换供应商。
台新证券投资咨询表示，对于台湾半导体供应商来说，美国对中国出口政策的变化仍然是一个值得关注的问题，包括对英伟达 H200 出货规则的任何修改。
美国目前要求向经批准的中国客户运送 Nvidia H200 AI 芯片的出口许可证，并且每项申请均需接受安全审查。

Taiwan chip suppliers see limited impact from Nvidia leadership change - Focus Taiwan
Taiwan chip suppliers see limited impact from Nvidia leadership change
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 13 (CNA) Nvidia Corp. co-founder Jensen Huang's (黃仁勳) departure could accelerate diversification in the artificial intelligence (AI) chip market but is unlikely to significantly disrupt Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, industry executives and investment advisers said Friday.
Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO, and a member of its board Thursday, following reports of extramarital relationships with two women, including a businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of having ties to Chinese intelligence.
Nvidia appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO while its board searches for a permanent successor.
In a report released Friday, Taishin Securities Investment Advisory said Huang's resignation could accelerate the diversification of AI chip orders, potentially benefiting Nvidia rivals AMD and Broadcom, as well as Amazon and Google, which are developing their own application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), or chips designed for specific tasks.
Several senior semiconductor industry executives interviewed by CNA said ASIC development could gain momentum, but they did not expect it to significantly alter the competitive balance between ASICs and graphics processing units (GPUs), key to Nvidia's AI business.
Image from Unsplash for illustrative purposes only
An executive in the semiconductor substrate industry said Nvidia's GPUs would be hard to replace because many AI developers rely on CUDA, Nvidia's software platform for developing and running AI applications, which is designed to work with its chips.
Despite a potential shift in AI chip demand from GPUs to ASICs, Taiwan's semiconductor suppliers are expected to face limited disruption because chipmakers maintain close relationships with Taiwanese suppliers, Taishin's report said.
Mega International Investment Services analyst Alex Huang (黃國偉) also said Nvidia's leadership change was unlikely to significantly affect Taiwanese suppliers, which remain integral to the AI supply chain amid rising demand and efforts to reduce reliance on China.
Individual suppliers will continue to adjust their operations in response to changes in product demand and technological developments, Huang added.
An executive at a semiconductor packaging and testing company said their company might reallocate some of its 2027 budget to mitigate risks in the short term.
In the longer term, however, both GPUs and ASICs had promising prospects, and the company would continue developing both based on customer demand, the executive said.
Another semiconductor executive said the change in Nvidia's leadership would not affect Nvidia's orders from Taiwanese suppliers, as increasingly complex GPU technology and lengthy supplier qualification processes make it difficult for Nvidia to switch suppliers.
For Taiwan's semiconductor suppliers, changes in U.S. export policy toward China remain an issue to watch, including any revisions to the rules governing Nvidia's H200 shipments, Taishin Securities Investment Advisory said.
The U.S. currently requires export licenses for Nvidia's H200 AI chips shipped to approved Chinese customers, with each application subject to a security review.
(By Chung Jung-feng, Chiang Ming-yen and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

content:
台北市政府：英伟达履行了规划总部的义务 - 焦点台湾
台北市政府：英伟达履行了规划总部的义务
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月13日电 台北市政府周五表示，英伟达台湾子公司正在履行该公司计划在北投士林科技园区设立海外总部的所有合同义务。
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋周四因涉嫌与一名涉嫌为中国情报机构工作的女性发生婚外情而辞职。
英伟达董事会随后宣布黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)同意担任临时首席执行官。
市政府表示，该土地权合同由英伟达台湾公司签署，该公司已按照协议规定缴纳了履约保证金、土地出让金和土地租金。
市政府表示，Nvidia 于 7 月 15 日提交了建筑许可申请，审查小组于 11 月 5 日批准了该项目的基础工作计划。
台北市政府城市发展局预计将于11月底召开城市设计审查委员会会议。
市政府补充说，如果该计划获得批准，英伟达将能够开始建设。
英伟达收购的北投士林科技园T17、T18地块。 CNA档案照片
市政府表示，英伟达在评估该项目并寻求土地使用权后，决定通过当地子公司设立海外总部。
因此，预计首席执行官的变更不会影响子公司的合同义务，并敦促公众避免可能损害双方之间信任或破坏协议的猜测。
市政府承诺将继续监督该项目并帮助该公司获得必要的批准，以帮助总部尽快竣工并投入运营。
今年 2 月，台北与 Nvidia 签署了价值 122 亿新台币（约合 3.71 亿美元）的协议，获得北投士林科技园区 T17 和 T18 地块 50 年土地使用权，并可选择将期限延长至 20 年。

Nvidia meeting obligations for planned HQ: Taipei City gov't
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 13 (CNA) The Taipei City government said Friday that Nvidia Corp.'s Taiwan subsidiary was meeting all its contractual obligations for the company's planned overseas headquarters at the Beitou-Shilin Technology Park.
The statement came after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (黃仁勳) resigned Thursday following reports of an alleged extramarital relationship involving a woman suspected of working for Chinese intelligence.
Nvidia's board subsequently announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and a board member, and that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress had agreed to serve as interim CEO.
The city government said the land rights contract was signed by Nvidia Iconic Taiwan Co., which has made the required performance bond, land premium and land rent payments in accordance with the agreement.
Nvidia submitted its building permit application on July 15, while a review panel approved plans for the project's foundation work on Nov. 5, the city government said.
The Taipei City government's Department of Urban Development is expected to convene an urban design review committee meeting by the end of November.
If the plan is approved, Nvidia will be able to begin construction, the city government added.
The T17 and T18 plots at Beitou-Shilin Technology Park acquired by Nvidia. CNA file photo
The city government said Nvidia's decision to establish its overseas headquarters through its local subsidiary came after the company assessed the project and sought to secure the land rights.
It therefore did not expect a change of CEO to affect the subsidiary's contractual obligations and urged the public to avoid speculation that could damage trust between the parties or undermine the agreement.
The city government pledged to continue monitoring the project and helping the company obtain the necessary approvals to help complete the headquarters and make it operational as soon as possible.
In February, Taipei signed a NT$12.2 billion (US$371 million) agreement with Nvidia for 50-year land rights to the T17 and T18 plots at Beitou-Shilin Technology Park, with an option to extend the term by up to 20 years.

summary: 新北市长候选人李苏在政策论坛上概述愿景 - 聚焦台湾2026选举/新北市长候选人李苏在政策论坛上概述愿景 要激活文字转语音服务，请先同意以下隐私政策。新北市长候选人李树全（左）、苏巧慧（右）。中新社综合照片 新北11月13日电 新北市市长候选人李四川和苏巧慧星期五概述了截然不同的城市愿景，李承诺进行重大基础设施项目，苏则呼吁更加平衡的发展
content:
新北市长候选人李苏在政策论坛上阐述愿景 - 聚焦台湾
2026 年选举/新北市长候选人李苏在政策论坛上概述愿景
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
新北市长候选人李树全（左）、苏巧慧（右）。 CNA 合成照片
中新社新北11月13日电 新北市长候选人李四川和苏巧慧周五概述了截然不同的城市愿景，李承诺将进行重大基础设施项目，而苏则呼吁各区更加平衡发展。
在这场比赛唯一一次官方组织的电视政策论坛上，国民党的李显龙提议改善与台北的交通联系，并开发人工智能（AI）产业走廊。
与此同时，民进党的苏呼吁在新北各地发展工业园区，让就业机会更接近居民。
凭借四十年的公共服务经验，李承诺将继续在两位国民党市长朱立伦和现任侯友宜的领导下发起或推进的铁路项目。
“创造就业机会、连接交通网络、更新旧建筑并照顾老年居民，”李说，并列出了他当选后的优先事项。
李现年68岁，曾任新北市、高雄市、台北市副市长。他于3月10日辞去台北市副市长职务，并于次日获得国民党提名，首次竞选公职。
国民党反对党新北市长候选人李树全。中央通讯社照片2026年11月13日
李希望将台北和新北主要地区之间的出行时间缩短至30分钟，部分方法是将正在建设中的汐止-东湖捷运线与环线东段连接起来。
他还提议修建一座连接新北芦洲区和台北社子岛的桥梁，以改善通往北投士林科技园区的交通。
民进党苏娇惠呼吁均衡发展
苏强调了新北29个区的不同需求。
“城市地区的人们想要更舒适的居住环境，而沿海社区则需要就业机会，”苏说。 “每个地区都需要均衡发展。”
她的工业发展计划包括拟议在淡水建立科学中心。
她还以河海燕贡寮摇滚音乐节为例，说明该市如何帮助社区发展自己的文化景点。
民进党新北市长候选人苏巧慧。中央通讯社照片2026年11月13日
民进党50岁的苏巧慧自2016年以来连续三届赢得新北立委选举。
如果她获胜，她将成为民进党第一位新北市市长，并结束国民党对该市及其前身台北县大约21年的统治。她的父亲、前总理苏贞昌在1997年至2004年期间担任该县县长。
两位候选人都呼吁加快城市更新速度。
李提议建立一个由市长领导的委员会来协调各城市部门的工作，而苏则呼吁建立一个拥有更多人员和技术的专门部门来帮助审查建筑计划。
为了减轻公务员的工作量，李呼吁简化规则并给予员工更大的自由裁量权。
苏承诺将在 100 天内发布简化程序的指导方针，并表示她将考虑通勤和住房补贴以留住员工。
CNA 文件照片仅供说明之用
李引用私人投资作为竞技场等项目融资的一种方式。

【原文 English Original】
New Taipei mayoral candidates Lee, Su outline visions at policy forum - Focus Taiwan
2026 ELECTIONS/New Taipei mayoral candidates Lee, Su outline visions at policy forum
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
New Taipei mayoral candidates Lee Shu-chuan (left) and Su Chiao-hui (right). CNA composite photo
New Taipei, Nov. 13 (CNA) New Taipei mayoral candidates Lee Shu-chuan (李四川) and Su Chiao-hui (蘇巧慧) outlined contrasting visions for the city Friday, with Lee pledging to carry on major infrastructure projects and Su calling for more balanced development across its districts.
At the race's only officially organized televised policy forum, Lee of the Kuomintang (KMT) proposed improving transport links with Taipei and developing an artificial intelligence (AI) industry corridor.
Su of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), meanwhile, called for developing industrial parks across New Taipei to bring jobs closer to residents.
Drawing on four decades in public service, Lee pledged to continue rail projects initiated or advanced under two KMT mayors, Eric Chu (朱立倫) and incumbent Hou Yu-ih (侯友宜).
"Bring in jobs, connect the transportation network, renew old buildings and take care of older residents," Lee said, listing his priorities if elected.
Lee, 68, has served as deputy mayor of New Taipei, Kaohsiung and Taipei. He stepped down as Taipei deputy mayor on March 10 and was nominated by the KMT the following day for his first bid for elected office.
Opposition KMT's New Taipei mayoral candidate Lee Shu-chuan. CNA photo Nov. 13, 2026
Lee wants to cut travel times between key areas of Taipei and New Taipei to 30 minutes, partly by connecting the Xizhi-Donghu MRT line, now under construction, to the eastern section of the Circular Line.
He also proposed a bridge linking New Taipei's Luzhou District with Taipei's Shezi Island to improve access to the Beitou Shilin Technology Park.
DPP's Su Chiao-hui calls for balanced development
Su emphasized the differing needs of New Taipei's 29 districts.
"People in urban areas want a more comfortable place to live, while coastal communities need job opportunities," Su said. "Every district needs balanced development."
Her industrial development plans include a proposed science hub in Tamsui.
She also cited the Ho-Hai-Yan Gongliao Rock Festival as an example of how the city could help communities develop their own cultural attractions.
Ruling DPP's New Taipei mayoral candidate Su Chiao-hui. CNA photo Nov. 13, 2026
The DPP's Su Chiao-hui, 50, has won three consecutive legislative elections in New Taipei since 2016.
A victory would make her the DPP's first New Taipei mayor and end roughly 21 years of KMT rule in the city and its predecessor, Taipei County, where her father, former Premier Su Tseng-chang (蘇貞昌), served as magistrate from 1997 to 2004.
Both candidates called for faster urban renewal.
Lee proposed establishing a mayor-led committee to coordinate work across city departments, while Su called for creating a dedicated department with more staff and technology to help review building plans.
To ease the workload of civil servants, Lee called for simpler rules and greater discretion for staff.
Su pledged to issue guidelines for streamlining procedures within 100 days and said she would consider commuting and housing subsidies to retain staff.
CNA file photo for illustrative purposes
Lee cited private investment as a way to finance projects such as arenas.
Su proposed allocating the largest share of funding to industrial development, followed by funding to ease administrative workloads and support social welfare.
Independent Su Hui-huang raises housing costs
Independent candidate Su Hui-huang (蘇輝湟) held up a property advertisement to highlight housing costs in Sanchong District.
He has also proposed allowing a man to have two wives or a woman to have two husbands as a response to Taiwan's low birth rate.
Independent New Taipei mayoral candidate Su Hui-huang. CNA file photo
The New Taipei City Election Commission organized the forum ahead of the Nov. 28 vote.
The three candidates answered panelists' questions without cross-examining one another.
On campaign trail, Chiang talks sports, Shen disadvantaged groups
Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) and his challenger Puma Shen (沈伯洋) campaigned in the capital on Sunday, highlighting sports achievements and support for disadvantaged groups, respectively, with local elections less than three weeks away.
Election-related fraud causes NT$20.15 million in losses: CIB
Fraud cases related to Taiwan's upcoming local elections have caused financial losses totaling NT$20.15 million (US$614,598) over the past two months, the Criminal Investigation Bureau (CIB) said Sunday.
Taipei mayoral rivals step up campaigns; back allies in Kaohsiung
Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an's (蔣萬安) campaign called on supporters Saturday to join a Nov. 14 march and rally, while Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) challenger Puma Shen (沈伯洋) led a campaign motorcade through two Taipei districts.

# 特朗普、习近平和普京可能于下周四在深圳会晤

据《纽约邮报》周五报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将于下周在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会期间会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。

发表时间： 13/11/2026 - 23:42

 1 分钟 浏览时间

 2026年10月20日，深圳宝安国际机场，亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议的宣传板。 REUTERS - Tingshu Wang

 作者： [阿曼亭](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E9%98%BF%E6%9B%BC%E4%BA%AD/ "阿曼亭")

广告

继续浏览后续

这家美国报纸称，此次三方会晤预计将聚焦核军控问题，但也可能涉及朝鲜问题和伊朗战争。

唐纳德·特朗普曾公开表示希望与俄罗斯和中国领导人会面。

目前，白宫和中国驻华盛顿大使馆均未对此事作出回应。

美国空军改变了战略前景，宣布了新的《部队设计 2026》，取代了 2024 年制定的先前标准。
一位空军发言人告诉《军事时报》：“美国空军设计 2026 提供了一个持久的框架，用于识别作战问题、塑造能力发展和告知现代化优先事项，确保空军不断发展其作战方式，并部署一支制胜力量。”
“原力设计是一份机密文件，因此没有可发布的副本，”发言人说。
2024 年 10 月，空军宣布将遵循“单一部队设计”文件中规定的指导，该文件由时任参谋长戴维·奥​​尔文上将签署，据称该文件是空军现代化计划的“北极星”。
它引入了三个不同的任务领域，有效地划分了针对无人机系统的防空系统。 2024年文件将空军的无人机杀伤能力分别分为近程、远程和洲际防御三类。
尽管新的 Force Design 2026 文件属于机密，但该服务的发布暗示了一些关键变化。
据称，新的战略展望“更明确地阐明了变革的必要性以及空军所需的能力”，以击败尖端技术。
报告将传感器、网络和人工智能列为对防空系统产生迅速影响的因素。
部队现代化副参谋长兼首席现代化官克里斯·尼米中将在新闻稿中表示：“新技术正在实现几年前难以想象的神奇能力，但这些技术也威胁到了我们历史上产生空中力量的一些方式。”
该文件还指出，“未来空军”将寻求将自主性、传感器以及指挥和控制与飞机整合起来，以“产生效果”，特别强调能够在被拒绝的环境中同步执行任务。
换句话说，新的重点是传感器和软件，而不是拦截和摧毁单个无人机。
空军参谋长肯·威尔斯巴赫上将在军种声明中表示，新的部队设计“体现了空军方法的根本转变”。
威尔斯巴赫说：“新技术正在实现几年前无法想象的神奇能力，但这些技术也威胁到了我们历史上产生空中力量的一些方式。”
齐塔·巴林格·弗莱彻 (Zita Ballinger Fletcher) 曾担任《军事历史季刊》和《越南》杂志的编辑，以及美国缉毒局的历史学家。她以优异的成绩获得了军事史硕士学位。

US Air Force adopts new Force Design focusing on sensors and autonomy

An F-15 refuels. (Alexis Morris/U.S. Air Force)
The U.S. Air Force has changed its strategic outlook, announcing a new Force Design 2026 that replaces its previous standards established in 2024.
“The U.S. Air Force Force Design 2026 provides an enduring framework for identifying operational problems, shaping capability development, and informing modernization priorities – ensuring the Air Force evolves how it fights, and that it fields a winning force,” an Air Force spokesperson told Military Times.
“The Force Design is a classified document so there is no releasable copy,” the spokesperson said.
In October 2024, the service announced it would follow guidance set out in a “One Force Design” document, signed by then-Chief of Staff Gen. David Allvin and said to be the “North Star” for Air Force modernization plans.
It introduced three distinct mission areas, effectively divvying up air defenses against unmanned aircraft systems. The Air Force’s drone-killing capabilities were classified in the 2024 document in categories of short-range, long-range and intercontinental defense, respectively.
Although the new Force Design 2026 document is classified, the service’s release hints at some key changes.
The new strategic outlook is said to be “more sharply articulating the need for change, and the capabilities the Air Force needs” to defeat sophisticated technology.
It lists sensors, networks and artificial intelligence as having had a rapid impact on air defenses.
“New technologies are enabling fantastic capabilities that were unimaginable just a few years ago, but those same technologies threaten some of the ways we have historically generated airpower,” Lt. Gen. Chris Niemi, deputy chief of staff for Force Modernization and Chief Modernization Officer, said in the release.
In another nod to where air defense is going, the document also notes that the “future Air Force” will seek to integrate autonomy, sensors and command and control with aircraft to “generate effects,” with a particular emphasis on being able to perform synchronously in denied environments.
In other words, a new focus on sensors and software is at play rather than on intercepting and destroying individual drones.
Air Force Chief of Staff Gen. Ken Wilsbach said in the service’s statement that the new Force Design “presents a fundamental shift” in the Air Force’s approach.
“New technologies are enabling fantastic capabilities that were unimaginable just a few years ago, but those same technologies threaten some of the ways we have historically generated airpower,” Wilsbach said.
Zita Ballinger Fletcher previously served as editor of Military History Quarterly and Vietnam magazines and as the historian of the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration. She holds an M.A. with distinction in military history.

Presidential Determination No. 2027-02 of October 28, 2026
Presidential Determination Pursuant to Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012
Memorandum for the Secretary of State[,] the Secretary of the Treasury[, and] the Secretary of Energy
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States, after carefully considering the reports submitted to the Congress by the Energy Information Administration, including the report submitted in October 2026, and other relevant factors, including global economic conditions and the availability of strategic reserves, I determine, pursuant to section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012, Public Law 112-81, and consistent with prior determinations, that there is a sufficient supply of petroleum and petroleum products from countries other than Iran to permit a significant reduction in the volume of petroleum and petroleum products purchased from Iran by or through foreign financial institutions.
I will continue to monitor this situation closely.
The Secretary of State is authorized and directed to publish this determination in the Federal Register.
Washington, October 28, 2026

Publication of web general licenses.
The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing two general licenses (GLs) issued pursuant to the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations: GLs ( printed page 73141) 55F and 115D, each of which was previously made available on OFAC's website.
GL 55F was issued on June 11, 2026. See SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION for additional relevant dates.
OFAC: Assistant Director for Regulatory Affairs, 202-622-4855; or https://ofac.treasury.gov/​contact-ofac.
This document and additional information concerning OFAC are available on OFAC's website: https://ofac.treasury.gov/​.
On June 11, 2026, OFAC issued GLs 55F and 115D to authorize certain transactions otherwise prohibited by the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 587 (RuHSR). These GLs were made available on OFAC's website ( https://ofac.treasury.gov) when they were issued. GLs 55F and 115D, each of which expires on December 18, 2026, replaced and superseded GLs 55E and 115C, respectively. The text of these GLs is provided below.
Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations 31 CFR Part 587
Authorizing Certain Services Related to Sakhalin-2
(a) Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by the determination of November 21, 2022 made pursuant to section 1(a)(ii) of Executive Order (E.O.) 14071 (“Prohibitions on Certain Services as They Relate to the Maritime Transport of Crude Oil of Russian Federation Origin”) related to the maritime transport of crude oil originating from the Sakhalin-2 project (“Sakhalin-2 byproduct”) are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time, December 18, 2026, provided that the Sakhalin-2 byproduct is solely for importation into Japan.
(b) Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by E.O. 14024 involving Gazprombank Joint Stock Company (Gazprombank) or any entity in which Gazprombank owns, directly or indirectly, a 50 percent or greater interest, that are related to the Sakhalin-2 project, including such transactions involving Sakhalin Energy LLC, are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time, December 18, 2026.
(c) Except as provided in paragraph (d) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by the determination of January 10, 2025 made pursuant to section 1(a)(ii) of E.O. 14071 (“Prohibition on Petroleum Services”) that are related to the Sakhalin-2 project are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time, December 18, 2026.
(d) This general license does not authorize:
(1) Any transactions prohibited by Directive 2 under E.O. 14024, Prohibitions Related to Correspondent or Payable-Through Accounts and Processing of Transactions Involving Certain Foreign Financial Institutions;
(2) Any transactions prohibited by Directive 4 under E.O. 14024, Prohibitions Related to Transactions Involving the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, the National Wealth Fund of the Russian Federation, and the Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation; or
(3) Any transactions otherwise prohibited by the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 587 (RuHSR), including transactions involving any person blocked pursuant to the RuHSR, other than the blocked persons described in paragraph (b), unless separately authorized.
(e) Effective June 11, 2026, General License No. 55E, dated December 17, 2025, is replaced and superseded in its entirety by this General License No. 55F.
Director, Office of Foreign Assets Control.
Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations 31 CFR Part 587
Authorizing Certain Transactions Related to Civil Nuclear Energy
(a) Except as provided in paragraph (c) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by Executive Order (E.O.) 14024 involving one or more of the following entities that are related to civil nuclear energy are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time, December 18, 2026:
(2) State Corporation Bank for Development and Foreign Economic Affairs Vnesheconombank;
(3) Public Joint Stock Company Bank Financial Corporation Otkritie;
(4) Sovcombank Open Joint Stock Company;
(5) Public Joint Stock Company Sberbank of Russia;
(6) VTB Bank Public Joint Stock Company;
(9) Bank Zenit Public Joint Stock Company;
(10) Bank Saint-Petersburg Public Joint Stock Company;
(12) Any entity in which one or more of the above persons own, directly or indirectly, individually or in the aggregate, a 50 percent or greater interest; or
(13) the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
(b) For the purposes of this general license, the term “related to civil nuclear energy” means transactions undertaken solely to maintain or support civil nuclear projects initiated before November 21, 2024.
(c) This general license does not authorize:
(1) The opening or maintaining of a correspondent account or payable-through account for or on behalf of any entity subject to Directive 2 under E.O. 14024, Prohibitions Related to Correspondent or Payable-Through Accounts and Processing of Transactions Involving Certain Foreign Financial Institutions;
(2) Any debit to an account on the books of a U.S. financial institution of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, the National Wealth Fund of the Russian Federation, or the Ministry of Finance; or
(3) Any transactions otherwise prohibited by the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 587 (RuHSR), including transactions involving any person blocked pursuant to the RuHSR other than the blocked persons described in paragraph (a) of this general license, unless separately authorized.
(d) Effective June 11, 2026, General License No. 115C, dated December 17, 2025, is replaced and superseded in its entirety by this General License No. 115D.
